```python
def seed_default_categories(session: Session, user_id: int) -> int:
    """
    Seed the default category tree if no categories exist for this user.

    Parameters
    ----------
    session : Active SQLAlchemy session.
    user_id : User to seed categories for.

    Returns
    -------
    int : Number of category rows created (0 if already seeded).
    """
    created = 0
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    for type_block in _SEED:
        type_node = (
            session.query(Category)
            .filter(
                Category.user_id == user_id,
                Category.parent_id.is_(None),
                Category.name == type_block["type_name"],
                Category.level == CategoryLevel.type,
            )
            .first()
        )
        if type_node is None:
            type_node = Category(
                user_id          = user_id,
                parent_id        = None,
                name             = type_block["type_name"],
                level            = CategoryLevel.type,
                transaction_type = type_block["transaction_type"],
                created_at       = now,
            )
            session.add(type_node)
            session.flush()
            created += 1

        for cat_name in type_block["categories"]:
            category_exists = (
                session.query(Category)
                .filter(
                    Category.user_id == user_id,
                    Category.parent_id == type_node.id,
                    Category.name == cat_name,
                    Category.level == CategoryLevel.category,
                )
                .first()
            )
            if category_exists is not None:
                continue
            cat_node = Category(
                user_id          = user_id,
                parent_id        = type_node.id,
                name             = cat_name,
                level            = CategoryLevel.category,
                transaction_type = None,
                created_at       = now,
            )
            session.add(cat_node)
            created += 1

    session.commit()
    logger.info(
        "Seed completado para user_id=%d: %d categorías creadas.",
        user_id, created
    )
    return created


def seed_default_rules(session: Session, user_id: int) -> int:
    """Create the confirmed CaixaBank rules for a user's default categories.

    Rules are personal because category IDs belong to a user.  Existing rules
    with the same category and pattern are preserved, making this safe to run
    again after the default categories have already been loaded.
    """
    from app.categorization.rules_engine import create_rule
    from app.db.models import AutoCategorizationRule, MatchType

    categories = get_all_categories(
        session, user_id, level=CategoryLevel.category
    )
    income_category_names = {
        "Nomina Maria",
        "Ayuda Cuidado Menor",
    }

    def find_category(name: str) -> Optional[Category]:
        matches = [category for category in categories if category.name == name]
        if len(matches) == 1:
            return matches[0]
        desired_type = "INGRESO" if name in income_category_names else "GASTO"
        return next(
            (
                category for category in matches
                if category.parent is not None
                and category.parent.name == desired_type
            ),
            None,
        )
    rule_definitions = [
        ("Teléfono", "VODAFONE"),
        ("Teléfono", "EUSKALTEL"),
        ("Teléfono", "MASMOVIL"),
        ("Luz", "IBERDROLA"),
        ("Com. Propiertarios (Cuota)", "CUOTA COMUNIDAD"),
        ("Com. Propiertarios (Gas & ACS)", "AGUA CALIENTE"),
        ("Com. Propiertarios (Gas & ACS)", "CALEFACCION"),
        ("Spotify", "SPOTIFY"),
        ("Netflix", "NETFLIX"),
        ("HBO", "HBO"),
        ("Amazon", "AMAZON"),
        ("Glovo", "GLOVO"),
        ("Gasolina", "REPSOL"),
        ("Gasolina", "GASOLINERA"),
        ("Peajes", "VIA T"),
        ("Peajes", "AUT. VASCO ARAGON"),
        ("Peajes", "TUNELES DE ARTXAN"),
        ("Tabaco", "ESTANCO"),
        ("Parking", "TELPARK"),
        ("Parking", "PARKING"),
        ("Nomina Maria", "MANPOWER TEAM E.T.T."),
        ("Nomina Maria", "PAGE GROUP SPAIN RECURSOS HUMANOS"),
        ("Ayuda Cuidado Menor", "EUSKO JAURLARITZA-GOBIERNO VASCO"),
        ("Apple iCloud", "APPLE"),
        ("Apple iCloud", "ITUNES"),
        ("Transporte", "UBER"),
        ("Transporte", "RENFE"),
        ("Transporte", "METRO"),
        ("Ocio, Eventos y Bodas", "PADEL"),
    ]

    created = 0
    for category_name, pattern in rule_definitions:
        category = find_category(category_name)
        if category is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"No existe la categoría por defecto '{category_name}' "
                f"para user_id={user_id}."
            )

        exists = (
            session.query(AutoCategorizationRule)
            .filter(
                AutoCategorizationRule.user_id == user_id,
                AutoCategorizationRule.category_id == category.id,
                AutoCategorizationRule.match_pattern == pattern,
                AutoCategorizationRule.match_type == MatchType.contains,
            )
            .first()
        )
        if exists is not None:
            continue

        create_rule(
            session,
            category_id=category.id,
            match_pattern=pattern,
            match_type=MatchType.contains,
            priority=100,
            user_id=user_id,
        )
        created += 1

    logger.info(
        "Reglas por defecto completadas para user_id=%d: %d creadas.",
        user_id,
        created,
    )
    return created


def get_all_categories(
    session: Session,
    user_id: int,
    level: Optional[CategoryLevel] = None,
) -> List[Category]:
    """
    Return all categories for a user, optionally filtered by level.
    Sorted by: type name → category name.

    Parameters
    ----------
    session : Active SQLAlchemy session.
    user_id : Target user.
    level   : Optional filter (CategoryLevel.type / .category / .subcategory).

    Returns
    -------
    List[Category] sorted alphabetically within each type.
    """
    query = session.query(Category).filter(Category.user_id == user_id)
    if level is not None:
        query = query.filter(Category.level == level)
    return query.order_by(Category.name).all()


def get_category_by_id(
    session: Session,
    category_id: int,
) -> Optional[Category]:
    """Return a Category by primary key, or None if not found."""
    return session.get(Category, category_id)


def create_category(
    session:          Session,
    user_id:          int,
    name:             str,
    level:            CategoryLevel,
    parent_id:        Optional[int]          = None,
    transaction_type: Optional[TransactionType] = None,
) -> Category:
    """
    Create a new category node.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError : If name is empty, or parent_id is missing for non-type levels.
    """
    if not name or not name.strip():
        raise ValueError("El nombre de la categoría no puede estar vacío.")
    if level != CategoryLevel.type and parent_id is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Las categorías de nivel '{level.value}' requieren un parent_id."
        )

    cat = Category(
        user_id          = user_id,
        parent_id        = parent_id,
        name             = name.strip(),
        level            = level,
        transaction_type = transaction_type,
        created_at       = datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )
    session.add(cat)
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(cat)
    logger.info(
        "Categoría creada: '%s' (level=%s, id=%d)",
        cat.name, cat.level.value, cat.id
    )
    return cat


def update_category_name(
    session:     Session,
    category_id: int,
    new_name:    str,
) -> Category:
    """
    Rename an existing category.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError : If category not found or new name is empty.
    """
    if not new_name or not new_name.strip():
        raise ValueError("El nuevo nombre no puede estar vacío.")

    cat = session.get(Category, category_id)
    if cat is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Categoría con id={category_id} no encontrada.")

    cat.name = new_name.strip()
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(cat)
    logger.info("Categoría id=%d renombrada a '%s'.", category_id, cat.name)
    return cat


def delete_category(
    session:     Session,
    category_id: int,
) -> None:
    """
    Delete a category and all its children (cascade).
    Transactions assigned to this category will have category_id set to NULL
    (handled by the DB FK ondelete=SET NULL).

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError : If category not found.
    """
    cat = session.get(Category, category_id)
    if cat is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Categoría con id={category_id} no encontrada.")

    name = cat.name
    session.delete(cat)
    session.commit()
    logger.info("Categoría '%s' (id=%d) eliminada.", name, category_id)


def _similarity_key(issuer_name: Optional[str], concept: Optional[str]) -> str:
    """The text two movements must share to count as "the same": the merchant
    (issuer_name) or, when the bank gives none, the full concept — compared
    ignoring case and repeated spaces. Empty means "matches nothing"."""
    return " ".join((issuer_name or concept or "").split()).casefold()


def similar_uncategorized_ids(session: Session, transaction_id: int) -> List[int]:
    """
    IDs of the owner's other uncategorized transactions that look the same
    as this one: same similarity key and same type (an expense never matches
    a refund from the same shop). No fuzzy matching, so the count shown to
    the user is exactly what "apply to similar" will change.
    """
    from app.db.models import Transaction  # local import to avoid circular

    txn = session.get(Transaction, transaction_id)
    if txn is None:
        return []
    key = _similarity_key(txn.issuer_name, txn.concept)
    if not key:
        return []
    candidates = (
        session.query(Transaction.id, Transaction.issuer_name, Transaction.concept)
        .filter(
            Transaction.user_id == txn.user_id,
            Transaction.type == txn.type,
            Transaction.category_id.is_(None),
            Transaction.id != txn.id,
        )
        .all()
    )
    return [row.id for row in candidates if _similarity_key(row.issuer_name, row.concept) == key]


def assign_transaction_category(
    session:          Session,
    transaction_id:   int,
    category_id:      Optional[int],
    apply_to_similar: bool = False,
) -> int:
    """
    Manually assign (or clear) the category of a transaction.

    Parameters
    ----------
    transaction_id   : Target transaction.
    category_id      : New category ID, or None to clear.
    apply_to_similar : Also give the category to the transactions returned
                       by similar_uncategorized_ids (ignored when clearing).

    Returns
    -------
    Number of transactions changed, including this one.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError : If transaction not found.
    """
    from app.db.models import CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL, Transaction  # local import to avoid circular

    txn = session.get(Transaction, transaction_id)
    if txn is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Transacción con id={transaction_id} no encontrada.")

    targets = [txn]
    if apply_to_similar and category_id is not None:
        similar = similar_uncategorized_ids(session, transaction_id)
        if similar:
            targets += session.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id.in_(similar)).all()

    for target in targets:
        target.category_id = category_id
        # A manual choice is protected from rule re-runs; clearing the
        # category hands the transaction back to the rules engine.
        target.category_source = CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL if category_id is not None else None
    session.commit()
    logger.info(
        "Transacción id=%d → category_id=%s (asignación manual, %d movimientos).",
        transaction_id, category_id, len(targets)
    )
    return len(targets)

def assign_user_transaction_category(
    session:          Session,
    user_id:          int,
    transaction_id:   int,
    category_id:      Optional[int],
    apply_to_similar: bool = False,
) -> int:
    """
    assign_transaction_category for a caller that only knows the logged-in
    user (the web front-end): both the transaction and the category must
    belong to user_id, so an id typed by hand can never touch or point at
    another family member's data.

    Raises
    ------
    LookupError : transaction or category not found for this user.
    """
    from app.db.models import Transaction  # local import to avoid circular

    txn = session.get(Transaction, transaction_id)
    if txn is None or txn.user_id != user_id:
        raise LookupError("Transacción no encontrada.")
    if category_id is not None:
        cat = session.get(Category, category_id)
        if cat is None or cat.user_id != user_id:
            raise LookupError("Categoría no encontrada.")
    return assign_transaction_category(session, transaction_id, category_id, apply_to_similar)

```

## `app/categorization/rules_engine.py`

```python
"""
app/categorization/rules_engine.py
====================================
FAMILYFIN — Auto-Categorization Rules Engine

Responsibility:
  Apply AutoCategorizationRule entries to a set of transactions,
  assigning category_id automatically based on pattern matching.

Matching logic:
  - Fields checked (OR gate — match in EITHER field triggers the rule):
      * issuer_name
      * concept
  - Movement type: a rule with transaction_type set (expense / income)
    only matches movements of that type (Transaction.type, from the sign
    of the amount); NULL matches any. The same text («BIZUM», a shop that
    also refunds) can be a payment or a receipt with different categories.
  - Match types:
      contains : case-insensitive substring match
      exact    : case-insensitive full-string match
      regex    : Python re.search() match (case-insensitive)
  - Priority: lower number = higher priority (rule with priority=1
    beats priority=100). First match wins.
  - Conflict detection: if two rules of different categories match the
    SAME transaction at DIFFERENT priorities, the higher-priority rule
    wins silently. If two rules match at the SAME priority, a conflict
    is flagged and the user is notified (no auto-assignment).

Global vs. per-user rules:
  - AutoCategorizationRule.user_id = NULL  → global rule (all users)
  - AutoCategorizationRule.user_id = X     → rule for user X only
  - Per-user rules override global rules at the SAME priority.
  - Load order: global rules first, then user rules (user rules can
    shadow global rules at equal priority).
  - Categories belong to one user, so a global rule's category_id points
    into its creator's tree. For any other user the rule is applied to the
    equivalent category in that user's own tree (same name and same parent
    type name); if there is none, the global rule is skipped for that user.
  - The demo account (config.DEMO_USERNAME) never sees or applies global
    rules: see rule_scope().

Output:
  RulesEngineResult.assigned   : {transaction_id: category_id}
  RulesEngineResult.conflicts  : {transaction_id: [RuleConflict, ...]}
  RulesEngineResult.unmatched  : [transaction_id, ...]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config import DEMO_USERNAME
from app.db.models import (
    CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL,
    CATEGORY_SOURCE_RULE,
    AutoCategorizationRule,
    Category,
    MatchType,
    Transaction,
    TransactionType,
    User,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# The movement types a rule can be limited to. Transaction.type comes from
# the sign of the amount, so it is never "investment": an investment
# contribution is an expense movement filed under an INVERSION category.
RULE_TRANSACTION_TYPES = (TransactionType.expense, TransactionType.income)

# update_rule(): "leave transaction_type as it is" (None means "any type").
_UNCHANGED = object()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Result types
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class RuleConflict:
    """Two rules matched the same transaction at the same priority."""
    transaction_id: int
    rule_a_id:      int
    rule_b_id:      int
    category_a_id:  int
    category_b_id:  int
    priority:       int
    field_matched:  str   # 'issuer_name' | 'concept' | 'both'
    pattern_a:      str
    pattern_b:      str


@dataclass
class RulesEngineResult:
    """
    Result of running the rules engine over a batch of transactions.

    Attributes
    ----------
    assigned  : dict {transaction_id: category_id} — auto-assigned.
    assigned_by_rule : dict {rule_id: transaction_count} — assignments won
                       by each rule.
    transaction_ids_by_rule : dict {rule_id: [transaction_id, ...]} —
                              transactions assigned by each rule.
    conflicts : dict {transaction_id: List[RuleConflict]} — needs user input.
    unmatched : List[transaction_id] — no rule matched.
    applied   : int — total rules applied (assigned + conflict rows).
    transactions_by_id : dict {transaction_id: Transaction} — the ORM
                          objects already loaded while matching, so callers
                          (e.g. apply_rules_and_commit) don't need to
                          re-fetch them one by one.
    """
    assigned:  Dict[int, int]               = field(default_factory=dict)
    assigned_by_rule: Dict[int, int]        = field(default_factory=dict)
    transaction_ids_by_rule: Dict[int, List[int]] = field(
        default_factory=dict
    )
    conflicts: Dict[int, List[RuleConflict]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    unmatched: List[int]                    = field(default_factory=list)
    transactions_by_id: Dict[int, Transaction] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def applied(self) -> int:
        return len(self.assigned) + len(self.conflicts)

    @property
    def summary(self) -> str:
        return (
            f"Asignadas: {len(self.assigned)} | "
            f"Conflictos: {len(self.conflicts)} | "
            f"Sin categoría: {len(self.unmatched)}"
        )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Public API
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def apply_rules(
    session:        Session,
    transaction_ids: List[int],
    user_id:        int,
) -> RulesEngineResult:
    """
    Apply all applicable rules to the given transaction IDs.

    Rules are loaded ordered by priority ASC (lowest = highest priority).
    Global rules (user_id IS NULL) are loaded first, then user-specific
    rules. At equal priority, user rules shadow global rules.

    Parameters
    ----------
    session         : Active SQLAlchemy session.
    transaction_ids : List of transaction primary keys to process.
    user_id         : Authenticated user (for loading per-user rules).

    Returns
    -------
    RulesEngineResult
    """
    result = RulesEngineResult()

    if not transaction_ids:
        return result

    # -- Load rules (global + user-specific), ordered by priority ASC ------
    rules = _load_rules(session, user_id)
    category_by_rule_id = _resolve_rule_categories(session, rules, user_id)
    rules = [rule for rule in rules if rule.id in category_by_rule_id]
    if not rules:
        logger.info("No hay reglas de auto-categorización definidas.")
        result.unmatched = list(transaction_ids)
        return result

    # -- Load transactions ---------------------------------------------------
    transactions = (
        session.query(Transaction)
        .filter(Transaction.id.in_(transaction_ids))
        .all()
    )

    # -- Precompute each rule's lower-cased pattern once, instead of on
    #    every rule x field x transaction comparison. --------------------
    pattern_lower_by_rule_id = {
        rule.id: rule.match_pattern.lower() for rule in rules
    }

    # -- Apply rules to each transaction ------------------------------------
    for txn in transactions:
        _process_transaction(
            txn, rules, result, pattern_lower_by_rule_id, category_by_rule_id
        )

    logger.info(
        "Rules engine completado: %s", result.summary
    )
    result.transactions_by_id = {txn.id: txn for txn in transactions}
    return result


def apply_rules_and_commit(
    session:         Session,
    transaction_ids: List[int],
    user_id:         int,
    overwrite:       bool = False,
) -> RulesEngineResult:
    """
    Apply rules AND persist the assignments to the DB.

    Parameters
    ----------
    overwrite : If True, re-categorize transactions that already have a
                category_id (used when rules are edited/deleted).
                If False (default), only categorize transactions with
                category_id=NULL (used on first import).
                Categories a user set by hand (category_source='manual')
                are never overwritten, in either mode.

    Conflicted and unmatched transactions are left untouched.
    """
    result = apply_rules(session, transaction_ids, user_id)

    # Write assignments, reusing the Transaction objects apply_rules already
    # loaded instead of re-fetching each one individually.
    for txn_id, cat_id in result.assigned.items():
        txn = result.transactions_by_id.get(txn_id)
        if txn is None or txn.category_source == CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL:
            continue
        if overwrite or txn.category_id is None:
            txn.category_id = cat_id
            txn.category_source = CATEGORY_SOURCE_RULE

    session.commit()
    logger.info(
        "Auto-categorización guardada: %d asignaciones (overwrite=%s).",
        len(result.assigned), overwrite,
    )
    return result


def create_rule(
    session:       Session,
    category_id:   int,
    match_pattern: str,
    match_type:    MatchType  = MatchType.contains,
    priority:      int        = 100,
    user_id:       Optional[int] = None,
    transaction_type: Optional[TransactionType] = None,
) -> AutoCategorizationRule:
    """
    Create and persist a new auto-categorization rule.

    Parameters
    ----------
    session       : Active SQLAlchemy session.
    category_id   : Category to assign when this rule matches.
    match_pattern : Pattern string (substring, exact string, or regex).
    match_type    : contains | exact | regex.
    priority      : Lower = higher priority. Default 100.
    user_id       : None = global rule. User ID = per-user rule.
    transaction_type : Only movements of this type match (expense /
                       income). None = any type.

    Returns
    -------
    AutoCategorizationRule (persisted).

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError : If match_pattern is empty, regex is invalid or the
                 movement type is not one of RULE_TRANSACTION_TYPES.
    """
    if not match_pattern or not match_pattern.strip():
        raise ValueError("El patrón de la regla no puede estar vacío.")
    transaction_type = _check_transaction_type(transaction_type)

    if match_type == MatchType.regex:
        try:
            re.compile(match_pattern)
        except re.error as exc:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Expresión regular inválida '{match_pattern}': {exc}"
            ) from exc

    rule = AutoCategorizationRule(
        user_id       = user_id,
        category_id   = category_id,
        match_pattern = match_pattern.strip(),
        match_type    = match_type,
        priority      = priority,
        transaction_type = transaction_type,
    )
    session.add(rule)
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(rule)
    logger.info(
        "Regla creada: id=%d pattern='%s' type=%s priority=%d user=%s movimiento=%s",
        rule.id, rule.match_pattern, rule.match_type.value,
        rule.priority, user_id,
        rule.transaction_type.value if rule.transaction_type else "cualquiera",
    )
    return rule


def delete_rule(session: Session, rule_id: int) -> None:
    """
    Delete an auto-categorization rule by ID.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError : If rule not found.
    """
    rule = session.get(AutoCategorizationRule, rule_id)
    if rule is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Regla con id={rule_id} no encontrada.")
    session.delete(rule)
    session.commit()
    logger.info("Regla id=%d eliminada.", rule_id)


def update_rule(
    session:       Session,
    rule_id:       int,
    category_id:   Optional[int]  = None,
    match_pattern: Optional[str]  = None,
    match_type:    Optional[MatchType] = None,
    priority:      Optional[int]  = None,
    transaction_type = _UNCHANGED,
) -> AutoCategorizationRule:
    """
    Update one or more fields of an existing auto-categorization rule.

    Only non-None arguments are applied — omitted arguments keep their
    current value. transaction_type is the exception, because None means
    "any type": it is only changed when passed.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError : If rule not found, pattern is empty, or regex is invalid.
    """
    rule = session.get(AutoCategorizationRule, rule_id)
    if rule is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Regla con id={rule_id} no encontrada.")

    if match_pattern is not None:
        if not match_pattern.strip():
            raise ValueError("El patrón de la regla no puede estar vacío.")
        rule.match_pattern = match_pattern.strip()

    if match_type is not None:
        # Validate regex before saving
        if match_type == MatchType.regex:
            effective_pattern = match_pattern.strip() if match_pattern else rule.match_pattern
            try:
                re.compile(effective_pattern)
            except re.error as exc:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Expresión regular inválida '{effective_pattern}': {exc}"
                ) from exc
        rule.match_type = match_type

    if category_id is not None:
        rule.category_id = category_id

    if priority is not None:
        rule.priority = priority

    if transaction_type is not _UNCHANGED:
        rule.transaction_type = _check_transaction_type(transaction_type)

    session.commit()
    session.refresh(rule)
    logger.info(
        "Regla actualizada: id=%d pattern='%s' type=%s priority=%d",
        rule.id, rule.match_pattern, rule.match_type.value, rule.priority,
    )
    return rule


def shares_global_rules(session: Session, user_id: int) -> bool:
    """False for the demo account, which is shown to visitors."""
    return session.query(User.id).filter(
        User.id == user_id, func.upper(User.username) == DEMO_USERNAME.upper()
    ).first() is None


def rule_scope(session: Session, user_id: int):
    """Filter for the rules a user sees and gets applied: their own plus the
    family's global ones (only their own for the demo account)."""
    own = AutoCategorizationRule.user_id == user_id
    if not shares_global_rules(session, user_id):
        return own
    return own | AutoCategorizationRule.user_id.is_(None)


def get_all_rules(
    session: Session,
    user_id: Optional[int] = None,
) -> List[AutoCategorizationRule]:
    """
    Return rules ordered by priority ASC.
    If user_id is provided, returns the rules in rule_scope() for that user.
    If user_id is None, returns only global rules.
    """
    query = session.query(AutoCategorizationRule)
    if user_id is not None:
        query = query.filter(rule_scope(session, user_id))
    else:
        query = query.filter(AutoCategorizationRule.user_id == None)  # noqa: E711
    return query.order_by(
        AutoCategorizationRule.priority.asc(),
        AutoCategorizationRule.id.asc(),
    ).all()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Internal helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _check_transaction_type(value) -> Optional[TransactionType]:
    """None or one of RULE_TRANSACTION_TYPES (enum or its value)."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    try:
        value = TransactionType(value)
    except ValueError:
        value = None
    if value not in RULE_TRANSACTION_TYPES:
        raise ValueError("Tipo de movimiento de la regla no válido (gasto, ingreso o cualquiera).")
    return value


def _load_rules(
    session: Session,
    user_id: int,
) -> List[AutoCategorizationRule]:
    """Load global + user-specific rules, ordered by priority ASC."""
    return get_all_rules(session, user_id=user_id)


def _resolve_rule_categories(
    session: Session,
    rules:   List[AutoCategorizationRule],
    user_id: int,
) -> Dict[int, int]:
    """Map each applicable rule id to a category id in user_id's own tree.

    Rules whose category already belongs to the user map to it unchanged.
    Global rules pointing at another user's category map to the category
    with the same name under a type node with the same name; rules with no
    equivalent are left out (never assign another user's category).
    """
    category_ids = {rule.category_id for rule in rules}
    categories = {
        cat.id: cat
        for cat in session.query(Category).filter(Category.id.in_(category_ids))
    } if category_ids else {}

    def key(cat: Category) -> tuple:
        parent_name = cat.parent.name if cat.parent is not None else None
        return (parent_name, cat.name, cat.level)

    foreign = [
        cat for cat in categories.values() if cat.user_id != user_id
    ]
    own_by_key: Dict[tuple, int] = {}
    if foreign:
        wanted_names = {cat.name for cat in foreign}
        for cat in (
            session.query(Category)
            .filter(Category.user_id == user_id, Category.name.in_(wanted_names))
        ):
            own_by_key.setdefault(key(cat), cat.id)

    resolved: Dict[int, int] = {}
    for rule in rules:
        cat = categories.get(rule.category_id)
        if cat is None:
            continue
        if cat.user_id == user_id:
            resolved[rule.id] = cat.id
        elif rule.user_id is None and key(cat) in own_by_key:
            resolved[rule.id] = own_by_key[key(cat)]
        else:
            logger.debug(
                "Regla id=%d omitida para user_id=%d: sin categoría equivalente.",
                rule.id, user_id,
            )
    return resolved


def _match(
    rule:        AutoCategorizationRule,
    value:       Optional[str],
    value_lower: Optional[str],
    pattern_lower: str,
) -> bool:
    """
    Test a single (pre-lowercased) field value against a rule's pattern.
    Returns True if the pattern matches, False otherwise.

    `value_lower`/`pattern_lower` are precomputed by the caller (once per
    transaction / once per rule respectively) instead of being lower-cased
    again on every rule x field combination.
    """
    if not value_lower:
        return False

    if rule.match_type == MatchType.contains:
        return pattern_lower in value_lower

    elif rule.match_type == MatchType.exact:
        return value_lower == pattern_lower

    elif rule.match_type == MatchType.regex:
        try:
            return bool(re.search(rule.match_pattern, value, re.IGNORECASE))
        except re.error:
            logger.warning(
                "Regex inválida en regla id=%d: '%s'", rule.id, rule.match_pattern
            )
            return False

    return False


def _match_transaction(
    rule:          AutoCategorizationRule,
    txn:           Transaction,
    issuer_lower:  Optional[str],
    concept_lower: Optional[str],
    pattern_lower: str,
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Test a rule against a transaction using OR gate on issuer_name + concept.

    Returns
    -------
    str  : 'issuer_name' | 'concept' | 'both' if matched.
    None : if no match.
    """
    hit_issuer  = _match(rule, txn.issuer_name, issuer_lower, pattern_lower)
    hit_concept = _match(rule, txn.concept, concept_lower, pattern_lower)

    if hit_issuer and hit_concept:
        return "both"
    elif hit_issuer:
        return "issuer_name"
    elif hit_concept:
        return "concept"
    return None


def _process_transaction(
    txn:            Transaction,
    rules:          List[AutoCategorizationRule],
    result:         RulesEngineResult,
    pattern_lower_by_rule_id: Dict[int, str],
    category_by_rule_id: Dict[int, int],
) -> None:
    """
    Apply all rules to a single transaction and update result in-place.

    Logic:
    - Iterate rules in priority order (already sorted ASC).
    - First match at priority P assigns the transaction.
    - If a SECOND rule at the SAME priority P also matches and maps to a
      DIFFERENT category → conflict flagged, no auto-assignment.
    - Once a priority level produces a match (assign or conflict),
      lower-priority rules are ignored.
    """
    best_priority:  Optional[int]  = None
    best_rule:      Optional[AutoCategorizationRule] = None
    best_field:     Optional[str]  = None
    conflict_rules: List[tuple]    = []  # (rule, field_matched)

    issuer_lower  = txn.issuer_name.lower() if txn.issuer_name else None
    concept_lower = txn.concept.lower() if txn.concept else None

    for rule in rules:
        if rule.transaction_type is not None and rule.transaction_type != txn.type:
            continue
        field_hit = _match_transaction(
            rule, txn, issuer_lower, concept_lower,
            pattern_lower_by_rule_id[rule.id],
        )
        if field_hit is None:
            continue

        if best_priority is None:
            # First match
            best_priority = rule.priority
            best_rule     = rule
            best_field    = field_hit
            conflict_rules = [(rule, field_hit)]

        elif rule.priority == best_priority:
            # Same priority level — potential conflict
            if category_by_rule_id[rule.id] != category_by_rule_id[best_rule.id]:
                conflict_rules.append((rule, field_hit))

        else:
            # Lower priority (higher number) — stop searching
            break

    if not conflict_rules:
        # No match at all
        result.unmatched.append(txn.id)

    elif len(conflict_rules) == 1:
        # Single winner — assign
        result.assigned[txn.id] = category_by_rule_id[best_rule.id]
        result.assigned_by_rule[best_rule.id] = (
            result.assigned_by_rule.get(best_rule.id, 0) + 1
        )
        result.transaction_ids_by_rule.setdefault(best_rule.id, []).append(
            txn.id
        )

    else:
        # Multiple rules at same priority, different categories → conflict
        conflicts = []
        first_rule, first_field = conflict_rules[0]
        for other_rule, other_field in conflict_rules[1:]:
            conflicts.append(RuleConflict(
                transaction_id = txn.id,
                rule_a_id      = first_rule.id,
                rule_b_id      = other_rule.id,
                category_a_id  = category_by_rule_id[first_rule.id],
                category_b_id  = category_by_rule_id[other_rule.id],
                priority       = best_priority,
                field_matched  = other_field,
                pattern_a      = first_rule.match_pattern,
                pattern_b      = other_rule.match_pattern,
            ))
        result.conflicts[txn.id] = conflicts
        logger.warning(
            "Conflicto de reglas para transacción id=%d: "
            "%d reglas coinciden en prioridad=%d",
            txn.id, len(conflict_rules), best_priority,
        )
```

```python
"""
app/gui/main_window.py
=======================
FAMILYFIN — Main Application Shell

Layout:
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  TOP BAR  (logo | breadcrumb | user | theme toggle) │
  ├──────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │          │                                          │
  │ SIDEBAR  │           CONTENT AREA                  │
  │ (nav     │     (swapped by nav selection)          │
  │  tree)   │                                          │
  │          │                                          │
  └──────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────┘
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Optional

from PySide6.QtCore    import Qt, QSettings, QSize, QTimer, QUrl
from PySide6.QtGui     import QDesktopServices, QFont, QIcon
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QPushButton, QFrame, QStackedWidget, QSizePolicy,
    QScrollArea, QApplication, QMessageBox, QDialog,
)
import qtawesome as qta

from app.auth.account_rules import is_demo_name
from app.config      import APP_NAME, APP_VERSION, THEMES, NAV_ITEMS, NAV_ITEMS_TOP, NAV_ITEMS_BOTTOM
from app.db.models   import User
from app.manual      import MANUAL_INDEX
from app.settings    import SettingsManager
from sqlalchemy.orm  import Session


class _NavButton(QPushButton):
    """Sidebar navigation button."""

    def __init__(self, label: str, icon_name: str,
                 view_key: str, theme: dict) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.view_key  = view_key
        self._label    = label
        self._icon_name = icon_name
        self._active   = False

        self.setFixedHeight(44)
        self.setCheckable(False)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding,
                           QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed)
        self.setFlat(True)
        self._refresh(theme)

    def set_active(self, active: bool, theme: dict) -> None:
        self._active = active
        self._refresh(theme)

    def _refresh(self, theme: dict) -> None:
        colour = (theme["text_sidebar_active"]
                  if self._active else theme["text_sidebar"])
        bg     = (f"background-color: {theme['bg_sidebar_hover']};"
                  if self._active else "background-color: transparent;")
        border = (f"border-left: 3px solid {theme['accent']};"
                  if self._active else "border-left: 3px solid transparent;")

        self.setIcon(qta.icon(self._icon_name, color=colour))
        self.setIconSize(QSize(20, 20))
        self.setText(f"  {self._label}")
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QPushButton {{
                {bg}
                {border}
                color: {colour};
                text-align: left;
                padding: 0 16px;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: {"600" if self._active else "400"};
                border-radius: 0px;
            }}
            QPushButton:hover {{
                background-color: {theme["bg_sidebar_hover"]};
            }}
        """)


class MainWindow(QWidget):
    """
    Main application window — fullscreen shell with sidebar navigation.
    """

    SETTINGS_ORG = "FAMILYFIN"
    SETTINGS_APP = "FAMILYFIN"
    KEY_THEME    = "ui/theme"
    KEY_NAV      = "ui/last_nav"
    AUTO_BACKUP_CHECK_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000

    def __init__(self, user: User, session: Session,
                 theme: str = "light") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._user    = user
        self._session = session
        stored_settings = SettingsManager().load()
        default_theme = stored_settings.theme if stored_settings.save_appearance_on_start else "light"
        selected_theme = theme if theme != "light" else default_theme
        self._theme   = selected_theme if selected_theme in THEMES else "light"
        self._t       = THEMES[self._theme]
        self._settings = QSettings(self.SETTINGS_ORG, self.SETTINGS_APP)
        self._nav_btns: dict[str, _NavButton] = {}
        self._current_view = ""
        self._stale_views: set[str] = set()

        self.setWindowTitle(f"{APP_NAME}  v{APP_VERSION}")
        self.setWindowFlag(Qt.WindowType.FramelessWindowHint)
        self.showMaximized()

        self._build_ui()
        self._apply_theme()

        # Navigate to last view or default dashboard
        last_nav = self._settings.value(self.KEY_NAV, "dashboard")
        self._navigate(last_nav)

        # Automatic backups: check now, then periodically while the app runs.
        self._auto_backup_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._auto_backup_timer.setInterval(self.AUTO_BACKUP_CHECK_MS)
        self._auto_backup_timer.timeout.connect(self._run_auto_backup)
        self._auto_backup_timer.start()
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._run_auto_backup)

        # Changes made from the LAN web front-end (queued from its thread).
        from app.gui.web_bridge import web_bridge
        web_bridge().data_changed.connect(self._on_web_data_changed)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI construction
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        root.setSpacing(0)

        # ── Top bar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        self._top_bar = self._make_top_bar()
        root.addWidget(self._top_bar)

        # ── Body (sidebar + content) ───────────────────────────────────
        body = QWidget()
        body_layout = QHBoxLayout(body)
        body_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        body_layout.setSpacing(0)

        self._sidebar   = self._make_sidebar()
        self._stack     = QStackedWidget()
        self._stack.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding,
                                   QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding)

        body_layout.addWidget(self._sidebar)
        body_layout.addWidget(self._stack)
        root.addWidget(body)

        # ── Populate stacked views ─────────────────────────────────────
        self._views: dict[str, QWidget] = {}
        self._register_views()

    def _make_top_bar(self) -> QFrame:
        """
        Minimal modern top bar:
        [☰] [● FAMILYFIN  v0.1.x] ── [breadcrumb] ──────── [Pedro ▾] [🌙] [⏻]
        Height: 48px. Single accent-colored bottom border. No visual clutter.
        """
        bar = QFrame()
        bar.setFixedHeight(48)

        # ── Drag support for frameless window ─────────────────────────
        bar._drag_pos = None

        def _bar_mouse_press(e):
            if e.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                bar._drag_pos = (
                    e.globalPosition().toPoint() - self.frameGeometry().topLeft()
                )
        def _bar_mouse_move(e):
            if bar._drag_pos and e.buttons() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                if self.isMaximized():
                    self.showNormal()
                    bar._drag_pos = (
                        e.globalPosition().toPoint() - self.frameGeometry().topLeft()
                    )
                self.move(e.globalPosition().toPoint() - bar._drag_pos)
        def _bar_mouse_release(e):
            bar._drag_pos = None
        def _bar_double_click(e):
            self._toggle_maximize()

        bar.mousePressEvent   = _bar_mouse_press
        bar.mouseMoveEvent    = _bar_mouse_move
        bar.mouseReleaseEvent = _bar_mouse_release
        bar.mouseDoubleClickEvent = _bar_double_click

        return bar

    def _register_views(self) -> None:
        """Register a factory per view; each widget is built on first visit.

        Building every view at login ran all of their DB queries up front.
        Views are now created (with the theme current at that moment) the
        first time the user navigates to them, then kept in the stack.
        """
        from app.gui.dashboard         import DashboardView
        from app.gui.import_view       import ImportView
        from app.gui.transactions_view import TransactionsView
        from app.gui.categories_view   import CategoriesView
        from app.gui.rules_view        import RulesView
        from app.gui.expenses_view     import ExpensesView
        from app.gui.incomes_window    import IncomesWindow
        from app.gui.investments_view  import InvestmentsView
        from app.gui.settings_view      import SettingsView

        self._view_factories = {
            "dashboard":    lambda: DashboardView(
                                self._user, self._session, self._theme
                            ),
            "expenses":     lambda: ExpensesView(
                                self._session, self._user, self._theme
                            ),
            "income":       lambda: IncomesWindow(
                                self._user, self._session, self._theme
                            ),
            "investments":  lambda: InvestmentsView(
                                self._user, self._session, self._theme
                            ),
            "transactions": lambda: TransactionsView(
                                self._user, self._session, self._theme
                            ),
            "import":       lambda: ImportView(
                                self._user, self._session, self._theme
                            ),
            "categories":   lambda: CategoriesView(
                                self._user, self._session, self._theme
                            ),
            "rules":        lambda: RulesView(
                                self._user, self._session, self._theme
                            ),
            "forecast":     lambda: _PlaceholderView(
                                "Previsiones",
                                "mdi.calendar-clock-outline", self._t
                            ),
            "export":       lambda: _PlaceholderView(
                                "Exportar", "mdi.download-outline", self._t
                            ),
            "settings":     lambda: SettingsView(
                                self._user, self._session, self._theme
                            ),
        }


    def _ensure_view(self, view_key: str) -> QWidget:
        """Return the view for view_key, building it on first use."""
        widget = self._views.get(view_key)
        if widget is None:
            widget = self._view_factories[view_key]()
            self._stack.addWidget(widget)
            self._views[view_key] = widget
        return widget

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Navigation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _navigate(self, view_key: str) -> None:
        if view_key not in self._view_factories:
            view_key = "dashboard"

        # Update sidebar active state
        if self._current_view and self._current_view in self._nav_btns:
            self._nav_btns[self._current_view].set_active(False, self._t)
        if view_key in self._nav_btns:
            self._nav_btns[view_key].set_active(True, self._t)

        # Update breadcrumb
        label = next(
            (lbl for lbl, _, k in NAV_ITEMS if k == view_key),
            view_key.capitalize()
        )
        self._lbl_breadcrumb.setText(label)

        self._stack.setCurrentWidget(self._ensure_view(view_key))
        self._current_view = view_key
        if view_key in self._stale_views:
            self._reload_view(view_key)
        self._settings.setValue(self.KEY_NAV, view_key)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Web front-end changes
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    _RELOAD_METHODS = ("refresh_data", "refresh", "reload", "_load_data")

    def _on_web_data_changed(self, user_id: int, area: str) -> None:
        """Someone changed this user's data from a phone: drop the cached ORM
        state and reload the visible view; the others reload on next visit.
        «account»: renamed (or new password) from the web → show the new name;
        «account_deleted»: this account was deleted from the web → back to login."""
        if user_id != self._user.id:
            return
        if area == "account_deleted":
            self._on_account_deleted_from_web()
            return
        try:
            self._session.expire_all()
        except Exception:
            logging.getLogger(__name__).exception("Web: no se pudo refrescar la sesión")
            return
        if area == "account":
            self._refresh_username()
            return
        self._stale_views = set(self._views)
        if self._current_view in self._views:
            self._reload_view(self._current_view)

    def _refresh_username(self) -> None:
        from app.db.models import User as UserModel
        fresh = self._session.get(UserModel, self._user.id)
        if fresh is None:
            return
        old_name = self._user.username
        self._user = fresh
        name = fresh.username
        for label in (getattr(self, "_lbl_user", None), getattr(self, "_lbl_sidebar_name", None)):
            if label is not None:
                label.setText(name.capitalize())
        for label in (getattr(self, "_lbl_top_avatar", None), getattr(self, "_lbl_sidebar_avatar", None)):
            if label is not None:
                label.setText(name[:2].upper())
        if old_name != name and self._settings.value("auth/last_username", "", type=str) == old_name:
            self._settings.setValue("auth/last_username", name)

    def _on_account_deleted_from_web(self) -> None:
        self._settings.remove("auth/last_username")
        QMessageBox.information(
            self, "Cuenta borrada",
            "Esta cuenta se ha borrado desde la web. Se guardó una copia de seguridad "
            "en la carpeta de copias de este PC.",
        )
        self._on_logout()

    def _reload_view(self, view_key: str) -> None:
        self._stale_views.discard(view_key)
        view = self._views.get(view_key)
        for name in self._RELOAD_METHODS:
            method = getattr(view, name, None)
            if callable(method):
                try:
                    method()
                except Exception:
                    logging.getLogger(__name__).exception("Web: recarga de la vista %s", view_key)
                return

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        # Views with background threads (Inversiones price refresh, Yahoo
        # lookups) must let them finish: destroying a running QThread aborts.
        from app.gui._background import wait_for_background_threads
        for view in self._views.values():
            if hasattr(view, "shutdown"):
                view.shutdown()
        wait_for_background_threads()
        super().closeEvent(event)

    def _toggle_maximize(self) -> None:
        if self.isMaximized():
            self.showNormal()
            self._btn_maximize.setIcon(
                qta.icon("mdi.crop-square", color=self._t["text_secondary"])
            )
            self._btn_maximize.setToolTip("Maximizar")
        else:
            self.showMaximized()
            self._btn_maximize.setIcon(
                qta.icon("mdi.window-restore", color=self._t["text_secondary"])
            )
            self._btn_maximize.setToolTip("Restaurar")

    def _toggle_sidebar(self) -> None:
        visible = self._sidebar.isVisible()
        self._sidebar.setVisible(not visible)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Theme
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _open_manual(self) -> None:
        if not MANUAL_INDEX.is_file():
            logging.getLogger(__name__).warning("Manual no encontrado: %s", MANUAL_INDEX)
            return
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(MANUAL_INDEX)))

    def _toggle_theme(self) -> None:
        self._theme = "dark" if self._theme == "light" else "light"
        self._t     = THEMES[self._theme]
        self._settings.setValue(self.KEY_THEME, self._theme)
        self._apply_theme()

        # Propagate theme to ALL registered views
        for key, view in self._views.items():
            # DashboardView uses refresh_theme(str)
            if hasattr(view, "refresh_theme"):
                view.refresh_theme(self._theme)
            # TransactionsView, ExpensesView, CategoriesView,
            # RulesView, ImportView use apply_theme(str)
            elif hasattr(view, "apply_theme"):
                view.apply_theme(self._theme)

    def _apply_theme(self) -> None:
        t = self._t
        is_dark = self._theme == "dark"

        icon_color = t["text_primary"]
        self._btn_menu.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.menu", color=t["text_sidebar_active"])
        )
        self._btn_menu.setIconSize(QSize(22, 22))

        theme_icon = ("mdi.weather-night"
                      if self._theme == "light" else "mdi.weather-sunny")
        self._btn_theme.setIcon(qta.icon(theme_icon, color=icon_color))
        self._btn_theme.setIconSize(QSize(20, 20))

        self._btn_help.setIcon(qta.icon("mdi.help-circle-outline", color=icon_color))
        self._btn_help.setIconSize(QSize(20, 20))

        self._btn_logout.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.logout", color=icon_color)
        )
        self._btn_logout.setIconSize(QSize(20, 20))

        self._btn_account.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.dots-vertical", color=self._t["text_sidebar"])
        )
        self._btn_account.setIconSize(QSize(16, 16))

        # Refresh nav buttons
        for key, btn in self._nav_btns.items():
            btn._refresh(t)

        # Refresh logo icon (accent color changes with theme)
        self._lbl_topbar_logo.setPixmap(
            qta.icon("mdi.chart-areaspline",
                     color=t["accent"]).pixmap(26, 26)
        )

        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QWidget {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-family: "Segoe UI";
                font-size: 13px;
            }}
            /* Labels show their parent (cards, bars) unless they set a colour. */
            QLabel {{ background: transparent; }}
                        QPushButton#wctrlMin:hover,
            QPushButton#wctrlMax:hover {{
                background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
                border-radius: 6px;
            }}
            QPushButton#wctrlClose:hover {{
                background-color: #EF4444;
                border-radius: 6px;
            }}
            QPushButton#wctrlClose:hover {{
                /* icon color via setIcon no cambia con CSS — ok */
            }}
            QFrame#topBarSepV {{
                color: {t["border"]};
                background-color: {t["border"]};
                max-width: 1px;
            }}
            QFrame#topBar {{
                background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0,
                    stop:0 {t["bg_secondary"]},
                    stop:1 {t["bg_primary"]});
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
            }}
            QLabel#topBarBrand {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 700;
            }}
            QLabel#topBarVersion {{
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 400;
            }}
            QLabel#breadcrumb {{
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
            }}
            QLabel#topBarAvatar {{
                background-color: {t["accent"]};
                color: #FFFFFF;
                border-radius: 13px;
                font-size: 10px;
                font-weight: 700;
            }}
            QLabel#topBarUsername {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
                font-weight: 600;
            }}
            QFrame#sidebar {{
                background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:1,
                    stop:0 {t["bg_sidebar"]},
                    stop:1 {t["bg_sidebar"]});
                border-right: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QFrame#sidebarUserCard {{
                background-color: {t["bg_sidebar_card"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["bg_sidebar_hover"]};

            }}
            QLabel#avatarCircle {{
                background-color: {t["accent"]};
                color: #FFFFFF;

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Slots
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _run_auto_backup(self) -> None:
        """Create an automatic backup if one is due. Never interrupts the user."""
        try:
            SettingsManager().run_auto_backup_if_due(user_name=self._user.username)
        except Exception:
            logging.getLogger(__name__).exception(
                "No se pudo crear la copia de seguridad automática."
            )

    def _on_logout(self) -> None:
        self._session.close()
        from app.gui.login_window import LoginWindow
        self._login = LoginWindow()
        self._login.show()
        self.close()

    def _on_account_settings(self) -> None:
        """Open account settings dialog with delete account option."""
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QDialogButtonBox

        t = self._t

        dlg = QDialog(self)
        dlg.setWindowTitle("Configuración de cuenta")
        dlg.setFixedWidth(380)
        dlg.setModal(True)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
        layout.setContentsMargins(28, 28, 28, 28)
        layout.setSpacing(16)

        # Header — avatar + username
        header = QHBoxLayout()
        lbl_av = QLabel(self._user.username[:2].upper())
        lbl_av.setFixedSize(48, 48)
        lbl_av.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_av.setStyleSheet(f"""
            background-color: {t["accent"]};
            color: #FFFFFF;
            border-radius: 24px;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
        """)
        header.addWidget(lbl_av)
        header.addSpacing(12)

        info = QVBoxLayout()
        lbl_uname = QLabel(self._user.username.capitalize())
        lbl_uname.setStyleSheet(
            f"font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: {t['text_primary']};"
        )
        lbl_joined = QLabel(
            f"Cuenta creada: "
            f"{self._user.created_at.strftime('%d %b %Y')}"
            if self._user.created_at else "Cuenta activa"
        )
        lbl_joined.setStyleSheet(
            f"font-size: 11px; color: {t['text_secondary']};"
        )
        info.addWidget(lbl_uname)
        info.addWidget(lbl_joined)
        header.addLayout(info)
        header.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(header)

        # Separator
        sep = QFrame()
        sep.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.HLine)
        sep.setStyleSheet(f"color: {t['border']};")
        layout.addWidget(sep)

        # Password / name (same rules as the web «Mi cuenta»)
        def _account_button(text: str, icon: str, slot) -> QPushButton:
            btn = QPushButton(f"  {text}")
            btn.setIcon(qta.icon(icon, color=t["text_primary"]))
            btn.setFixedHeight(40)
            btn.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
            btn.setStyleSheet(f"""
                QPushButton {{
                    background-color: transparent;
                    color: {t["text_primary"]};
                    border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                    border-radius: 8px;
                    font-size: 13px;
                    padding: 0 16px;
                    text-align: left;
                }}
                QPushButton:hover {{ background-color: {t["bg_hover"]}; }}
            """)

            def _clicked() -> None:
                dlg.accept()
                slot()
            btn.clicked.connect(_clicked)
            layout.addWidget(btn)
            return btn

        self._btn_change_password = _account_button(
            "Cambiar contraseña", "mdi.lock-reset", self._on_change_password)
        if not is_demo_name(self._user.username):
            _account_button("Cambiar nombre de usuario", "mdi.account-edit-outline",
                            self._on_rename_account)
            _account_button("Exportar mis datos…", "mdi.download-outline",
                            self._on_export_my_data)

        # Delete account button
        btn_delete = QPushButton(
            "  Eliminar cuenta permanentemente"
        )
        btn_delete.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.account-remove-outline", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        btn_delete.setFixedHeight(42)
        btn_delete.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_delete.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QPushButton {{
                background-color: {t["expense"]};
                color: #FFFFFF;
                border: none;
                border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 600;
                padding: 0 16px;
                text-align: left;
            }}
            QPushButton:hover {{
                background-color: #B91C1C;
            }}
        """)
        layout.addWidget(btn_delete)

        lbl_warn = QLabel(
            "Se eliminarán todos tus datos: transacciones, cuentas,\n"
            "categorías y reglas. Esta acción no se puede deshacer."
        )
        lbl_warn.setStyleSheet(
            f"font-size: 11px; color: {t['text_secondary']};"
        )
        lbl_warn.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(lbl_warn)

        # Close button
        sep2 = QFrame()
        sep2.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.HLine)
        sep2.setStyleSheet(f"color: {t['border']};")
        layout.addWidget(sep2)

        btn_close = QPushButton("Cerrar")
        btn_close.setFixedHeight(38)
        btn_close.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_close.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QPushButton {{
                background-color: transparent;
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px;
            }}
            QPushButton:hover {{
                background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
            }}
        """)
        btn_close.clicked.connect(dlg.reject)
        layout.addWidget(btn_close)

        dlg.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QDialog {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
            }}
        """)

        def _on_delete_clicked() -> None:
            dlg.accept()
            self._confirm_delete_account()

        btn_delete.clicked.connect(_on_delete_clicked)
        dlg.exec()

    def _audit_account(self, new: str, old: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        from app.db.models import AuditAction, AuditLog
        try:
            self._session.add(AuditLog(
                user_id=self._user.id, table_affected="users", record_id=self._user.id,
                action=AuditAction.update, old_value=old, new_value=f"{new} [PC]",
            ))
            self._session.commit()
        except Exception:
            self._session.rollback()
            logging.getLogger(__name__).exception("No se pudo escribir en audit_log")

    def _on_change_password(self) -> None:
        from app.gui.account_dialogs import ChangePasswordDialog
        from app.web.server import get_web_server

        dlg = ChangePasswordDialog(self._session, self._user.id, self._t, self)
        if dlg.exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
            return
        # Like the web: a new password ends the sessions opened with the old one.
        closed = get_web_server().sessions.revoke_user(self._user.id)
        self._audit_account(f"contraseña cambiada; {closed} sesiones web cerradas")
        logging.getLogger(__name__).info(
            "PC: '%s' cambió su contraseña (%d sesiones web cerradas)", self._user.username, closed)
        message = "Tu contraseña se ha cambiado."
        if closed:
            message += (f"\n\nSe cerró la sesión en la web de {closed} dispositivo"
                        f"{'s' if closed != 1 else ''}: vuelve a entrar con la nueva contraseña.")
        QMessageBox.information(self, "Contraseña cambiada", message)

    def _on_rename_account(self) -> None:
        from app.gui.account_dialogs import RenameDialog
        from app.web.server import get_web_server

        dlg = RenameDialog(self._session, self._user.id, self._t, self)
        if dlg.exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted or dlg.names is None:
            return
        old, new = dlg.names
        get_web_server().sessions.rename_user(self._user.id, new)
        get_web_server().invites.rename_member(self._user.id, new)
        self._audit_account(f"«{new}»", old=f"«{old}»")
        self._refresh_username()
        logging.getLogger(__name__).info("PC: '%s' se renombró a '%s'", old, new)
        QMessageBox.information(self, "Nombre cambiado",
                                f"Ahora tu usuario es «{new}». Úsalo para entrar en el PC y en la web.")

    def _on_export_my_data(self) -> None:
        """Only this user's data (Excel + categories library), never the
        family backup: the same zip as «Descargar mis datos» on the web."""
        from pathlib import Path
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFileDialog
        from app.settings.user_export import export_filename, export_user_data

        default = Path.home() / "Documents" / export_filename(self._user.username)
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self, "Exportar mis datos", str(default), "Archivo ZIP (*.zip)")
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            self._session.expire_all()
            export = export_user_data(self._session, self._user.id)
            Path(path).write_bytes(export.data)
        except Exception:
            logging.getLogger(__name__).exception("No se pudieron exportar los datos")
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Exportar mis datos",
                                "No se pudieron exportar tus datos. No se ha guardado nada.")
            return
        self._audit_account(f"exportó sus datos: {export.describe()}")
        QMessageBox.information(
            self, "Datos exportados",
            f"Se han guardado tus datos ({export.describe()}) en:\n{path}\n\n"
            "Es una exportación para guardar o abrir con Excel, no una copia de seguridad.")

    def _confirm_delete_account(self) -> None:
        """
        Two-step confirmation dialog before permanently deleting the account.
        Step 1: Warning + confirm button.
        Step 2: Type username to confirm.
        """
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QLineEdit

        t = self._t
        username = self._user.username

        dlg = QDialog(self)
        dlg.setWindowTitle("Confirmar eliminación de cuenta")
        dlg.setFixedWidth(420)
        dlg.setModal(True)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
        layout.setContentsMargins(28, 28, 28, 28)
        layout.setSpacing(14)

        # Warning icon + title
        lbl_icon = QLabel()
        lbl_icon.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_icon.setPixmap(
            qta.icon("mdi.alert-circle-outline",
                     color=t["expense"]).pixmap(48, 48)
        )
        layout.addWidget(lbl_icon)

        lbl_title = QLabel("¿Eliminar cuenta definitivamente?")
        lbl_title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_title.setStyleSheet(
            f"font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: {t['text_primary']};"
        )
        layout.addWidget(lbl_title)

        lbl_msg = QLabel(
            f"Vas a eliminar la cuenta <b>{username}</b> y "
            f"<b>todos sus datos</b>.\n\n"
            "Antes se guardará una copia de seguridad en la carpeta de copias de este PC.\n\n"
            f"Para confirmar, escribe tu nombre de usuario y tu contraseña:"
        )
        lbl_msg.setWordWrap(True)
        lbl_msg.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_msg.setStyleSheet(
            f"font-size: 12px; color: {t['text_secondary']};"
        )
        layout.addWidget(lbl_msg)

        inp_confirm = QLineEdit()
        inp_confirm.setPlaceholderText(f"Escribe «{username}» para confirmar")
        inp_confirm.setFixedHeight(42)
        inp_confirm.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        inp_confirm.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QLineEdit {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
                border: 2px solid {t["expense"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 8px 12px;
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 13px;
            }}
            QLineEdit:focus {{
                border: 2px solid #B91C1C;
            }}
        """)
        layout.addWidget(inp_confirm)

        inp_password = QLineEdit()
        inp_password.setPlaceholderText("Tu contraseña")
        inp_password.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
        inp_password.setFixedHeight(42)
        inp_password.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        inp_password.setStyleSheet(inp_confirm.styleSheet())
        layout.addWidget(inp_password)

        # Error label
        lbl_err = QLabel("")
        lbl_err.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_err.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {t['expense']}; font-size: 11px;"
        )
        lbl_err.setVisible(False)
        layout.addWidget(lbl_err)

        # Buttons row
        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_row.setSpacing(10)

        btn_cancel = QPushButton("Cancelar")
        btn_cancel.setFixedHeight(40)
        btn_cancel.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_cancel.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QPushButton {{
                background-color: transparent;
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px;
            }}
            QPushButton:hover {{ background-color: {t["bg_hover"]}; }}
        """)
        btn_cancel.clicked.connect(dlg.reject)

        btn_confirm = QPushButton("  Eliminar cuenta")
        btn_confirm.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.delete-forever-outline", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        btn_confirm.setFixedHeight(40)
        btn_confirm.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_confirm.setEnabled(False)   # disabled until username matches
        btn_confirm.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QPushButton {{
                background-color: {t["expense"]};
                color: #FFFFFF;
                border: none;
                border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 600;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton:hover {{ background-color: #B91C1C; }}
            QPushButton:disabled {{
                background-color: {t["border"]};
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
            }}
        """)

        btn_row.addWidget(btn_cancel)
        btn_row.addWidget(btn_confirm)
        layout.addLayout(btn_row)

        dlg.setStyleSheet(f"QDialog {{ background-color: {t['bg_secondary']}; }}")

        # Enable confirm button only when username matches exactly
        def _on_text_changed(_text: str = "") -> None:
            btn_confirm.setEnabled(
                inp_confirm.text().strip() == username and bool(inp_password.text())
            )
            lbl_err.setVisible(False)

        inp_confirm.textChanged.connect(_on_text_changed)
        inp_password.textChanged.connect(_on_text_changed)
        inp_confirm.returnPressed.connect(inp_password.setFocus)
        inp_password.returnPressed.connect(
            lambda: btn_confirm.click() if btn_confirm.isEnabled() else None
        )

        def _do_delete() -> None:
            from app.auth.account_service import AccountError, delete_user

            # Shared with the web «Borrar mi cuenta»: checks the name and the
            # password, refuses while family rules depend on this user's
            # categories, takes a backup first (nothing is deleted if it
            # fails) and leaves an audit row that survives the cascade.
            try:
                self._session.expire_all()
                backup = delete_user(
                    self._session, self._user.id, inp_password.text(), inp_confirm.text(),
                    backup=lambda: SettingsManager().backup_before_delete(username),
                    source="el PC",
                )
            except AccountError as exc:
                lbl_err.setText(exc.message)
                lbl_err.setVisible(True)
                if exc.field == "password":
                    inp_password.clear()
                    inp_password.setFocus()
                return
            except Exception:
                self._session.rollback()
                logging.getLogger(__name__).exception("No se pudo borrar la cuenta")
                lbl_err.setText("No se pudo borrar la cuenta. No se ha cambiado nada.")
                lbl_err.setVisible(True)
                return

            # Its web sessions and invitations die with it.
            from app.web.server import get_web_server
            get_web_server().sessions.revoke_user(self._user.id)
            get_web_server().invites.revoke_by(self._user.id)
            logging.getLogger(__name__).info("Copia previa al borrado: %s", backup)

            dlg.accept()

            # Clear last user from settings and return to login
            from PySide6.QtCore import QSettings
            settings = QSettings("FAMILYFIN", "FAMILYFIN")
            settings.remove("auth/last_username")

            self._session.close()

            from app.gui.login_window import LoginWindow
            self._login = LoginWindow()
            self._login.show()
            self.close()

        btn_confirm.clicked.connect(_do_delete)
        dlg.exec()
```
