```python
        # Selected info
        self._lbl_selected = QLabel("Selecciona una categoría")
        self._lbl_selected.setObjectName("selectedInfo")

        layout.addSpacing(8)

        # Add subcategory
        self._btn_add_sub = QPushButton("  Añadir subcategoría")
        self._btn_add_sub.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.plus", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        self._btn_add_sub.setFixedHeight(38)
        self._btn_add_sub.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        self._btn_add_sub.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._btn_add_sub.setEnabled(False)
        self._btn_add_sub.clicked.connect(self._on_add_sub)
        layout.addWidget(self._btn_add_sub)

        # Rename
        self._btn_rename = QPushButton("  Renombrar")
        self._btn_rename.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.pencil-outline",
                     color=self._t["text_secondary"])
        )
        self._btn_rename.setFixedHeight(38)
        self._btn_rename.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        self._btn_rename.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._btn_rename.setEnabled(False)
        self._btn_rename.clicked.connect(self._on_rename)
        layout.addWidget(self._btn_rename)

        # Delete
        self._btn_delete = QPushButton("  Eliminar")
        self._btn_delete.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.delete-outline", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        self._btn_delete.setFixedHeight(38)
        self._btn_delete.setObjectName("btnDanger")
        self._btn_delete.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._btn_delete.setEnabled(False)
        self._btn_delete.clicked.connect(self._on_delete)
        layout.addWidget(self._btn_delete)

        layout.addStretch()

        return panel

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Data loading
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self._tree_model.clear()
        self._cat_id_map: dict = {}  # item -> category_id

        types = get_all_categories(
            self._session, self._user.id, level=CategoryLevel.type
        )
        cats  = get_all_categories(
            self._session, self._user.id, level=CategoryLevel.category
        )

        # Group categories by parent_id
        by_parent: dict = {}
        for cat in cats:
            by_parent.setdefault(cat.parent_id, []).append(cat)

        type_icons = {
            "GASTO":          ("mdi.trending-down",  self._t["expense"]),
            "INGRESO":        ("mdi.trending-up",    self._t["income"]),
            "INVERSION":      ("mdi.chart-line",     self._t["investment"]),
            "SERV. BANCARIO": ("mdi.bank-outline",   self._t["accent"]),
        }

        for type_node in types:
            icon_name, color = type_icons.get(
                type_node.name,
                ("mdi.tag-outline", self._t["accent"])
            )
            type_item = QStandardItem(
                qta.icon(icon_name, color=color), type_node.name
            )
            type_item.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 12, QFont.Weight.Bold))
            type_item.setData(type_node.id, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            type_item.setData("type", Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole + 1)
            self._tree_model.appendRow(type_item)

            for cat in by_parent.get(type_node.id, []):
                cat_item = QStandardItem(
                    qta.icon("mdi.tag-outline",
                             color=self._t["text_secondary"]),
                    cat.name
                )
                cat_item.setData(cat.id, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                cat_item.setData("category", Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole + 1)
                type_item.appendRow(cat_item)

        self._tree.collapseAll()
        self._btn_add_sub.setEnabled(False)
        self._btn_rename.setEnabled(False)
        self._btn_delete.setEnabled(False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Slots
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_selection_changed(self, current, previous) -> None:
        item = self._tree_model.itemFromIndex(current)
        if item is None:
            return

        level    = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole + 1)
        cat_name = item.text()

        self._lbl_selected.setText(
            f"<b>{cat_name}</b><br>"
            f"<small>Nivel: {level or '—'}</small>"
        )

        is_type     = level == "type"
        is_category = level == "category"

        self._btn_add_sub.setEnabled(is_type)
        self._btn_rename.setEnabled(is_type or is_category)
        self._btn_delete.setEnabled(is_category)

    def _on_add_sub(self) -> None:
        idx  = self._tree.currentIndex()
        item = self._tree_model.itemFromIndex(idx)
        if item is None:
            return
        parent_id = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)

        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(
            self, "Nueva categoría",
            "Nombre de la nueva categoría:"
        )
        if not ok or not name.strip():
            return
        try:
            add_category(self._session, self._user.id, parent_id, name.strip())
            self.refresh()
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Error", str(exc))

    def _on_rename(self) -> None:
        idx  = self._tree.currentIndex()
        item = self._tree_model.itemFromIndex(idx)
        if item is None:
            return
        cat_id   = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        old_name = item.text()

        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(
            self, "Renombrar",
            "Nuevo nombre:", text=old_name
        )
        if not ok or not name.strip():
            return
        try:
            rename_category(self._session, self._user.id, cat_id, name.strip())
            self.refresh()
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Error", str(exc))

    def _on_delete(self) -> None:
        idx  = self._tree.currentIndex()
        item = self._tree_model.itemFromIndex(idx)
        if item is None:
            return
        cat_id   = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        cat_name = item.text()

        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self, "Confirmar eliminación",
            f"¿Eliminar la categoría <b>{cat_name}</b>?<br>"
            "Las transacciones asignadas quedarán sin categorizar.",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes |
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            remove_category(self._session, self._user.id, cat_id)
            self.refresh()
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Error", str(exc))

    def _on_seed(self) -> None:
        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self, "Cargar categorías por defecto",
            "Se añadirán las categorías estándar de FAMILYFIN "
            "(solo si aún no existen).<br>¿Continuar?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes |
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return

        created, rules_created = load_defaults(self._session, self._user.id)
        self.refresh()
        if created > 0 or rules_created > 0:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "Categorías cargadas",
                f"Se crearon {created} categorías y {rules_created} reglas "
                "por defecto."
            )
        else:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "Sin cambios",
                "Las categorías y reglas por defecto ya estaban creadas."
            )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Export / import of the categorization library
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_export(self) -> None:
        include_global = False
        if shares_global_rules(self._session, self._user.id) and self._session.query(
                AutoCategorizationRule.id).filter(AutoCategorizationRule.user_id.is_(None)).first() is not None:
            reply = QMessageBox.question(
                self, "Exportar categorías y reglas",
                "¿Incluir también las reglas globales (compartidas por toda la familia)?",
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            )
            include_global = reply == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self, "Exportar categorías y reglas",
            library_io.suggested_filename(self._user.username),
            f"Biblioteca de categorías (*{library_io.FILE_SUFFIX})",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        payload = library_io.export_library(self._session, self._user.id, include_global,
                                            source_user=self._user.username)
        try:
            Path(path).write_bytes(library_io.dumps(payload))
        except OSError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Error", f"No se pudo guardar el archivo:\n{exc}")
            return
        categories = sum(len(t["categories"]) for t in payload["types"])
        QMessageBox.information(
            self, "Exportación completada",
            f"Se exportaron {categories} categorías y {len(payload['rules'])} reglas a:\n{path}",
        )

    def _on_import(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Importar categorías y reglas", "",
            f"Biblioteca de categorías (*{library_io.FILE_SUFFIX} *.json *.json.gz);;Todos (*)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            with open(path, "rb") as handle:
                raw = handle.read(library_io.MAX_FILE_BYTES + 1)
            lib = library_io.parse_library(raw)
        except (OSError, library_io.LibraryError) as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No se puede importar", str(exc))
            return

        dialog = LibraryImportDialog(self._session, self._user.id, lib, Path(path).name, self)
        if dialog.exec() != LibraryImportDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
            return
        mode, allow_global = dialog.mode, dialog.allow_global
        if mode == library_io.MODE_REPLACE and dialog.plan and dialog.plan.deleted_rules:
            reply = QMessageBox.warning(
                self, "Confirmar reemplazo",
                f"Se eliminarán {len(dialog.plan.deleted_rules)} reglas tuyas que no están "
                "en el archivo. ¿Continuar?",
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            )
            if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
                return

        safety = self._save_pre_import_copy()
        try:
            result = library_io.apply_import(self._session, self._user.id, lib, mode, allow_global)
        except Exception as exc:  # apply_import already rolled back
            logger.exception("Importación de categorías fallida")
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Error", f"No se importó nada: {exc}")
            return
        self.refresh()

        lines = [
            f"Categorías creadas: {result.types_created + result.categories_created}",
            f"Reglas creadas: {result.rules_created}",
        ]
        if mode == library_io.MODE_REPLACE:
            lines += [f"Prioridades actualizadas: {result.rules_updated}",
                      f"Reglas eliminadas: {result.rules_deleted}"]
        if safety:
            lines.append(f"\nCopia previa guardada en:\n{safety}")
        lines.append("\n¿Aplicar ahora las reglas a los movimientos sin categoría?")
        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self, "Importación completada", "\n".join(lines),
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        )
        if reply == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            summary = apply_all_rules(self._session, self._user.id, overwrite=False)
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "Reglas aplicadas",
                f"Movimientos categorizados: {summary.assigned}\n"
                f"Con conflicto: {summary.conflicts}\nSin regla: {summary.unmatched}",
            )

    def _save_pre_import_copy(self) -> Optional[Path]:
        """Export the current library next to the backups before changing it."""
        try:
            from app.settings.settings_manager import SettingsManager
            manager = SettingsManager()
            folder = manager.auto_backup_dir(manager.load())
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
            name = library_io.suggested_filename(self._user.username).replace(
                library_io.FILE_SUFFIX, f"-antes-de-importar-{stamp}{library_io.FILE_SUFFIX}")
            payload = library_io.export_library(self._session, self._user.id, include_global=True,
                                                source_user=self._user.username)
            (folder / name).write_bytes(library_io.dumps(payload))
            return folder / name
        except Exception:  # a failed safety copy must not block the import
            logger.exception("No se pudo guardar la copia previa de categorías")
            return None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Theme
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def apply_theme(self, theme_key: str) -> None:
        self._theme = theme_key
        self._t = THEMES[theme_key]
        self._apply_theme()

    def _apply_theme(self) -> None:
        t = self._t
        is_dark = self._theme == "dark"
        selection_bg = (
            f"background-color: {t['accent']}; color: #FFFFFF;"
            if is_dark else
            f"background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0, "
            f"stop:0 {t['selection_grad_start']}, stop:1 {t['selection_grad_end']}); "
            f"color: {t['selection_text']};"
        )
        selection_hover = (
            f"background-color: {t['accent_hover']}; color: #FFFFFF;"
            if is_dark else
            f"background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0, "
            f"stop:0 {t['selection_hover_start']}, stop:1 {t['selection_hover_end']}); "
            f"color: {t['selection_text']};"
        )
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame#dashTopBar {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QLabel#dashTitle {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnPrimary {{
                background-color: {t["accent"]}; color: #FFFFFF;
                border: none; border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnPrimary:hover {{
                background-color: {t["accent_hover"]};
            }}
            QPushButton#btnSecondary {{
                background-color: transparent;
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnSecondary:hover {{
                background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
            }}
            QPushButton#btnDanger {{
                background-color: {t["expense"]}; color: #FFFFFF;
                border: none; border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnDanger:disabled {{
                background-color: {t["border"]};
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
            }}
            QTreeView#catTree {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 13px;
                alternate-background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
            }}
            QTreeView#catTree::item {{
                padding: 6px 8px;
                border-radius: 4px;
            }}
            QTreeView#catTree::item:hover {{
                background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
            }}
            QTreeView#catTree::item:selected {{
                {selection_bg}
            }}
            QTreeView#catTree::item:selected:hover {{
                {selection_hover}
            }}
            QFrame#actionPanel {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 12px;
            }}
            QLabel#panelTitle {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
            }}
            QLabel#selectedInfo {{
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
            }}
            QFrame#panelSep {{
                color: {t["border"]};
                background-color: {t["border"]};
                max-height: 1px;
            }}
        """)
        apply_card_shadow(self._action_panel, t)
```

## `app/gui/import_view.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/import_view.py
=======================
FAMILYFIN — Import View (Fase 4b)

Flow:
  Step 1 — File selection  : Browse for (or drop) one or several .xls/.xlsx
                             statements of the account
  Step 2 — Preview         : Table showing new vs duplicate rows
                             + duplicate resolution dialogs
  Step 3 — Confirm         : Commit to DB, show import summary

Design decisions:
  - Uses prepare_import() (no DB writes) for preview
  - Uses commit_import() for final DB writes
  - Preview table columns: Fecha | Emisor | Concepto | Importe | Tipo | Saldo
    (+ Extracto when several files are imported together)
  - Duplicates flagged in orange; user resolves via inline checkbox
  - Auto-categorization runs after commit
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Dict, List

from PySide6.QtCore    import Qt, QThread, Signal, QObject
from PySide6.QtGui     import QFont, QColor
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QPushButton, QFrame, QFileDialog, QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem, QHeaderView, QProgressBar,
    QMessageBox, QSizePolicy, QStackedWidget,
    QAbstractItemView, QCheckBox, QScrollArea,
)
import qtawesome as qta

from app.config      import THEMES
from app.db.models   import User, TransactionType
from sqlalchemy.orm  import Session


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Background worker for parse + validate (keeps GUI responsive)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _ParseWorker(QObject):
    finished = Signal(object)   # ImportPreview or Exception
    error    = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, file_paths: List[Path], user_id: int, account_id: int) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._file_paths = file_paths
        self._user_id    = user_id
        self._account_id = account_id

    def run(self) -> None:
        # A SQLAlchemy Session is not thread-safe: this worker thread opens
        # its own short-lived session instead of using the GUI's shared one.
        from app.db.database import get_session
        from app.ingestion.importer import prepare_import

        session = get_session()
        try:
            preview = prepare_import(
                file_paths = self._file_paths,
                session    = session,
                user_id    = self._user_id,
                account_id = self._account_id,
            )
            self.finished.emit(preview)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.error.emit(str(exc))
        finally:
            session.close()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main Import View
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ImportView(QWidget):
    """Three-step import wizard embedded in the main stacked view."""

    STEP_SELECT  = 0
    STEP_PREVIEW = 1
    STEP_SUMMARY = 2

    COL_FILE   = 6
    COL_IMPORT = 7
    EXTENSIONS = (".xls", ".xlsx")

    def __init__(self, user: User, session: Session,
                 theme: str = "light") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._user     = user
        self._session  = session
        self._theme    = theme
        self._t        = THEMES[theme]
        self._preview  = None   # ImportPreview object
        self._decisions: Dict[int, bool] = {}  # row_idx -> import (True) / skip (False)
        self._account_id: Optional[int] = None

        self._build_ui()
        self._apply_theme()
        self._ensure_account()
        self.setAcceptDrops(True)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI construction
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        root.setSpacing(0)

        # Top bar
        topbar = self._make_topbar()
        root.addWidget(topbar)

        # Step indicator
        self._step_bar = self._make_step_bar()
        root.addWidget(self._step_bar)

        # Stacked steps
        self._stack = QStackedWidget()
        root.addWidget(self._stack)

        self._stack.addWidget(self._make_step_select())
        self._stack.addWidget(self._make_step_preview())
        self._stack.addWidget(self._make_step_summary())

        self._go_to_step(self.STEP_SELECT)

    def _make_topbar(self) -> QFrame:
        bar = QFrame()
        bar.setObjectName("dashTopBar")
        bar.setFixedHeight(56)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(bar)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 0, 24, 0)

        lbl = QLabel("Importar movimientos")
        lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 15, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        lbl.setObjectName("dashTitle")
        layout.addWidget(lbl)
        layout.addStretch()
        return bar

    def _make_step_bar(self) -> QFrame:
        bar = QFrame()
        bar.setFixedHeight(48)
        bar.setObjectName("stepBar")
        layout = QHBoxLayout(bar)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 0, 24, 0)
        layout.setSpacing(0)

        steps = ["1  Seleccionar extractos",
                 "2  Previsualizar",
                 "3  Resultado"]
        self._step_labels: List[QLabel] = []
        for i, text in enumerate(steps):
            lbl = QLabel(text)
            lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            lbl.setObjectName(f"step_{i}")
            lbl.setFixedHeight(48)
            lbl.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding,
                              QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed)
            layout.addWidget(lbl)
            self._step_labels.append(lbl)

            if i < len(steps) - 1:
                arrow = QLabel("›")
                arrow.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
                arrow.setFixedWidth(20)
                arrow.setObjectName("stepArrow")
                layout.addWidget(arrow)

        return bar

    def _make_step_select(self) -> QWidget:
        w = QWidget()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(w)
        layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        layout.setSpacing(20)
        layout.setContentsMargins(48, 48, 48, 48)

        # Drop zone
        self._drop_zone = QFrame()
        self._drop_zone.setObjectName("dropZone")
        self._drop_zone.setFixedSize(480, 220)
        dz_layout = QVBoxLayout(self._drop_zone)
        dz_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        dz_layout.setSpacing(12)

        lbl_icon = QLabel()
        lbl_icon.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_icon.setPixmap(
            qta.icon("mdi.file-excel-outline",
                     color=self._t["accent"]).pixmap(56, 56)
        )
        dz_layout.addWidget(lbl_icon)

        lbl_drop = QLabel("Selecciona o arrastra uno o varios extractos de CaixaBank")
        lbl_drop.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_drop.setObjectName("dropZoneText")
        dz_layout.addWidget(lbl_drop)

        lbl_hint = QLabel("Excel .xls / .xlsx — si se solapan, cada movimiento se guarda una vez")
        lbl_hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_hint.setObjectName("dropZoneHint")
        dz_layout.addWidget(lbl_hint)

        dz_layout.addSpacing(8)

        self._btn_browse = QPushButton(
            "  Buscar extractos..."
        )
        self._btn_browse.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.folder-open-outline", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        self._btn_browse.setFixedHeight(40)
        self._btn_browse.setFixedWidth(200)
        self._btn_browse.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        self._btn_browse.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._btn_browse.clicked.connect(self._on_browse)
        dz_layout.addWidget(self._btn_browse,
                            alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

        layout.addWidget(self._drop_zone)

        # Selected file label
        self._lbl_selected = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_selected.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self._lbl_selected.setObjectName("selectedFile")
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_selected)

        # Progress bar (hidden by default)
        self._progress = QProgressBar()
        self._progress.setFixedWidth(480)
        self._progress.setFixedHeight(6)
        self._progress.setTextVisible(False)
        self._progress.setRange(0, 0)   # indeterminate
        self._progress.setVisible(False)
        self._progress.setObjectName("importProgress")
        layout.addWidget(self._progress,
                         alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

        # Parse button
        self._btn_parse = QPushButton("  Analizar")
        self._btn_parse.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.magnify", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        self._btn_parse.setFixedHeight(44)
        self._btn_parse.setFixedWidth(200)
        self._btn_parse.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        self._btn_parse.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._btn_parse.setEnabled(False)
        self._btn_parse.clicked.connect(self._on_parse)
        layout.addWidget(self._btn_parse,
                         alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

        self._selected_paths: List[Path] = []
        return w

    def _make_step_preview(self) -> QWidget:
        w = QWidget()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(w)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 16, 24, 16)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        # Summary bar
        self._preview_summary = QFrame()
        self._preview_summary.setObjectName("previewSummary")
        self._preview_summary.setFixedHeight(52)
        sum_layout = QHBoxLayout(self._preview_summary)
        sum_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 0, 16, 0)
        sum_layout.setSpacing(24)

        self._lbl_total = self._make_summary_chip(
            "mdi.database-import-outline", "0 filas", "accent"
        )
        self._lbl_new = self._make_summary_chip(
            "mdi.plus-circle-outline", "0 nuevas", "income"
        )
        self._lbl_dups = self._make_summary_chip(
            "mdi.content-copy", "0 duplicados", "warning"
        )
        self._lbl_skip = self._make_summary_chip(
            "mdi.skip-next-outline", "0 omitidas", "neutral"
        )
        for chip in [self._lbl_total, self._lbl_new,
                     self._lbl_dups, self._lbl_skip]:
            sum_layout.addWidget(chip)
        sum_layout.addStretch()

        layout.addWidget(self._preview_summary)

        # Transaction table
        self._tbl_preview = QTableWidget()
        self._tbl_preview.setColumnCount(8)
        self._tbl_preview.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            "Fecha", "Emisor", "Concepto",
            "Importe", "Tipo", "Saldo", "Extracto", "Importar"
        ])
        self._tbl_preview.setEditTriggers(
            QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers
        )
        self._tbl_preview.setSelectionBehavior(
            QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows
        )
        self._tbl_preview.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self._tbl_preview.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self._tbl_preview.setShowGrid(False)

        hdr = self._tbl_preview.horizontalHeader()
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(4, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(5, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(self.COL_FILE, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(self.COL_IMPORT, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        self._tbl_preview.setColumnWidth(self.COL_IMPORT, 80)

        layout.addWidget(self._tbl_preview)

        # Bottom button row
        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_row.setSpacing(12)

        self._btn_back_select = QPushButton("  Volver")
        self._btn_back_select.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.arrow-left", color=self._t["text_secondary"])
        )
        self._btn_back_select.setFixedHeight(40)
        self._btn_back_select.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        self._btn_back_select.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._btn_back_select.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._go_to_step(self.STEP_SELECT)
        )

        self._btn_commit = QPushButton("  Confirmar importación")
        self._btn_commit.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.database-check-outline", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        self._btn_commit.setFixedHeight(40)
        self._btn_commit.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        self._btn_commit.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._btn_commit.clicked.connect(self._on_commit)

        btn_row.addWidget(self._btn_back_select)
        btn_row.addStretch()
        btn_row.addWidget(self._btn_commit)
        layout.addLayout(btn_row)

        return w

    def _make_step_summary(self) -> QWidget:
        w = QWidget()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(w)
        layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        layout.setSpacing(20)
        layout.setContentsMargins(48, 48, 48, 48)

        self._lbl_summary_icon = QLabel()
        self._lbl_summary_icon.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_summary_icon)

        self._lbl_summary_title = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_summary_title.setFont(
            QFont("Segoe UI", 18, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        self._lbl_summary_title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_summary_title)

        self._lbl_summary_detail = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_summary_detail.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self._lbl_summary_detail.setObjectName("summaryDetail")
        self._lbl_summary_detail.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self._lbl_summary_detail)

        btn_new = QPushButton("  Nueva importación")
        btn_new.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.upload-outline", color="#FFFFFF")
        )
        btn_new.setFixedHeight(44)
        btn_new.setFixedWidth(220)
        btn_new.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        btn_new.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_new.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._go_to_step(self.STEP_SELECT)
        )
        layout.addWidget(btn_new, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

        return w

    def _make_summary_chip(self, icon_name: str,
                            text: str, color_key: str) -> QLabel:
        lbl = QLabel(f"  {text}")
        lbl.setObjectName(f"chip_{color_key}")
        return lbl

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step navigation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _go_to_step(self, step: int) -> None:
        self._stack.setCurrentIndex(step)
        t = self._t
        for i, lbl in enumerate(self._step_labels):
            if i == step:
                lbl.setStyleSheet(
                    f"color: {t['accent']}; font-weight: 700;"
                    f"border-bottom: 2px solid {t['accent']};"
                )
            else:
                lbl.setStyleSheet(
                    f"color: {t['text_secondary']}; font-weight: 400;"
                    "border-bottom: none;"
                )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Slots — Step 1
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_browse(self) -> None:
        paths, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames(
            self, "Seleccionar extractos de CaixaBank",
            os.path.expanduser("~"),
            "Ficheros CaixaBank (*.xls *.xlsx);;Todos los ficheros (*)"
        )
        if paths:
            self._select([Path(p) for p in paths])

    def _select(self, paths: List[Path]) -> None:
        self._selected_paths = paths
        if len(paths) == 1:
            self._lbl_selected.setText(f"📄  {paths[0].name}")
        else:
            self._lbl_selected.setText(f"📄  {len(paths)} extractos seleccionados")
        self._lbl_selected.setToolTip("\n".join(p.name for p in paths))
        self._btn_parse.setEnabled(True)

    def _dropped_statements(self, event) -> List[Path]:
        if not event.mimeData().hasUrls():
            return []
        paths = [Path(u.toLocalFile()) for u in event.mimeData().urls() if u.isLocalFile()]
        return [p for p in paths if p.suffix.lower() in self.EXTENSIONS]

    def dragEnterEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if self._stack.currentIndex() == self.STEP_SELECT and self._dropped_statements(event):
            event.acceptProposedAction()

    def dropEvent(self, event) -> None:
        paths = self._dropped_statements(event)
        if paths and self._btn_browse.isEnabled():
            self._select(paths)
            event.acceptProposedAction()

    def _on_parse(self) -> None:
        if not self._selected_paths:
            return
        if self._account_id is None:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self, "Sin cuenta",
                "No se encontró ninguna cuenta bancaria. "
                "Por favor crea una cuenta antes de importar."
            )
            return

        self._btn_parse.setEnabled(False)
        self._btn_browse.setEnabled(False)
        self._progress.setVisible(True)

        # Run in background thread
        self._thread = QThread()
        self._worker = _ParseWorker(
            list(self._selected_paths), self._user.id, self._account_id
        )
        self._worker.moveToThread(self._thread)
        self._thread.started.connect(self._worker.run)
        self._worker.finished.connect(self._on_parse_done)
        self._worker.error.connect(self._on_parse_error)
        self._worker.finished.connect(self._thread.quit)
        self._worker.error.connect(self._thread.quit)
        self._thread.start()

    def _on_parse_done(self, preview) -> None:
        self._progress.setVisible(False)
        self._btn_parse.setEnabled(True)
        self._btn_browse.setEnabled(True)
        self._preview = preview
        self._populate_preview_table(preview)
        self._go_to_step(self.STEP_PREVIEW)
        if preview.rejected:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self, "Extractos no incluidos",
                "Estos ficheros no se importarán:\n\n" + "\n".join(
                    f"• {r.name}: {r.reason}" for r in preview.rejected
                ),
            )

    def _on_parse_error(self, error_msg: str) -> None:
        self._progress.setVisible(False)
        self._btn_parse.setEnabled(True)
        self._btn_browse.setEnabled(True)
        QMessageBox.critical(
            self, "Error de validación", error_msg
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Preview table population
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _populate_preview_table(self, preview) -> None:
        """
        Populate the preview table from an ImportPreview object.

        ImportPreview structure (real):
          preview.df                  → pd.DataFrame (all rows)
          preview.duplicate_result    → DuplicateCheckResult
            .clean        → List[int]  row indices safe to import
            .auto_skip    → List[int]  certain duplicates (auto-skipped)
            .needs_review → List[int]  possible duplicates (user decides)
            .review_reasons → dict[int, str]
        """
        t          = self._t
        df         = preview.df
        dup_result = preview.duplicate_result

        n_total    = len(df)
        n_skip     = len(dup_result.auto_skip)
        n_review   = len(dup_result.needs_review)
        n_clean    = len(dup_result.clean)
        many       = len(preview.files) > 1

        self._lbl_total.setText(
            f"  {n_total} filas en {len(preview.files)} extractos" if many
            else f"  {n_total} filas"
        )
        self._lbl_new.setText(f"  {n_clean} nuevas")
        self._lbl_dups.setText(f"  {n_review} posibles duplicados")
        self._lbl_skip.setText(f"  {n_skip} omitidas (exactas)")

        # Only show clean + needs_review rows (auto_skip are hidden)
        visible_indices = sorted(dup_result.clean + dup_result.needs_review)

        self._tbl_preview.setRowCount(len(visible_indices))
        self._tbl_preview.setColumnHidden(self.COL_FILE, not many)
        self._decisions = {}

        type_labels = {
            TransactionType.income:     "Ingreso",
            TransactionType.expense:    "Gasto",
            TransactionType.investment: "Inversión",
        }

        for tbl_row, df_idx in enumerate(visible_indices):
            row       = df.iloc[df_idx]
            is_review = df_idx in dup_result.needs_review

            # -- Fecha
            d = row.get("transaction_date", "")
            item_date = QTableWidgetItem(str(d) if d else "")

            # -- Emisor
            item_issuer = QTableWidgetItem(
                str(row.get("issuer_name", "") or "")[:40]
            )

            # -- Concepto
            item_concept = QTableWidgetItem(
                str(row.get("concept", "") or "")[:80]
            )

            # -- Importe
            amount = float(row.get("amount", 0.0) or 0.0)
            item_amount = QTableWidgetItem(self._fmt_amount(amount))
            item_amount.setTextAlignment(
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight |
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
            )
            item_amount.setForeground(
                QColor(t["income"] if amount >= 0 else t["expense"])
            )

            # -- Tipo (derived from amount sign)
            if amount > 0:
                txn_type = TransactionType.income
            elif amount < 0:
                txn_type = TransactionType.expense
            else:
                txn_type = None
            item_type = QTableWidgetItem(
                type_labels.get(txn_type, "—")
            )

            # -- Saldo
            balance = float(row.get("running_balance", 0.0) or 0.0)
            item_balance = QTableWidgetItem(self._fmt_amount(balance))
            item_balance.setTextAlignment(
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight |
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
            )

            # -- Extracto (source file of the row)
            item_file = QTableWidgetItem(str(row.get("source_file", "") or ""))

            # -- Apply row styling
            for col, item in enumerate([
                item_date, item_issuer, item_concept,
                item_amount, item_type, item_balance, item_file
            ]):
                item.setFlags(
                    Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled |
                    Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable
                )
                if is_review:
                    # Orange tint for possible duplicates
                    item.setBackground(QColor(t["warning"] + "30"))
                    item.setToolTip(
                        dup_result.review_reasons.get(df_idx, "Posible duplicado")
                    )
                self._tbl_preview.setItem(tbl_row, col, item)

            # -- Checkbox column: clean=checked, needs_review=unchecked
            chk = QCheckBox()
            chk.setChecked(not is_review)
            chk.setStyleSheet("margin-left: 24px;")
            # Store decision keyed by df_idx (not tbl_row) for commit_import
            self._decisions[df_idx] = not is_review
            chk.stateChanged.connect(
                lambda state, idx=df_idx: self._decisions.__setitem__(
                    idx, state == Qt.CheckState.Checked.value
                )
            )
            self._tbl_preview.setCellWidget(tbl_row, self.COL_IMPORT, chk)

        self._tbl_preview.resizeRowsToContents()
        import logging
        logging.getLogger(__name__).info(
            "Preview: %d filas visibles (%d limpias, %d revisión, %d omitidas)",
            len(visible_indices), n_clean, n_review, n_skip,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Slots — Step 2 (Commit)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_commit(self) -> None:
        if self._preview is None:
            return

        to_import = sum(1 for v in self._decisions.values() if v)
        if to_import == 0:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "Sin filas seleccionadas",
                "No hay filas marcadas para importar. "
                "Selecciona al menos una fila."
            )
            return

        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Confirmar importación",
            f"Se importarán <b>{to_import}</b> transacciones "
            f"a la base de datos.<br><br>¿Continuar?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes |
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return

        try:
            from app.ingestion.import_service import run_import

            outcome = run_import(
                self._session, self._user.id, self._preview,
                self._account_id, self._decisions,
            )
            result   = outcome.summary
            auto_cat = outcome.auto_categorized

            self._show_summary(
                success     = True,
                imported    = result.rows_imported,
                skipped     = result.rows_skipped,
                auto_cat    = auto_cat,
                files       = len(result.batch_ids),
            )

        except Exception as exc:
            self._show_summary(success=False, error=str(exc))

    def _show_summary(self, success: bool,
                       imported: int = 0, skipped: int = 0,
                       auto_cat: int = 0, files: int = 1,
                       error: str = "") -> None:
        t = self._t
        if success:
            self._lbl_summary_icon.setPixmap(
                qta.icon("mdi.check-circle-outline",
                         color=t["income"]).pixmap(72, 72)
            )
            self._lbl_summary_title.setText("¡Importación completada!")
            self._lbl_summary_title.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {t['income']}; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700;"
            )
            self._lbl_summary_detail.setText(
                (f"<b>{files}</b> extractos  ·  " if files > 1 else "") +
                f"<b>{imported}</b> transacciones importadas  ·  "
                f"<b>{skipped}</b> omitidas  ·  "
                f"<b>{auto_cat}</b> auto-categorizadas"
            )
        else:
            self._lbl_summary_icon.setPixmap(
                qta.icon("mdi.alert-circle-outline",
                         color=t["expense"]).pixmap(72, 72)
            )
            self._lbl_summary_title.setText("Error en la importación")
            self._lbl_summary_title.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {t['expense']}; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700;"
            )
            self._lbl_summary_detail.setText(error)

        self._go_to_step(self.STEP_SUMMARY)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _ensure_account(self) -> None:
        """Get or create default account for this user."""
        from app.ingestion.import_service import ensure_default_account
        self._account_id = ensure_default_account(self._session, self._user.id).id

    @staticmethod
    def _fmt_amount(value: float) -> str:
        sign = "+" if value >= 0 else ""
        return (
            f"{sign}{abs(value):,.2f} €"
            .replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")
        )

    def _apply_theme(self) -> None:
        t = self._t
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame#dashTopBar {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QLabel#dashTitle {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;
            }}
            QFrame#stepBar {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QFrame#dropZone {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border: 2px dashed {t["border_strong"]};
                border-radius: 16px;
            }}
            QLabel#dropZoneText {{
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
            }}
            QLabel#dropZoneHint {{
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
            }}
            QLabel#selectedFile {{
                color: {t["accent"]};
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnPrimary {{
                background-color: {t["accent"]};
                color: #FFFFFF; border: none;
                border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnPrimary:hover {{
                background-color: {t["accent_hover"]};
            }}
            QPushButton#btnPrimary:disabled {{
                background-color: {t["border"]};
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
            }}
            QPushButton#btnSecondary {{
                background-color: transparent;
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
                font-size: 13px;
                padding: 0 16px;
            }}
            QPushButton#btnSecondary:hover {{
                background-color: {t["bg_hover"]};
            }}
            QTableWidget {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
                gridline-color: transparent;
                color: {t["text_primary"]};
                font-size: 12px;
            }}
            QTableWidget::item {{
                padding: 6px 8px;
                border-bottom: 1px solid {t["border"]};
            }}
            QTableWidget::item:selected {{
                background-color: {t["accent_light"]};
                color: {t["accent"]};
            }}
            QHeaderView::section {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
                padding: 6px 8px;
                border: none;
                border-bottom: 2px solid {t["border"]};
                text-transform: uppercase;
                letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            }}
            QTableWidget::item:alternate {{
                background-color: {t["bg_primary"]};
            }}
            QFrame#previewSummary {{
                background-color: {t["bg_secondary"]};
                border: 1px solid {t["border"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
            }}
            QProgressBar#importProgress {{

                border-radius: 3px;
            }}
            QProgressBar#importProgress::chunk {{
                background-color: {t["accent"]};
                border-radius: 3px;
            }}
            QLabel#summaryDetail {{
                color: {t["text_secondary"]};
                font-size: 14px;
            }}
        """)
```

```python
"""
app/gui/login_window.py
========================
FAMILYFIN — Login Window

Features:
  - Fullscreen on launch (showMaximized)
  - Auto-fills last logged-in username from QSettings
  - Password field always empty (security)
  - Light/dark theme toggle (persisted)

"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from PySide6.QtCore    import Qt, QSettings
from PySide6.QtGui     import QFont, QColor, QPalette, QIcon, QFontMetrics
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QLineEdit, QPushButton, QCheckBox, QFrame,
    QApplication, QMessageBox, QSizePolicy, QFileDialog, QComboBox,
)
import qtawesome as qta

from app.config        import APP_NAME, APP_VERSION, THEMES
from app.db import database as database_module
from app.db.database   import (
    Base,
    get_database_users,
    get_default_data_dir,
    get_session,
    get_user_data_dir,

    refresh_runtime_paths,
)
from app.auth.auth_service import verify_login
from app.settings      import SettingsManager


class _ElidedPathLabel(QLabel):
    """
    Non-interactive display for a filesystem path: elides from the front
    (…\\…\\data) to fit the available width instead of clipping, keeps the
    full path in the tooltip, and re-elides on resize.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._full_text = ""
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding,
                           QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed)

    def set_path(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._full_text = text
        self.setToolTip(text)
        self._update_elided_text()

    def full_path(self) -> str:
        return self._full_text

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._update_elided_text()

    def _update_elided_text(self) -> None:
        if not self._full_text:
            return
        fm = QFontMetrics(self.font())
        elided = fm.elidedText(
            self._full_text, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideLeft, self.width()
        )
        super().setText(elided)


class LoginWindow(QWidget):
    """
    Full-screen login window.
    Emits no signals — on success it instantiates MainWindow and closes self.
    """

    SETTINGS_ORG  = "FAMILYFIN"
    SETTINGS_APP  = "FAMILYFIN"
    KEY_LAST_USER = "auth/last_username"
    KEY_THEME     = "ui/theme"

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._settings = QSettings(self.SETTINGS_ORG, self.SETTINGS_APP)
        saved_settings = SettingsManager().load()
        remember_theme = saved_settings.save_appearance_on_start
        startup_theme = self._settings.value(self.KEY_THEME, saved_settings.theme if remember_theme else "light")
        self._theme = startup_theme if startup_theme in THEMES else (saved_settings.theme if remember_theme else "light")
        if not remember_theme:
            self._settings.setValue(self.KEY_THEME, "light")
        self._data_dir = get_user_data_dir()
        self._session  = get_session()

        self.setWindowTitle(f"{APP_NAME}  v{APP_VERSION}")

        self._build_ui()
        self._apply_theme()
        self._refresh_database_info()
        self._load_last_user()

        # A family member who joins, is renamed or deleted from the web
        # appears (or disappears) in the user list without restarting.
        try:
            from app.gui.web_bridge import web_bridge
            web_bridge().data_changed.connect(self._on_web_users_changed)
        except Exception:
            logging.getLogger(__name__).exception("Web: no se pudo escuchar los cambios de usuarios")

        self.showMaximized()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI construction
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        root.setSpacing(0)

        # ── Top bar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        self._top_bar = QFrame()
        self._top_bar.setFixedHeight(48)
        top_layout = QHBoxLayout(self._top_bar)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _refresh_database_info(self) -> None:
        """Show database status and populate users from the active directory."""
        database_path = self._data_dir / "profin.db"
        self._user_combo.clear()
        if not database_path.is_file():
            self._database_status.setText("BD no detectada en este directorio.")
            self._database_status.setProperty("databaseState", "missing")
            self._refresh_status_style()
            return

        try:
            users = get_database_users(self._data_dir)
            modified = datetime.fromtimestamp(
                database_path.stat().st_mtime
            ).strftime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S")
        except (OSError, sqlite3.DatabaseError) as exc:
            self._database_status.setText(f"No se pudo leer la BD: {exc}")
            self._database_status.setProperty("databaseState", "invalid")
            self._refresh_status_style()
            return

        self._database_status.setText(
            f"BD encontrada. Última modificación: {modified}"
        )
        self._database_status.setProperty("databaseState", "found")
        self._user_combo.addItems(users)
        self._refresh_status_style()

    def _on_web_users_changed(self, _user_id: int, area: str) -> None:
        if area not in ("user_created", "account", "account_deleted"):
            return
        current = self._user_combo.currentText()
        self._refresh_database_info()
        if current and self._user_combo.findText(current) >= 0:
            self._user_combo.setCurrentText(current)

    def _refresh_status_style(self) -> None:
        self._database_status.style().unpolish(self._database_status)
        self._database_status.style().polish(self._database_status)

    def _select_data_folder(self) -> None:
        """Select a database folder, including an empty one for registration."""
        selected = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Seleccionar carpeta de la base de datos",
            self._data_folder.full_path() or str(get_default_data_dir()),
        )
        if not selected:
            return

        data_dir = Path(selected).expanduser().resolve()
        previous_value = self._settings.value("settings/data_folder", "", type=str)
        try:
            self._session.close()
            self._settings.setValue("settings/data_folder", str(data_dir))
            self._settings.sync()
            # init_db, not just refresh_runtime_paths: an older database in the
            # chosen folder must be integrity-checked and migrated before use.
            init_db()
            self._data_dir = database_module.DB_DIR
            self._session = get_session()
            self._data_folder.set_path(str(self._data_dir))
            self._refresh_database_info()
            self._lbl_error.setVisible(False)
        except (OSError, RuntimeError, sqlite3.DatabaseError) as exc:
            self._settings.setValue("settings/data_folder", previous_value)
            self._settings.sync()
            refresh_runtime_paths()
            self._session = get_session()
            self._show_error(f"No se pudo activar la base de datos:\n{exc}")

    def _on_login(self) -> None:
        username = self._user_combo.currentText().strip()
        password = self._inp_pass.text()

        if not username:
            self._show_error("Por favor introduce tu nombre de usuario.")
            return
        if not password:
            self._show_error("Por favor introduce tu contraseña.")
            return

        user = verify_login(self._session, username, password)

        if user is None:
            self._show_error("Usuario o contraseña incorrectos.")
            self._inp_pass.clear()
            self._inp_pass.setFocus()
            return

        # Persist last user
        self._settings.setValue(self.KEY_LAST_USER, username)
        self._settings.setValue(self.KEY_THEME,     self._theme)

        # Launch main window
        from app.gui.main_window import MainWindow
        self._main = MainWindow(user=user, session=self._session,
                                theme=self._theme)
        self._main.show()
        self.close()

    def _on_register(self) -> None:
        """Open the inline register dialog."""
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QDialogButtonBox

        t = THEMES[self._theme]

        dlg = QDialog(self)
        dlg.setWindowTitle("Crear nueva cuenta")
        dlg.setFixedWidth(360)
        dlg.setModal(True)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
        layout.setContentsMargins(28, 28, 28, 28)
        layout.setSpacing(14)

        lbl_title = QLabel("Crear nueva cuenta")
        lbl_title.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 14, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        lbl_title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        layout.addWidget(lbl_title)

        lbl_u = QLabel("Usuario")
        lbl_u.setObjectName("fieldLabel")
        layout.addWidget(lbl_u)

        inp_user = QLineEdit()
        inp_user.setPlaceholderText("Elige un nombre de usuario")
        inp_user.setFixedHeight(40)
        inp_user.setObjectName("loginInput")
        layout.addWidget(inp_user)

        lbl_p = QLabel("Contraseña")
        lbl_p.setObjectName("fieldLabel")
        layout.addWidget(lbl_p)

        inp_pass = QLineEdit()
        inp_pass.setPlaceholderText("Elige una contraseña")
        inp_pass.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
        inp_pass.setFixedHeight(40)
        inp_pass.setObjectName("loginInput")
        layout.addWidget(inp_pass)

        lbl_p2 = QLabel("Confirmar contraseña")
        lbl_p2.setObjectName("fieldLabel")
        layout.addWidget(lbl_p2)

        inp_pass2 = QLineEdit()
        inp_pass2.setPlaceholderText("Repite la contraseña")
        inp_pass2.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
        inp_pass2.setFixedHeight(40)
        inp_pass2.setObjectName("loginInput")
        layout.addWidget(inp_pass2)

        lbl_err = QLabel("")
        lbl_err.setObjectName("loginError")
        lbl_err.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        lbl_err.setVisible(False)
        layout.addWidget(lbl_err)

        btn_box = QDialogButtonBox()
        btn_create = btn_box.addButton(
            "Crear cuenta", QDialogButtonBox.ButtonRole.AcceptRole
        )
        btn_create.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        btn_create.setFixedHeight(40)
        btn_cancel = btn_box.addButton(
            "Cancelar", QDialogButtonBox.ButtonRole.RejectRole
        )
        btn_cancel.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        btn_cancel.setFixedHeight(40)
        layout.addWidget(btn_box)

        dlg.setStyleSheet(self.styleSheet())

        def _try_create() -> None:
            from app.auth.auth_service import create_user, validate_new_user
            username = inp_user.text().strip()
            password = inp_pass.text()
            password2 = inp_pass2.text()

            try:
                Base.metadata.create_all(bind=database_module.engine)
                # Same rules as the web «Nuevo usuario» sheet (auth_service).
                errors = validate_new_user(self._session, username, password, password2)
                for field in ("username", "password", "confirm"):
                    if field in errors:
                        lbl_err.setText(errors[field])
                        lbl_err.setVisible(True)
                        if field == "confirm":
                            inp_pass2.clear()
                        return
                create_user(self._session, username, password)
                dlg.accept()
                # Auto-fill username after successful registration
                if self._user_combo.findText(username) < 0:
                    self._user_combo.addItem(username)
                self._user_combo.setCurrentText(username)
                self._inp_pass.setFocus()
                self._show_error(
                    f"✓ Cuenta '{username}' creada. Introduce tu contraseña para entrar."
                )
                self._lbl_error.setStyleSheet(
                    f"color: {t['income']}; font-size: 12px;"
                )
            except ValueError as exc:
                lbl_err.setText(str(exc))
                lbl_err.setVisible(True)

        btn_box.accepted.connect(_try_create)
        btn_box.rejected.connect(dlg.reject)
        inp_pass2.returnPressed.connect(_try_create)

        dlg.exec()

    def _toggle_theme(self) -> None:
        self._theme = "dark" if self._theme == "light" else "light"
        self._apply_theme()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _show_error(self, msg: str) -> None:
        self._lbl_error.setText(msg)
        self._lbl_error.setVisible(True)

    def _load_last_user(self) -> None:
        last = self._settings.value(self.KEY_LAST_USER, "")
        if last and self._user_combo.findText(last) >= 0:
            self._user_combo.setCurrentText(last)
            self._inp_pass.setFocus()
        else:
            self._user_combo.setFocus()

        t = THEMES[self._theme]
```

## `app/gui/rules_view.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/rules_view.py
======================
FAMILYFIN — Auto-Categorization Rules View (Fase 4b)

Features:
  - List of all rules (global + user) ordered by priority
  - Create new rule: pattern + match type + movement type (gasto /
    ingreso / cualquiera) + category + priority
  - Delete rule
  - Visual indicator for match type (contains/exact/regex)
  - Search box + filters (categoría, tipo, coincidencia, ámbito, uso) over
    the rows built by app.categorization.rule_search; the table only holds
    the filtered rows and every action resolves the rule by the id stored in
    column 0 (never by row index), so sorting/filtering can't misdirect it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import List

from PySide6.QtCore    import Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtGui     import QFont, QColor, QStandardItemModel, QStandardItem
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QPushButton, QFrame, QTableView, QHeaderView,
    QDialog, QLineEdit, QComboBox, QSpinBox,
    QFormLayout, QDialogButtonBox, QMessageBox,
    QAbstractItemView, QSizePolicy,
)
import qtawesome as qta

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config      import THEMES
from app.db.models   import (
    AutoCategorizationRule, MatchType, User, Category, CategoryLevel,
    Transaction, TransactionType,
)
from app.categorization.rules_engine  import (
    apply_rules, create_rule, delete_rule, get_all_rules, shares_global_rules, update_rule
)
from app.categorization.category_manager import get_all_categories
from app.categorization.rule_search import (
    MATCH_TYPE_LABELS, MOVEMENT_FILTERS, SCOPE_GLOBAL, SCOPE_PERSONAL, USAGE_WITH, USAGE_WITHOUT,
    RuleFilters, RuleRow, build_rule_rows, count_label, filter_options,
    filter_rule_rows,
)
from app.analytics.transaction_search import fold_text
from app.gui._style_utils import apply_card_shadow

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

RULE_ID_ROLE = Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole          # column 0: the rule id
SORT_ROLE    = Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole + 1      # typed sort key per cell
SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 250


def _movement_combo(current: TransactionType | None = None) -> QComboBox:
    """Which movements a rule applies to (stored in transaction_type)."""
    cmb = QComboBox()
    cmb.setFixedHeight(38)
    cmb.addItem("Cualquiera (gastos e ingresos)", None)
    cmb.addItem("Solo gastos (cargos)", TransactionType.expense)
    cmb.addItem("Solo ingresos (abonos)", TransactionType.income)
    cmb.setToolTip(
        "Un mismo texto (p. ej. BIZUM) puede ser un pago o un cobro:\n"
        "limita la regla a un tipo para categorizar cada uno por separado."
    )
    cmb.setCurrentIndex(max(0, cmb.findData(current)))
    return cmb


def _category_label(cat: Category) -> str:
    """Name plus its type: the same name can exist under GASTO and INGRESO."""
    return f"{cat.name} ({cat.parent.name})" if cat.parent is not None else cat.name


class RulesView(QWidget):

    def __init__(self, user: User, session: Session,
                 theme: str = "light") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._user    = user
        self._session = session
        self._theme   = theme
        self._t       = THEMES[theme]
        self._rules:  List[AutoCategorizationRule] = []
        self._rows:   List[RuleRow] = []          # all visible rules (unfiltered)
        self._shown:  List[RuleRow] = []          # after search + filters
        self._categories: List[Category] = []

        self._build_ui()
        self._apply_theme()
        self._load_categories()
        self.refresh()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        root.setSpacing(0)

        root.addWidget(self._make_topbar())
        self._filter_bar = self._make_filter_bar()
        root.addWidget(self._filter_bar)

        # Table
        self._table = QTableView()
        self._table.setSelectionBehavior(
            QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows
        )
        self._table.setEditTriggers(
            QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers
        )
        self._table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self._table.setShowGrid(False)
        self._table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        self._table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)

        self._model = QStandardItemModel()
        self._model.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            "Prioridad", "Patrón", "Tipo match", "Movimiento",
            "Categoría", "Ámbito", "Transacciones vinculadas",
            "Total (€)",
        ])
        # Numbers sort as numbers, text without case/accents (SORT_ROLE).
        self._model.setSortRole(SORT_ROLE)
        self._table.setModel(self._model)
        self._table.sortByColumn(0, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)
        self._table.doubleClicked.connect(lambda _index: self._on_edit_rule())

        hdr = self._table.horizontalHeader()
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(4, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(5, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(6, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        hdr.setSectionResizeMode(7, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)

        root.addWidget(self._table)

        # Bottom bar
        bottom = QFrame()
        self._bottom_bar = bottom
        bottom.setObjectName("rulesBottom")
        bottom.setFixedHeight(52)
        bl = QHBoxLayout(bottom)
        bl.setContentsMargins(16, 8, 16, 8)
        bl.setSpacing(10)

        self._lbl_count = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_count.setObjectName("rulesCount")
        bl.addWidget(self._lbl_count)

        bl.addStretch()

        btn_edit = QPushButton("  Editar regla")
        btn_edit.setIcon(
            qta.icon("mdi.pencil-outline", color="#FFFFFF")
        )

        self._search_timer.setInterval(SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS)
        self._search_timer.timeout.connect(self._on_filter_changed)
        self._inp_search.textChanged.connect(self._search_timer.start)
        self._inp_search.returnPressed.connect(self._on_filter_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self._inp_search, 1)

        def combo(first: str, tooltip: str, min_width: int = 0) -> QComboBox:
```
