```python
    _check_password(_user(session, user_id), password)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Password and name
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def change_password(session: Session, user_id: int, current: str, new: str, confirm: str) -> None:
    """Set a new password after checking the current one (field "current")."""
    user = _user(session, user_id)
    _check_password(user, current, field="current")
    validate_password(new, confirm, user.username)
    if new == current:
        raise AccountError("password", "La nueva contraseña debe ser distinta de la actual.")
    user.password_hash = hash_password(new)
    try:
        session.commit()
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        raise
    logger.info("Contraseña cambiada: '%s' (id=%s)", user.username, user.id)


def rename_user(session: Session, user_id: int, password: str, new_name: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    """Rename the account after checking its password. Returns (old, new)."""
    user = _user(session, user_id)
    if is_demo_name(user.username):
        raise AccountError("username", "La cuenta de demostración no se puede renombrar.")
    name = validate_username(session, new_name, exclude_id=user.id)
    if name == user.username:
        raise AccountError("username", "Ese ya es tu nombre de usuario.")
    _check_password(user, password)
    old = user.username
    user.username = name
    try:
        session.commit()
    except IntegrityError:
        session.rollback()
        raise AccountError("username", f"El usuario «{name}» ya existe. Elige otro nombre.")
    logger.info("Usuario renombrado: '%s' -> '%s' (id=%s)", old, name, user.id)
    return old, name


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deletion
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DeletionSummary:
    accounts: int
    transactions: int
    investment_operations: int
    categories: int
    rules: int
    imports: int
    global_rules: int          # family rules (user_id NULL) that point at this user's categories

    @property
    def blocked(self) -> bool:
        return self.global_rules > 0


def deletion_summary(session: Session, user_id: int) -> DeletionSummary:
    def count(model, *criteria) -> int:
        return session.query(func.count(model.id)).filter(*criteria).scalar() or 0

    own_categories = session.query(Category.id).filter(Category.user_id == user_id)
    return DeletionSummary(
        accounts=count(Account, Account.user_id == user_id),
        transactions=count(Transaction, Transaction.user_id == user_id),
        investment_operations=count(InvestmentTransaction, InvestmentTransaction.user_id == user_id),
        categories=count(Category, Category.user_id == user_id),
        rules=count(AutoCategorizationRule, AutoCategorizationRule.user_id == user_id),
        imports=count(ImportBatch, ImportBatch.user_id == user_id),
        global_rules=count(
            AutoCategorizationRule,
            AutoCategorizationRule.user_id.is_(None),
            AutoCategorizationRule.category_id.in_(own_categories),
        ),
    )


def delete_user(
    session: Session,
    user_id: int,
    password: str,
    confirm_name: str,
    backup: Callable[[], Path],
    source: str = "web",
) -> Path:
    """Delete the account and all its data. Returns the backup file.

    Order: exact name, password, no family rule depends on its categories
    (deleting them would cascade into rules the whole family uses), then the
    backup (if it fails nothing is deleted), then the ORM cascade. An
    audit_log row with user_id NULL records who was deleted and where the
    copy is; it survives the cascade that removes the user's own rows.
    """
    user = _user(session, user_id)
    if (confirm_name or "").strip() != user.username:
        raise AccountError("confirm_name", "El nombre escrito no coincide con tu usuario.")
    _check_password(user, password)

    summary = deletion_summary(session, user_id)
    if summary.blocked:
        raise AccountError(None, (
            f"{summary.global_rules} reglas globales de la familia usan tus categorías. "
            "Muévelas o bórralas desde el PC (Reglas) antes de borrar tu cuenta."
        ))

    try:
        backup_path = Path(backup())
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("No se pudo hacer la copia antes de borrar la cuenta '%s'", user.username)
        raise AccountError(None, (
            "No se pudo hacer la copia de seguridad, así que no se ha borrado nada. "
            "Revisa la carpeta de copias en el PC e inténtalo de nuevo."
        ))

    name, uid = user.username, user.id
    try:
        session.add(AuditLog(
            user_id=None,
            table_affected="users",
            record_id=uid,
            action=AuditAction.delete,
            old_value=(f"usuario «{name}» (id {uid}): {summary.accounts} cuentas, "
                       f"{summary.transactions} movimientos, {summary.investment_operations} operaciones"),
            new_value=f"cuenta borrada desde {source}; copia previa {backup_path.name}",
        ))
        session.delete(user)
        session.commit()
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        logger.exception("No se pudo borrar la cuenta '%s'", name)
        raise AccountError(None, "No se pudo borrar la cuenta. No se ha cambiado nada.")
    logger.info("Cuenta borrada desde %s: '%s' (id=%s), copia %s", source, name, uid, backup_path)
    return backup_path

```

## `app/categorization/admin_service.py`

```python
"""
app/categorization/admin_service.py
===================================
FAMILYFIN — Category and rule administration for one logged-in user.

Qt-free and shared by the desktop views (CategoriesView, RulesView) and the
web front-end. Every function takes the acting user's id and refuses to
touch another family member's categories or rules: the lower-level CRUD in
category_manager / rules_engine works on bare ids, which is fine inside the
desktop app but not for ids that arrive from a browser.

Global rules (user_id NULL) are shared by the whole family; they can be
read here but only created/changed from the desktop app.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.categorization.category_manager import (
    create_category,
    delete_category,
    seed_default_categories,
    seed_default_rules,
    update_category_name,
)
from app.categorization.rules_engine import (
    RULE_TRANSACTION_TYPES,
    RulesEngineResult,
    apply_rules,
    apply_rules_and_commit,
    create_rule,
    delete_rule,
    rule_scope,
    update_rule,
)
from app.db.models import (
    CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL,
    AutoCategorizationRule,
    Category,
    CategoryLevel,
    MatchType,
    Transaction,
    TransactionType,
    TRANSACTIONS_NEWEST_FIRST,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_NAME = 80
MAX_PATTERN = 200


class AdminError(ValueError):
    """A validation problem to show to the user as is."""


class NotFound(LookupError):
    """The record does not exist or belongs to someone else."""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Categories
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def own_category(session: Session, user_id: int, category_id: int) -> Category:
    cat = session.get(Category, category_id)
    if cat is None or cat.user_id != user_id:
        raise NotFound("Categoría no encontrada.")
    return cat


def _clean_name(name: Optional[str]) -> str:
    name = (name or "").strip()
    if not name:
        raise AdminError("El nombre no puede estar vacío.")
    if len(name) > MAX_NAME:
        raise AdminError(f"El nombre no puede superar {MAX_NAME} caracteres.")
    return name


def _check_unique(session: Session, user_id: int, parent_id: Optional[int], name: str,
                  exclude_id: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
    query = session.query(Category.id).filter(
        Category.user_id == user_id,
        Category.parent_id.is_(None) if parent_id is None else Category.parent_id == parent_id,
        func.lower(Category.name) == name.lower(),
    )
    if exclude_id is not None:
        query = query.filter(Category.id != exclude_id)
    if query.first() is not None:
        raise AdminError(f"Ya existe «{name}» en ese grupo.")


def add_category(session: Session, user_id: int, parent_id: int, name: str) -> Category:
    """New category under one of the user's type nodes (GASTO, INGRESO…)."""
    parent = own_category(session, user_id, parent_id)
    if parent.level != CategoryLevel.type:
        raise AdminError("Las categorías se crean dentro de un tipo (GASTO, INGRESO…).")
    name = _clean_name(name)
    _check_unique(session, user_id, parent.id, name)
    return create_category(session, user_id, name, CategoryLevel.category, parent_id=parent.id)


def rename_category(session: Session, user_id: int, category_id: int, name: str) -> Category:
    cat = own_category(session, user_id, category_id)
    name = _clean_name(name)
    _check_unique(session, user_id, cat.parent_id, name, exclude_id=cat.id)
    return update_category_name(session, cat.id, name)


@dataclass
class CategoryUsage:
    transactions: int = 0
    manual: int = 0
    rules: int = 0


def category_usage(session: Session, user_id: int, category_id: int) -> CategoryUsage:
    """What deleting this category would affect (shown before confirming)."""
    own_category(session, user_id, category_id)
    usage = CategoryUsage()
    usage.transactions = session.query(func.count(Transaction.id)).filter(
        Transaction.user_id == user_id, Transaction.category_id == category_id).scalar() or 0
    usage.manual = session.query(func.count(Transaction.id)).filter(
        Transaction.user_id == user_id, Transaction.category_id == category_id,
        Transaction.category_source == CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL).scalar() or 0
    usage.rules = session.query(func.count(AutoCategorizationRule.id)).filter(
        AutoCategorizationRule.category_id == category_id).scalar() or 0
    return usage


def remove_category(session: Session, user_id: int, category_id: int) -> CategoryUsage:
    """Delete a category (not a type node). Its transactions become
    uncategorized and go back to the rules; rules pointing at it are deleted
    with it (FK cascade), exactly as on the desktop."""
    cat = own_category(session, user_id, category_id)
    if cat.level == CategoryLevel.type:
        raise AdminError("Los tipos (GASTO, INGRESO…) no se pueden borrar.")
    usage = category_usage(session, user_id, category_id)
    # Done explicitly too: SQLite only cascades with PRAGMA foreign_keys on,
    # and a NULL category with category_source='manual' would stay locked.
    session.query(Transaction).filter(
        Transaction.user_id == user_id, Transaction.category_id == category_id,
    ).update({Transaction.category_id: None, Transaction.category_source: None},
             synchronize_session=False)
    session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).filter(
        AutoCategorizationRule.category_id == category_id,
    ).delete(synchronize_session=False)
    session.flush()
    delete_category(session, cat.id)
    return usage


def load_defaults(session: Session, user_id: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Default category tree and default rules (only what is missing).
    Returns (categories created, rules created)."""
    created = seed_default_categories(session, user_id)
    rules_created = seed_default_rules(session, user_id)
    return created, rules_created


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rules
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def visible_rules(session: Session, user_id: int) -> List[AutoCategorizationRule]:
    """The user's own rules plus the family's global ones, by priority."""
    return (
        session.query(AutoCategorizationRule)
        .filter(rule_scope(session, user_id))
        .order_by(AutoCategorizationRule.priority, AutoCategorizationRule.id)
        .all()
    )


def own_rule(session: Session, user_id: int, rule_id: int) -> AutoCategorizationRule:
    """A rule this user may change: their own, never a global one."""
    rule = session.get(AutoCategorizationRule, rule_id)
    if rule is None or (rule.user_id is not None and rule.user_id != user_id):
        raise NotFound("Regla no encontrada.")
    if rule.user_id is None:
        raise AdminError("Las reglas globales solo se modifican desde la aplicación del PC.")
    return rule


def _clean_transaction_type(value: Optional[str]) -> Optional[TransactionType]:
    """'' / None = any type; else expense or income."""
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        kind = TransactionType(value)
    except ValueError:
        kind = None
    if kind not in RULE_TRANSACTION_TYPES:
        raise AdminError("Tipo de movimiento no válido.")
    return kind


def _clean_rule(session: Session, user_id: int, category_id: Optional[int], pattern: Optional[str],
                match_type: Optional[str], priority: Optional[int]) -> tuple:
    if category_id is None:
        raise AdminError("Elige la categoría que asigna la regla.")
    cat = own_category(session, user_id, category_id)
    if cat.level == CategoryLevel.type:
        raise AdminError("Elige una categoría, no un tipo.")
    pattern = (pattern or "").strip()
    if not pattern:
        raise AdminError("El texto a buscar no puede estar vacío.")
    if len(pattern) > MAX_PATTERN:
        raise AdminError(f"El texto a buscar no puede superar {MAX_PATTERN} caracteres.")
    try:
        kind = MatchType(match_type or MatchType.contains.value)
    except ValueError:
        raise AdminError("Tipo de coincidencia no válido.")
    if kind == MatchType.regex:
        try:
            re.compile(pattern)
        except re.error as exc:
            raise AdminError(f"Expresión regular no válida: {exc}")
    if priority is None:
        priority = 100
    if not 1 <= priority <= 9999:
        raise AdminError("La prioridad debe estar entre 1 y 9999.")
    return cat.id, pattern, kind, priority


def add_rule(session: Session, user_id: int, category_id: Optional[int], pattern: Optional[str],
             match_type: Optional[str] = None, priority: Optional[int] = None,
             transaction_type: Optional[str] = None) -> AutoCategorizationRule:
    """New personal rule (scope: only this user). transaction_type limits
    it to expense or income movements; empty = any type."""
    cat_id, pattern, kind, priority = _clean_rule(session, user_id, category_id, pattern, match_type, priority)
    txn_type = _clean_transaction_type(transaction_type)
    return create_rule(session, cat_id, pattern, kind, priority, user_id=user_id,
                       transaction_type=txn_type)


def transaction_has_rule(session: Session, user_id: int, transaction_id: int) -> bool:
    """True when an existing rule (personal or global) already matches this
    transaction's text — then the category picker offers no new rule."""
    result = apply_rules(session, [transaction_id], user_id)
    return transaction_id in result.assigned or transaction_id in result.conflicts


@dataclass
class RuleFromTransaction:
    rule: AutoCategorizationRule
    categorized_ids: List[int]      # uncategorized transactions the new rule filled at once


def add_rule_from_transaction(session: Session, user_id: int, transaction_id: int,
                              category_id: int) -> Optional[RuleFromTransaction]:
    """
    "Crear regla" from the category picker: an exact rule on the merchant
    (or, without one, the full concept) pointing at category_id, limited to
    the movement's type (a BIZUM paid and a BIZUM received get separate
    rules), applied right away to the user's uncategorized transactions —
    what the next Movimientos refresh would do anyway.

    Returns None (and creates nothing) when a rule already matches the
    transaction. Raises NotFound for another user's transaction or category.
    """
    txn = session.get(Transaction, transaction_id)
    if txn is None or txn.user_id != user_id:
        raise NotFound("Movimiento no encontrado.")
    pattern = (txn.issuer_name or txn.concept or "").strip()
    if not pattern or len(pattern) > MAX_PATTERN or transaction_has_rule(session, user_id, transaction_id):
        return None
    txn_type = TransactionType(txn.type)
    rule = add_rule(session, user_id, category_id, pattern, MatchType.exact.value,
                    transaction_type=txn_type.value if txn_type in RULE_TRANSACTION_TYPES else None)
    ids = [row.id for row in session.query(Transaction.id).filter(
        Transaction.user_id == user_id, Transaction.category_id.is_(None))]
    result = apply_rules_and_commit(session, ids, user_id) if ids else RulesEngineResult()
    return RuleFromTransaction(rule, list(result.assigned))


def edit_rule(session: Session, user_id: int, rule_id: int, category_id: Optional[int],
              pattern: Optional[str], match_type: Optional[str],
              priority: Optional[int], transaction_type: Optional[str] = None) -> AutoCategorizationRule:
    """Save the whole rule form (an empty transaction_type = any type)."""
    rule = own_rule(session, user_id, rule_id)
    cat_id, pattern, kind, priority = _clean_rule(session, user_id, category_id, pattern, match_type, priority)
    txn_type = _clean_transaction_type(transaction_type)
    return update_rule(session, rule.id, category_id=cat_id, match_pattern=pattern,
                       match_type=kind, priority=priority, transaction_type=txn_type)


def remove_rule(session: Session, user_id: int, rule_id: int) -> None:
    rule = own_rule(session, user_id, rule_id)
    delete_rule(session, rule.id)


def move_rule(session: Session, user_id: int, rule_id: int, direction: str) -> AutoCategorizationRule:
    """Raise (up) or lower (down) a rule's priority past its visible
    neighbour: lower number = applied first."""
    rule = own_rule(session, user_id, rule_id)
    rules = visible_rules(session, user_id)
    index = next(i for i, r in enumerate(rules) if r.id == rule.id)
    if direction == "up":
        if index == 0:
            return rule
        neighbour = rules[index - 1]
        new_priority = max(1, neighbour.priority - 1)
    elif direction == "down":
        if index == len(rules) - 1:
            return rule
        neighbour = rules[index + 1]
        new_priority = min(9999, neighbour.priority + 1)
    else:
        raise AdminError("Dirección no válida.")
    return update_rule(session, rule.id, priority=new_priority)


def rule_match_counts(session: Session, user_id: int) -> Dict[int, int]:
    """How many of the user's transactions each rule wins today (dry run)."""
    ids = [row.id for row in session.query(Transaction.id).filter(Transaction.user_id == user_id)]
    if not ids:
        return {}
    result = apply_rules(session, ids, user_id)
    return {rule_id: len(txn_ids) for rule_id, txn_ids in result.transaction_ids_by_rule.items()}


@dataclass
class PatternPreview:
    total: int = 0
    samples: List[Transaction] = field(default_factory=list)
    manual: int = 0


def preview_pattern(session: Session, user_id: int, pattern: Optional[str],
                    match_type: Optional[str], limit: int = 8,
                    transaction_type: Optional[str] = None) -> PatternPreview:
    """Transactions a pattern would match (issuer or concept), newest
    first; only expenses or incomes when transaction_type says so."""
    preview = PatternPreview()
    pattern = (pattern or "").strip()
    if not pattern or len(pattern) > MAX_PATTERN:
        return preview
    try:
        kind = MatchType(match_type or MatchType.contains.value)
        txn_type = _clean_transaction_type(transaction_type)
    except ValueError:      # AdminError included
        return preview
    if kind == MatchType.regex:
        try:
            regex = re.compile(pattern, re.IGNORECASE)
        except re.error:
            return preview
        test = lambda text: bool(text) and regex.search(text) is not None  # noqa: E731
    elif kind == MatchType.exact:
        low = pattern.lower()
        test = lambda text: bool(text) and text.lower() == low  # noqa: E731
    else:
        low = pattern.lower()
        test = lambda text: bool(text) and low in text.lower()  # noqa: E731

    query = (
        session.query(Transaction)
        .filter(Transaction.user_id == user_id)
        .order_by(*TRANSACTIONS_NEWEST_FIRST)
    )
    if txn_type is not None:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.type == txn_type)
    if kind == MatchType.contains:
        like = f"%{pattern.lower()}%"
        query = query.filter(func.lower(Transaction.issuer_name).like(like)
                             | func.lower(Transaction.concept).like(like))
    for txn in query:
        if test(txn.issuer_name) or test(txn.concept):
            preview.total += 1
            if txn.category_source == CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL:
                preview.manual += 1
            if len(preview.samples) < limit:
                preview.samples.append(txn)
    return preview


@dataclass
class ApplySummary:
    assigned: int
    conflicts: int
    unmatched: int


def apply_all_rules(session: Session, user_id: int, overwrite: bool = False) -> ApplySummary:
    """Run the rules over the user's transactions.

    overwrite=False: only uncategorized ones (safe default).
    overwrite=True : also re-categorize ones set by rules earlier (after
                     editing rules). Categories set by hand are never
                     touched in either mode (apply_rules_and_commit).
    """
    query = session.query(Transaction.id).filter(Transaction.user_id == user_id)
    if not overwrite:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.category_id.is_(None))
    ids = [row.id for row in query]
    if not ids:
        return ApplySummary(0, 0, 0)
    result: RulesEngineResult = apply_rules_and_commit(session, ids, user_id, overwrite=overwrite)
    return ApplySummary(len(result.assigned), len(result.conflicts), len(result.unmatched))

```

## `app/categorization/library_io.py`

```python
"""
app/categorization/library_io.py
================================
FAMILYFIN — Export / import of a user's categorization library.

The library is the category tree (type → category) plus the
auto-categorization rules: the work that makes imports categorize
themselves. It is written as a small, versioned, deterministic JSON file
(".profin-cats.json") meant to be archived, diffed and loaded into another
user or database.

Design rules
------------
* Never trust ids: categories are identified by their natural key
  (type name, category name), compared case-insensitively — the same names
  repeat under different types (lessons_learned: ids from other users).
* Import is planned first (plan_import, read-only) and then applied in one
  transaction (apply_import). The plan is recomputed at apply time so it
  always reflects the current state of the database.
* Merge (default) only adds what is missing. Replace also makes the user's
  *personal rules* equal to the file. Categories are never deleted and
  transactions are never touched — rules are applied afterwards, on demand.
* Global rules (user_id NULL) are only imported when allow_global=True
  (desktop); the web never changes them.

Qt-free; shared by CategoriesView and the web router.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import re
import zlib
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.categorization.admin_service import MAX_NAME, MAX_PATTERN, AdminError
from app.categorization.rules_engine import RULE_TRANSACTION_TYPES, rule_scope
from app.db.models import (
    AutoCategorizationRule,
    Category,
    CategoryLevel,
    MatchType,
    TransactionType,
)

FORMAT_NAME = "profin.categorization"
FORMAT_VERSION = 1
FILE_SUFFIX = ".profin-cats.json"
MAX_FILE_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024        # compressed or not
MAX_RULES = 5000
MAX_CATEGORIES = 2000

SCOPE_PERSONAL = "personal"
SCOPE_GLOBAL = "global"
MODE_MERGE = "merge"
MODE_REPLACE = "replace"

# Upgrade steps for older files: {from_version: fn(dict) -> dict at from_version + 1}.
# Same idea as SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS: never renumber, only append.
_UPGRADES: Dict[int, Callable[[dict], dict]] = {}


class LibraryError(AdminError):
    """The file cannot be imported; the message is shown to the user."""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LibType:
    name: str
    transaction_type: Optional[str]
    categories: Tuple[str, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LibRule:
    type: str
    category: str
    pattern: str
    match_type: str
    priority: int
    scope: str
    # Movement type the rule is limited to ("expense" / "income"); None =
    # any. Optional in the file: files written before it existed mean any.
    transaction_type: Optional[str] = None


@dataclass
class LibraryFile:
    types: List[LibType]
    rules: List[LibRule]
    source_user: Optional[str] = None
    exported_at: Optional[str] = None
    app_version: Optional[str] = None
    checksum_ok: bool = True        # False: edited or damaged by hand → warn

    @property
    def category_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(len(t.categories) for t in self.types)


def _fold(text: str) -> str:
    return text.strip().casefold()


def _rule_key(type_name: str, category: str, pattern: str, match_type: str,
              transaction_type: Optional[str] = None) -> tuple:
    return (_fold(type_name), _fold(category), _fold(pattern), match_type, transaction_type)


def _txn_type_value(rule: AutoCategorizationRule) -> Optional[str]:
    return rule.transaction_type.value if rule.transaction_type else None


def movement_note(transaction_type: Optional[str]) -> str:
    """" (solo gastos)" / " (solo ingresos)" for previews; "" for any type."""
    return {TransactionType.expense.value: " (solo gastos)",
            TransactionType.income.value: " (solo ingresos)"}.get(transaction_type or "", "")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _type_and_category(cat: Category) -> Optional[Tuple[Category, Category]]:
    """(type node, category) for an assignable category, else None."""
    parent = cat.parent
    if cat.level == CategoryLevel.category and parent is not None and parent.level == CategoryLevel.type:
        return parent, cat
    return None


def export_library(session: Session, user_id: int, include_global: bool = False,
                   source_user: Optional[str] = None) -> dict:
    """The user's library as a plain dict (see dumps() for the file bytes)."""
    from app.config import APP_VERSION
    from app.db.database import SCHEMA_VERSION

    roots = (
        session.query(Category)
        .filter(Category.user_id == user_id, Category.parent_id.is_(None),
                Category.level == CategoryLevel.type)
        .all()
    )
    types = []
    for root in sorted(roots, key=lambda c: (_fold(c.name), c.name)):
        children = sorted(
            (c.name for c in root.children if c.level == CategoryLevel.category),
            key=lambda n: (_fold(n), n),
        )
        types.append({
            "name": root.name,
            "transaction_type": root.transaction_type.value if root.transaction_type else None,
            "categories": children,
        })

    query = session.query(AutoCategorizationRule)
    if include_global:
        query = query.filter(rule_scope(session, user_id))
    else:
        query = query.filter(AutoCategorizationRule.user_id == user_id)

    rules, seen = [], set()
    for rule in query:
        pair = _type_and_category(rule.category)
        if pair is None:
            continue
        type_node, cat = pair
        scope = SCOPE_GLOBAL if rule.user_id is None else SCOPE_PERSONAL
        key = _rule_key(type_node.name, cat.name, rule.match_pattern, rule.match_type.value,
                        _txn_type_value(rule)) + (scope,)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        rules.append({
            "type": type_node.name,
            "category": cat.name,
            "pattern": rule.match_pattern,
            "match_type": rule.match_type.value,
            "transaction_type": _txn_type_value(rule),
            "priority": rule.priority,
            "scope": scope,
        })
    rules.sort(key=lambda r: (r["priority"], _fold(r["type"]), _fold(r["category"]),
                              _fold(r["pattern"]), r["match_type"], r["transaction_type"] or "",
                              r["scope"]))

    return {
        "format": FORMAT_NAME,
        "format_version": FORMAT_VERSION,
        "exported_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        "app_version": APP_VERSION,
        "db_schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "source_user": source_user,
        "types": types,
        "rules": rules,
    }


def _canonical(payload: dict) -> bytes:
    body = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "checksum"}
    return json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def dumps(payload: dict) -> bytes:
    """File bytes: pretty, key-sorted JSON with a SHA-256 of the content."""
    body = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "checksum"}
    body["checksum"] = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(_canonical(body)).hexdigest()
    return (json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def suggested_filename(user_name: str, when: Optional[datetime] = None) -> str:
    safe = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "_", user_name or "usuario").strip("_") or "usuario"
    return f"profin-categorias-{safe}-{(when or datetime.now()):%Y%m%d}{FILE_SUFFIX}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parse + validate
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _decompress(raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    if raw[:2] != b"\x1f\x8b":
        return raw
    # Bounded inflate: a tiny .gz must not expand into gigabytes.
    inflater = zlib.decompressobj(16 + zlib.MAX_WBITS)
    try:
        data = inflater.decompress(raw, MAX_FILE_BYTES + 1)
    except zlib.error:
        raise LibraryError("El archivo comprimido está dañado.")
    if len(data) > MAX_FILE_BYTES or inflater.unconsumed_tail:
        raise LibraryError("El archivo es demasiado grande.")
    return data


def _text(value, what: str, limit: int) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise LibraryError(f"Falta {what} o no es texto.")
    value = value.strip()
    if len(value) > limit:
        raise LibraryError(f"{what.capitalize()} supera {limit} caracteres: «{value[:40]}…».")
    return value


def parse_library(raw: bytes) -> LibraryFile:
    """Validate file bytes (plain or gzip JSON) into a LibraryFile.

    Raises LibraryError with a user-facing message on anything malformed.
    A checksum mismatch is not an error: checksum_ok=False lets the caller warn.
    """
    if len(raw) > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
        raise LibraryError("El archivo es demasiado grande.")
    data = _decompress(raw)
    try:
        payload = json.loads(data.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        raise LibraryError("El archivo no es un JSON válido.")
    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get("format") != FORMAT_NAME:
        raise LibraryError("El archivo no es una biblioteca de categorías de FAMILYFIN.")

    checksum = payload.get("checksum")
    checksum_ok = (isinstance(checksum, str)
                   and checksum == "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(_canonical(payload)).hexdigest())

    version = payload.get("format_version")
    if not isinstance(version, int) or isinstance(version, bool) or version < 1:
        raise LibraryError("Versión de formato no válida.")
    if version > FORMAT_VERSION:
        raise LibraryError(
            f"El archivo usa la versión de formato {version}; esta aplicación solo entiende "
            f"hasta la {FORMAT_VERSION}. Actualiza FAMILYFIN para importarlo.")
    while version < FORMAT_VERSION:
        upgrade = _UPGRADES.get(version)
        if upgrade is None:
            raise LibraryError(f"No se puede actualizar el formato {version}.")
        payload = upgrade(payload)
        version += 1

    raw_types = payload.get("types")
    raw_rules = payload.get("rules")
    if not isinstance(raw_types, list) or not isinstance(raw_rules, list):
        raise LibraryError("Al archivo le faltan las secciones de tipos o reglas.")
    if len(raw_rules) > MAX_RULES:
        raise LibraryError(f"El archivo tiene más de {MAX_RULES} reglas.")

    tx_types = {t.value for t in TransactionType}
    types: List[LibType] = []
    seen_types: Dict[str, LibType] = {}
    total = 0
    for entry in raw_types:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            raise LibraryError("Tipo de categoría mal formado.")
        name = _text(entry.get("name"), "el nombre de un tipo", MAX_NAME)
        tx = entry.get("transaction_type")
        if tx is not None and tx not in tx_types:
            raise LibraryError(f"Tipo de movimiento desconocido en «{name}»: {tx}.")
        cats_raw = entry.get("categories") or []
        if not isinstance(cats_raw, list):
            raise LibraryError(f"Las categorías de «{name}» están mal formadas.")
        cats, seen = [], set()
        for cat in cats_raw:
            cat = _text(cat, f"el nombre de una categoría de «{name}»", MAX_NAME)
            if _fold(cat) not in seen:
                seen.add(_fold(cat))
                cats.append(cat)
        total += len(cats)
        if _fold(name) in seen_types:
            raise LibraryError(f"El tipo «{name}» aparece dos veces.")
        lib_type = LibType(name, tx, tuple(cats))
        seen_types[_fold(name)] = lib_type
        types.append(lib_type)
    if total > MAX_CATEGORIES:
        raise LibraryError(f"El archivo tiene más de {MAX_CATEGORIES} categorías.")

    match_types = {m.value for m in MatchType}
    rules: List[LibRule] = []
    for entry in raw_rules:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            raise LibraryError("Regla mal formada.")
        type_name = _text(entry.get("type"), "el tipo de una regla", MAX_NAME)
        category = _text(entry.get("category"), "la categoría de una regla", MAX_NAME)
        lib_type = seen_types.get(_fold(type_name))
        if lib_type is None or _fold(category) not in {_fold(c) for c in lib_type.categories}:
            raise LibraryError(f"La regla apunta a «{type_name} › {category}», que no está en el archivo.")
        pattern = _text(entry.get("pattern"), "el texto de una regla", MAX_PATTERN)
        kind = entry.get("match_type", MatchType.contains.value)
        if kind not in match_types:
            raise LibraryError(f"Tipo de coincidencia no válido en la regla «{pattern}».")
        if kind == MatchType.regex.value:
            try:
                re.compile(pattern)
            except re.error as exc:
                raise LibraryError(f"Expresión regular no válida «{pattern}»: {exc}")
        priority = entry.get("priority", 100)
        if not isinstance(priority, int) or isinstance(priority, bool) or not 1 <= priority <= 9999:
            raise LibraryError(f"Prioridad fuera de rango (1–9999) en la regla «{pattern}».")
        scope = entry.get("scope", SCOPE_PERSONAL)
        if scope not in (SCOPE_PERSONAL, SCOPE_GLOBAL):
            raise LibraryError(f"Ámbito no válido en la regla «{pattern}».")
        rule_tx = entry.get("transaction_type")
        if rule_tx is not None and rule_tx not in {t.value for t in RULE_TRANSACTION_TYPES}:
            raise LibraryError(f"Tipo de movimiento no válido en la regla «{pattern}».")
        rules.append(LibRule(type_name, category, pattern, kind, priority, scope, rule_tx))

    def _meta(key: str) -> Optional[str]:
        value = payload.get(key)
        return value[:100] if isinstance(value, str) else None

    return LibraryFile(types, rules, source_user=_meta("source_user"),
                       exported_at=_meta("exported_at"), app_version=_meta("app_version"),
                       checksum_ok=checksum_ok)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plan + apply
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class ImportPlan:
    mode: str
    new_types: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    new_categories: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)          # "TIPO › Categoría"
    new_rules: List[LibRule] = field(default_factory=list)
    priority_changes: List[Tuple[LibRule, int]] = field(default_factory=list)   # (rule, old priority)
    deleted_rules: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)          # replace: personal rules gone
    unchanged_rules: int = 0
    skipped_global: int = 0
    warnings: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def has_changes(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.new_types or self.new_categories or self.new_rules
                    or self.priority_changes or self.deleted_rules)


@dataclass
class _State:
    """The user's current tree and rules, indexed by natural key."""
    types: Dict[str, Category]
    categories: Dict[Tuple[str, str], Category]
    personal: Dict[tuple, AutoCategorizationRule]
    global_: Dict[tuple, AutoCategorizationRule]
    stray_personal: List[AutoCategorizationRule]   # rules on non-exportable categories


def _load_state(session: Session, user_id: int) -> _State:
    types: Dict[str, Category] = {}
    categories: Dict[Tuple[str, str], Category] = {}
    for cat in session.query(Category).filter(Category.user_id == user_id):
        if cat.level == CategoryLevel.type and cat.parent_id is None:
            types.setdefault(_fold(cat.name), cat)
        pair = _type_and_category(cat)
        if pair is not None:
            categories.setdefault((_fold(pair[0].name), _fold(cat.name)), cat)

    personal, global_, stray = {}, {}, []
    rules = (session.query(AutoCategorizationRule)
             .filter(rule_scope(session, user_id))
             .order_by(AutoCategorizationRule.id))
    for rule in rules:
        pair = _type_and_category(rule.category)
        if pair is None:
            if rule.user_id is not None:
                stray.append(rule)
            continue
        key = _rule_key(pair[0].name, pair[1].name, rule.match_pattern, rule.match_type.value,
                        _txn_type_value(rule))
        target = global_ if rule.user_id is None else personal
        target.setdefault(key, rule)
    return _State(types, categories, personal, global_, stray)


def _describe(rule: AutoCategorizationRule) -> str:
    pair = _type_and_category(rule.category)
    where = f"{pair[0].name} › {pair[1].name}" if pair else rule.category.name
    return f"«{rule.match_pattern}»{movement_note(_txn_type_value(rule))} → {where}"


def plan_import(session: Session, user_id: int, lib: LibraryFile, mode: str = MODE_MERGE,
                allow_global: bool = False) -> ImportPlan:
    """What apply_import would change, without writing anything."""
    if mode not in (MODE_MERGE, MODE_REPLACE):
        raise LibraryError("Modo de importación no válido.")
    state = _load_state(session, user_id)
    plan = ImportPlan(mode=mode)
    if not lib.checksum_ok:
        plan.warnings.append("La huella del archivo no coincide: se editó a mano o está dañado. "
                             "Revisa la vista previa antes de importar.")

    for lib_type in lib.types:
        if _fold(lib_type.name) not in state.types:
            plan.new_types.append(lib_type.name)
        for cat in lib_type.categories:
            if (_fold(lib_type.name), _fold(cat)) not in state.categories:
                plan.new_categories.append(f"{lib_type.name} › {cat}")

    file_personal: Dict[tuple, LibRule] = {}
    file_global: set = set()
    for rule in lib.rules:
        key = _rule_key(rule.type, rule.category, rule.pattern, rule.match_type, rule.transaction_type)
        if rule.scope == SCOPE_GLOBAL:
            if not allow_global:
                plan.skipped_global += 1
            elif key in file_global:
                continue
            elif key in state.global_:
                plan.unchanged_rules += 1
            else:
                plan.new_rules.append(rule)
            file_global.add(key)
            continue
        if key in file_personal:
            continue
        file_personal[key] = rule
        existing = state.personal.get(key)
        if existing is None:
            plan.new_rules.append(rule)
        elif mode == MODE_REPLACE and existing.priority != rule.priority:
            plan.priority_changes.append((rule, existing.priority))
        else:
            plan.unchanged_rules += 1

    if mode == MODE_REPLACE:
        plan.deleted_rules = [_describe(r) for k, r in state.personal.items() if k not in file_personal]
        plan.deleted_rules += [_describe(r) for r in state.stray_personal]

    if plan.skipped_global:
        plan.warnings.append(f"{plan.skipped_global} reglas globales del archivo no se importan aquí: "
                             "las reglas globales solo se cambian desde la aplicación del PC.")
    return plan


@dataclass
class ImportResult:
    types_created: int = 0
    categories_created: int = 0
    rules_created: int = 0
    rules_updated: int = 0
    rules_deleted: int = 0


def apply_import(session: Session, user_id: int, lib: LibraryFile, mode: str = MODE_MERGE,
                 allow_global: bool = False) -> ImportResult:
    """Apply the import in one transaction (all or nothing).

    The plan is recomputed against the current database, so a preview made
    earlier (web token, open dialog) can never apply stale decisions.
    """
    plan = plan_import(session, user_id, lib, mode, allow_global)
    result = ImportResult()
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    try:
        state = _load_state(session, user_id)

        for lib_type in lib.types:
            type_node = state.types.get(_fold(lib_type.name))
            if type_node is None:
                type_node = Category(
                    user_id=user_id, parent_id=None, name=lib_type.name, level=CategoryLevel.type,
                    transaction_type=TransactionType(lib_type.transaction_type) if lib_type.transaction_type else None,
                    created_at=now,
                )
                session.add(type_node)
                session.flush()
                state.types[_fold(lib_type.name)] = type_node
                result.types_created += 1
            for cat_name in lib_type.categories:
                key = (_fold(lib_type.name), _fold(cat_name))
                if key in state.categories:
                    continue
                cat = Category(user_id=user_id, parent_id=type_node.id, name=cat_name,
                               level=CategoryLevel.category, transaction_type=None, created_at=now)
                session.add(cat)
                session.flush()
                state.categories[key] = cat
                result.categories_created += 1

        for rule in plan.new_rules:
            cat = state.categories[(_fold(rule.type), _fold(rule.category))]
            session.add(AutoCategorizationRule(
                user_id=None if rule.scope == SCOPE_GLOBAL else user_id,
                category_id=cat.id, match_pattern=rule.pattern,
                match_type=MatchType(rule.match_type), priority=rule.priority, created_at=now,
                transaction_type=TransactionType(rule.transaction_type) if rule.transaction_type else None,
            ))
            result.rules_created += 1

        for rule, _old in plan.priority_changes:
            existing = state.personal[_rule_key(rule.type, rule.category, rule.pattern, rule.match_type,
                                                rule.transaction_type)]
            existing.priority = rule.priority
            result.rules_updated += 1

        if mode == MODE_REPLACE:
            keep = {_rule_key(r.type, r.category, r.pattern, r.match_type, r.transaction_type)
                    for r in lib.rules if r.scope == SCOPE_PERSONAL}
            doomed = [r for k, r in state.personal.items() if k not in keep] + state.stray_personal
            for rule in doomed:
                session.delete(rule)
                result.rules_deleted += 1

        session.commit()
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        raise
    return result

```

## `app/categorization/rule_search.py`

```python
"""
app/categorization/rule_search.py
=================================
FAMILYFIN — Search and filters for the Reglas screen (desktop RulesView and
web /mas/reglas). Qt-free.

``build_rule_rows`` turns the rules a user sees (``rule_scope``) into plain
rows with the category resolved the way the engine resolves it for that
user (global rules created by another family member map to the same-named
category of this user's tree, see ``rules_engine._resolve_rule_categories``).
``filter_rule_rows`` then applies the free-text search and the filters in
Python: a family has at most a few hundred rules, so this is cheap.

Free-text search: same behaviour as Movimientos — every word must appear in
at least one field (AND across words, OR across fields), case- and
accent-insensitive. Text fields match as substrings: pattern, match type
(desktop and web labels and value), movement type (gasto / ingreso /
cualquiera), category, its parent type, scope (global / personal) and
creation date (dd/mm/yyyy or ISO; only words containing "/" or "-",
so plain numbers don't hit every year). Numbers match whole: a word equal
to the priority or to the number of linked transactions.

The rule model has no active flag, no notes and no per-rule matched field
(every rule is tested against both issuer and concept), so none of those
can be searched or filtered.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Tuple

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.analytics.transaction_search import fold_text, search_terms
from app.categorization.rules_engine import _resolve_rule_categories, get_all_rules
from app.db.models import AutoCategorizationRule, Category, MatchType, TransactionType

MATCH_TYPE_LABELS = {
    MatchType.contains: "Contiene",
    MatchType.exact:    "Exacto",
    MatchType.regex:    "Regex",
}
# Every wording either UI shows for a match type (the web says "Es
# exactamente" / "Expresión regular"), so both screens search the same.
MATCH_TYPE_SEARCH_WORDS = {
    MatchType.contains: "Contiene",
    MatchType.exact:    "Exacto Es exactamente",
    MatchType.regex:    "Regex Expresión regular",
}
# Movement type a rule is limited to (None = any). Filter values below.
MOVEMENT_LABELS = {
    None: "Cualquiera",
    TransactionType.expense: "Gasto",
    TransactionType.income: "Ingreso",
}
MOVEMENT_ANY = "any"
MOVEMENT_FILTERS = {
    TransactionType.expense.value: "Solo gastos",
    TransactionType.income.value: "Solo ingresos",
    MOVEMENT_ANY: "Cualquier movimiento",
}
SCOPE_GLOBAL = "global"
SCOPE_PERSONAL = "personal"
SCOPE_LABELS = {SCOPE_GLOBAL: "Global", SCOPE_PERSONAL: "Personal"}
USAGE_WITH = "con"        # rules that win at least one transaction today
USAGE_WITHOUT = "sin"     # rules that win none (candidates to review)
USAGE_LABELS = {USAGE_WITH: "Con movimientos", USAGE_WITHOUT: "Sin movimientos"}


@dataclass
class RuleRow:
    id:            int
    user_id:       Optional[int]
    pattern:       str
    match_type:    MatchType
    priority:      int
    category_id:   Optional[int]      # in this user's tree; None = no equivalent
    category_name: Optional[str]
    type_name:     Optional[str]      # parent type node (GASTO, INGRESO, ...)
    created_at:    Optional[datetime]
    transaction_type: Optional[TransactionType] = None   # None = any movement
    matches:       Optional[int] = None    # transactions it wins today
    total:         Optional[float] = None  # their summed amount
    _haystack:     str = field(default="", repr=False)
    _numbers:      Tuple[str, ...] = field(default=(), repr=False)
    _dates:        str = field(default="", repr=False)

    @property
    def is_global(self) -> bool:
        return self.user_id is None

    @property
    def scope(self) -> str:
        return SCOPE_GLOBAL if self.is_global else SCOPE_PERSONAL

    @property
    def match_label(self) -> str:
        return MATCH_TYPE_LABELS.get(self.match_type, str(self.match_type))

    @property
    def movement(self) -> str:
        """Filter value: 'expense' | 'income' | MOVEMENT_ANY."""
        return self.transaction_type.value if self.transaction_type else MOVEMENT_ANY

    @property
    def movement_label(self) -> str:
        return MOVEMENT_LABELS.get(self.transaction_type, "Cualquiera")


@dataclass
class RuleFilters:
    text:        str = ""
    category_id: Optional[int] = None
    type_name:   Optional[str] = None
    match_type:  Optional[MatchType] = None
    scope:       Optional[str] = None     # SCOPE_GLOBAL | SCOPE_PERSONAL
    usage:       Optional[str] = None     # USAGE_WITH | USAGE_WITHOUT
    movement:    Optional[str] = None     # a MOVEMENT_FILTERS key

    def is_empty(self) -> bool:
        return not search_terms(self.text) and all(
            value is None for value in (
                self.category_id, self.type_name, self.match_type, self.scope, self.usage,
                self.movement)
        )


def _index(row: RuleRow) -> RuleRow:
    created = []
    if row.created_at is not None:
        created = [row.created_at.date().isoformat(), row.created_at.strftime("%d/%m/%Y")]
    texts = [
        row.pattern, MATCH_TYPE_SEARCH_WORDS.get(row.match_type, ""), row.match_type.value,
        row.category_name or "", row.type_name or "",
        SCOPE_LABELS[row.scope], row.movement_label,
    ]
    row._haystack = "\n".join(fold_text(t) for t in texts if t)
    numbers = [str(row.priority)]
    if row.matches is not None:
        numbers.append(str(row.matches))
    row._numbers = tuple(numbers)
    row._dates = "\n".join(created)
    return row


def build_rule_rows(
    session: Session,
    user_id: int,
    matches: Optional[Dict[int, int]] = None,
    totals: Optional[Dict[int, float]] = None,
    rules: Optional[List[AutoCategorizationRule]] = None,
) -> List[RuleRow]:
    """Rows (priority order) for every rule ``user_id`` sees. ``matches``
    and ``totals`` (rule id -> count / amount) are optional usage stats;
    when ``matches`` is given, rules missing from it count 0."""
    if rules is None:
        rules = get_all_rules(session, user_id=user_id)
    if not rules:
        return []
    resolved = _resolve_rule_categories(session, rules, user_id)
    wanted = set(resolved.values()) | {rule.category_id for rule in rules}
    cats: Dict[int, Category] = {
        c.id: c for c in session.query(Category).filter(Category.id.in_(wanted))
    }
    rows: List[RuleRow] = []
    for rule in rules:
        own_id = resolved.get(rule.id)
        # Own tree first; for a global rule without equivalent, show its
        # creator's category name so the row still reads sensibly.
        cat = cats.get(own_id) if own_id is not None else cats.get(rule.category_id)
        parent = cat.parent if cat is not None else None
        rows.append(_index(RuleRow(
            id=rule.id,
            user_id=rule.user_id,
            pattern=rule.match_pattern,
            match_type=MatchType(rule.match_type),
            priority=rule.priority,
            category_id=own_id,
            category_name=cat.name if cat is not None else None,
            type_name=parent.name if parent is not None else None,
            created_at=rule.created_at,
            transaction_type=(TransactionType(rule.transaction_type)
                              if rule.transaction_type else None),
            matches=(matches.get(rule.id, 0) if matches is not None else None),
            total=(round(totals.get(rule.id, 0.0), 2) if totals is not None else None),
        )))
    return rows


def _matches_text(row: RuleRow, terms: Iterable[str]) -> bool:
    return all(
        term in row._haystack
        or term in row._numbers
        # Dates only for words that look like one ("18/10", "2026-10"), so a
        # plain number such as a priority doesn't match every creation year.
        or (("/" in term or "-" in term) and term in row._dates)
        for term in terms
    )


def filter_rule_rows(rows: List[RuleRow], filters: RuleFilters) -> List[RuleRow]:
    """Rows passing every filter and containing every search word."""
    terms = search_terms(filters.text)
    out: List[RuleRow] = []
    for row in rows:
        if filters.category_id is not None and row.category_id != filters.category_id:
            continue
        if filters.type_name is not None and fold_text(row.type_name or "") != fold_text(filters.type_name):
            continue
        if filters.match_type is not None and row.match_type != filters.match_type:
            continue
        if filters.scope is not None and row.scope != filters.scope:
            continue
        if filters.movement is not None and row.movement != filters.movement:
            continue
        if filters.usage is not None and row.matches is not None:
            if (row.matches > 0) != (filters.usage == USAGE_WITH):
                continue
        if terms and not _matches_text(row, terms):
            continue
        out.append(row)
    return out


def filter_options(rows: List[RuleRow]) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[int, str, str]], List[str]]:
    """(categories as (id, name, type name) sorted by type then name,
    type names sorted) present among ``rows`` — what the combos offer."""
    cats = {
        row.category_id: (row.category_id, row.category_name or "", row.type_name or "")
        for row in rows if row.category_id is not None
    }
    categories = sorted(cats.values(), key=lambda c: (fold_text(c[2]), fold_text(c[1])))
    types = sorted({row.type_name for row in rows if row.type_name}, key=fold_text)
    return categories, types


def count_label(shown: int, total: int, filtered: bool) -> str:
    """"Mostrando 37 de 412 reglas" when something filters, else "412 reglas"."""
    noun = "regla" if total == 1 else "reglas"
    if filtered:
        return f"Mostrando {shown} de {total} {noun}"
    return f"{total} {noun}"

```

## `app/gui/_background.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/_background.py
======================
FAMILYFIN — Run a slow call (network) off the GUI thread.

    runner = BackgroundRunner(parent=self)
    runner.run(lambda: provider.search(text), self._on_results)

The callback runs back on the GUI thread as callback(result, error), with
exactly one of the two set. The callable must not use the GUI's shared
SQLAlchemy Session (it is not thread-safe): do the network part in the
thread and touch the database in the callback.

`latest_only=True` drops the result of a call that a newer latest_only
call has superseded (e.g. a search the user has already retyped).

Lifetime: each call runs in its own QThread subclass whose run() ends when
the call returns (no event loop to quit). Threads are kept alive in a
module-level registry until they finish, even if the dialog that started
them is closed — destroying a running QThread aborts the process. Closing
a runner only suppresses its callbacks. wait_for_background_threads() is
called when the main window closes.

Thread note: the `done` signal is emitted from the worker thread and is
connected to a bound method of the runner (a QObject living in the GUI
thread), so Qt queues the call there. A plain function or lambda would
run in the worker thread instead.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, Optional, Set

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, QThread, Signal, Slot

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_LIVE: Set[QThread] = set()


def _prune() -> None:
    for thread in [t for t in _LIVE if t.isFinished()]:
        _LIVE.discard(thread)


def wait_for_background_threads(timeout_ms: int = 15000) -> None:
    """Block until every background call has returned (app shutdown)."""
    for thread in list(_LIVE):
        if not thread.wait(timeout_ms):
            logger.warning("Un hilo en segundo plano no terminó a tiempo")
    _prune()


class _Task(QThread):
    done = Signal(int, object, object)   # number, result, error

    def __init__(self, number: int, fn: Callable[[], Any]) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._number = number
        self._fn = fn

    def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            result = self._fn()
        except Exception as exc:        # handed to the callback, never lost
            self.done.emit(self._number, None, exc)
        else:
            self.done.emit(self._number, result, None)


class BackgroundRunner(QObject):
    def __init__(self, parent: Optional[QObject] = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._callbacks: Dict[int, tuple] = {}
        self._sequence = 0
        self._latest = 0
        self._closed = False

    @property
    def busy(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self._callbacks)

    def run(
        self,
        fn: Callable[[], Any],
        callback: Callable[[Any, Optional[BaseException]], None],
        latest_only: bool = False,
    ) -> int:
        _prune()
        self._sequence += 1
        number = self._sequence
        if latest_only:
            self._latest = number
        task = _Task(number, fn)
        _LIVE.add(task)
        self._callbacks[number] = (callback, latest_only)
        task.done.connect(self._on_done)
        task.start()
        return number

    @Slot(int, object, object)
    def _on_done(self, number: int, result, error) -> None:
        entry = self._callbacks.pop(number, None)
        if entry is None or self._closed:
            return
        callback, latest_only = entry
        if latest_only and number != self._latest:
            return
        if error is not None:
            logger.info("Tarea en segundo plano con error: %s", error)
        callback(result, error)

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        """Stop delivering callbacks; running calls finish on their own."""
        self._closed = True
        self._callbacks.clear()

```

## `app/gui/_format.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/_format.py
==================
FAMILYFIN — Spanish number formatting for the investment screens.

1234.5 → "1.234,50"; thousands with ".", decimals with ",".
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from typing import Optional

_SYMBOLS = {"EUR": "€", "USD": "$", "GBP": "£", "GBp": "p", "CHF": "CHF"}


def fmt_number(value: float, decimals: int = 2) -> str:
    text = f"{value:,.{decimals}f}"
    return text.replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")


def fmt_quantity(value: Optional[float]) -> str:
    """Shares: no trailing zeros, up to 6 decimals (fund units)."""
    if value is None:
        return "—"
    text = fmt_number(value, 6).rstrip("0").rstrip(",")
    return text


def fmt_eur(value: Optional[float], signed: bool = False) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "—"
    sign = "+" if signed and value > 0 else ("−" if value < 0 else "")
    return f"{sign}{fmt_number(abs(value))} €"


def fmt_money(value: Optional[float], currency: Optional[str], decimals: int = 2) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "—"
    symbol = _SYMBOLS.get(currency or "EUR", currency or "")
    return f"{fmt_number(value, decimals)} {symbol}"


def fmt_pct(value: Optional[float], signed: bool = True) -> str:
    """0.1234 → "+12,34 %"."""
    if value is None:
        return "—"
    sign = "+" if signed and value > 0 else ("−" if value < 0 else "")
    return f"{sign}{fmt_number(abs(value) * 100)} %"


def fmt_date(value: Optional[date]) -> str:
    return value.strftime("%d/%m/%Y") if value else "—"

```

## `app/gui/_style_utils.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/_style_utils.py
=========================
FAMILYFIN — Small shared GUI style helpers.

Currently provides card elevation (drop shadow) built from the theme's
``card_shadow`` token, so it can be applied consistently to every card-like
container across views and re-applied whenever the theme toggles.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re

from PySide6.QtGui     import QColor
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QGraphicsDropShadowEffect, QWidget

_RGBA_RE = re.compile(
    r"rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*(?:,\s*([\d.]+)\s*)?\)"
)


def _parse_shadow_color(card_shadow: str) -> QColor:
    """Parse a 'rgba(r,g,b,a)' token string into a QColor. Falls back to a
    sensible translucent black if the token is missing/malformed."""
    match = _RGBA_RE.match(card_shadow or "")
    if not match:
        return QColor(0, 0, 0, 60)
    r, g, b = (int(match.group(i)) for i in (1, 2, 3))
    alpha = float(match.group(4)) if match.group(4) is not None else 1.0
    color = QColor(r, g, b)
    color.setAlphaF(max(0.0, min(1.0, alpha)))
    return color


def apply_card_shadow(widget: QWidget, theme: dict,
                       blur_radius: int = 20,
                       x_offset: int = 0,
                       y_offset: int = 4) -> None:
    """
    Apply (or refresh) a soft drop shadow on ``widget`` using the theme's
    ``card_shadow`` token. Safe to call repeatedly (e.g. on every theme
    toggle) — it replaces any existing effect rather than stacking them.
    """
    effect = QGraphicsDropShadowEffect(widget)
    effect.setBlurRadius(blur_radius)
    effect.setOffset(x_offset, y_offset)
    effect.setColor(_parse_shadow_color(theme.get("card_shadow", "")))
    widget.setGraphicsEffect(effect)

```

## `app/gui/account_dialogs.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/account_dialogs.py
==========================
FAMILYFIN — «Cambiar contraseña» and «Cambiar nombre» on the PC (account
menu of MainWindow), with the same rules as the web «Mi cuenta»: both run
through app.auth.account_service, and every AccountError is shown under the
field it belongs to. The dialogs only write the user row; the caller does
the rest (web sessions, audit, labels) after accept().
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QLineEdit, QPushButton, QVBoxLayout, QWidget,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.auth.account_rules import MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH, MAX_USERNAME_LENGTH, MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH, AccountError
from app.auth.account_service import change_password, rename_user
from app.gui.investment_dialogs import dialog_stylesheet


class _AccountFormDialog(QDialog):
    """Title, hint, a column of labelled fields with an error line under
    each, a general error line and Cancelar / <action>."""

    TITLE = ""
    HINT = ""
    ACTION = ""
    # (field key as in AccountError.field, label, is a password)
    FIELDS: List[Tuple[str, str, bool]] = []

    def __init__(self, session: Session, user_id: int, theme: dict,
                 parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._session = session
        self._user_id = user_id
        self.setWindowTitle(self.TITLE)
        self.setModal(True)
        self.setFixedWidth(420)
        self.setStyleSheet(dialog_stylesheet(theme))

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 22, 24, 20)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        title = QLabel(self.TITLE)
        title.setObjectName("dlgTitle")
        layout.addWidget(title)
        hint = QLabel(self.HINT)
        hint.setObjectName("dlgHint")
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(hint)
        layout.addSpacing(8)

        self.inputs: Dict[str, QLineEdit] = {}
        self.errors: Dict[str, QLabel] = {}
        for key, label, secret in self.FIELDS:
            layout.addWidget(QLabel(label))
            edit = QLineEdit()
            edit.setMaxLength(MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH * 2 if secret else MAX_USERNAME_LENGTH * 2)
            if secret:
                edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
            edit.textChanged.connect(lambda _text, k=key: self._clear_error(k))
            edit.returnPressed.connect(self._next_or_submit)
            layout.addWidget(edit)
            error = QLabel()
            error.setObjectName("dlgError")
            error.setWordWrap(True)
            error.setVisible(False)
            layout.addWidget(error)
            self.inputs[key] = edit
            self.errors[key] = error
            layout.addSpacing(4)

        self.general_error = QLabel()
        self.general_error.setObjectName("dlgError")
        self.general_error.setWordWrap(True)
        self.general_error.setVisible(False)
        layout.addWidget(self.general_error)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.addStretch()
        cancel = QPushButton("Cancelar")
        cancel.setObjectName("btnSecondary")
        cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        self.btn_ok = QPushButton(self.ACTION)
        self.btn_ok.setObjectName("btnPrimary")
        self.btn_ok.setDefault(True)
        self.btn_ok.clicked.connect(self.submit)
        buttons.addWidget(cancel)
        buttons.addWidget(self.btn_ok)
        layout.addSpacing(8)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

    def value(self, key: str) -> str:
        return self.inputs[key].text()

    def _clear_error(self, key: str) -> None:
        self.errors[key].setVisible(False)
        self.general_error.setVisible(False)

    def _next_or_submit(self) -> None:
        keys = list(self.inputs)
        for key in keys:
            if not self.inputs[key].text():
                self.inputs[key].setFocus()
                return
        self.submit()

    def show_error(self, exc: AccountError) -> None:
        label = self.errors.get(exc.field) if exc.field else None
        if label is None:
            label = self.general_error
        label.setText(exc.message)
        label.setVisible(True)
        if exc.field in self.inputs:
            edit = self.inputs[exc.field]
            if edit.echoMode() == QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password:
                edit.clear()
                label.setVisible(True)      # clear() hid it through textChanged
            edit.setFocus()

    def submit(self) -> None:
        try:
            self._session.expire_all()
            self.apply()
        except AccountError as exc:
            self.show_error(exc)
            return
        except Exception:
            self._session.rollback()
            logging.getLogger(__name__).exception("%s: error inesperado", self.TITLE)
            self.show_error(AccountError(None, "No se pudo guardar el cambio. No se ha cambiado nada."))
            return
        self.accept()

    def apply(self) -> None:          # pragma: no cover - overridden
        raise NotImplementedError


class ChangePasswordDialog(_AccountFormDialog):
    TITLE = "Cambiar contraseña"
    HINT = (f"Entre {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} y {MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH} caracteres. Mejor una frase fácil "
            "de recordar que una palabra con símbolos; no valen las muy comunes ni tu nombre. "
            "Se cerrará la sesión en la web de todos tus dispositivos.")
    ACTION = "Cambiar contraseña"
    FIELDS = [
        ("current", "Contraseña actual", True),
        ("password", "Nueva contraseña", True),
        ("confirm", "Repite la nueva contraseña", True),
    ]

    def apply(self) -> None:
        change_password(self._session, self._user_id, self.value("current"),
                        self.value("password"), self.value("confirm"))


class RenameDialog(_AccountFormDialog):
    TITLE = "Cambiar nombre de usuario"
    HINT = "Con este nombre entrarás en el PC y en la web. Tus datos no cambian."
    ACTION = "Cambiar nombre"
    FIELDS = [
        ("username", "Nuevo nombre", False),
        ("password", "Tu contraseña", True),
    ]

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.names: Optional[Tuple[str, str]] = None   # (old, new) after accept()

    def apply(self) -> None:
        self.names = rename_user(self._session, self._user_id,
                                 self.value("password"), self.value("username"))

```

## `app/gui/investment_charts.py`

```python
"""
app/gui/investment_charts.py
============================
FAMILYFIN — "Evolución" and "Distribución" tabs of the Inversiones view.

EvolutionPanel
    Line chart of the portfolio value against the FIFO cost of what is held
    ("Capital invertido") and, optionally, a benchmark fed with the same cash
    flows. Period buttons (1M · 6M · Año · 1A · 3A · Todo), benchmark
    selector, and a hover read-out (crosshair + box with the day's values).
    Painted with QPainter like the dashboard charts: no chart library.

AllocationPanel
    The dashboard's donut/bars card (_CategoryChartWidget) fed with the
    current market value grouped by security, broker, currency or type.

Both only read the local cache (performance.py); the view reloads them
lazily, when their tab is visible.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, timedelta
from typing import List, Optional

from PySide6.QtCore import QPointF, QRectF, QSettings, Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QBrush, QColor, QFont, QLinearGradient, QPainter, QPainterPath, QPen
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QButtonGroup,
    QComboBox,
    QFrame,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QPushButton,
    QSizePolicy,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.gui._format import fmt_date, fmt_eur, fmt_number
from app.gui._style_utils import apply_card_shadow
from app.gui.dashboard import _CategoryChartWidget
from app.investments.benchmarks import BENCHMARKS, DEFAULT_BENCHMARK
from app.investments.performance import (
    ALLOCATION_DIMENSIONS,
    HistoryPoint,
    PortfolioHistory,
    allocation,
    portfolio_history,
)

_MONTHS = ["ene", "feb", "mar", "abr", "may", "jun", "jul", "ago", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dic"]
BENCHMARK_SETTING = "investments/benchmark"
BENCHMARK_COLOR = "#D97706"

PERIODS = [("1M", 31), ("6M", 183), ("Año", "ytd"), ("1A", 365), ("3A", 3 * 365), ("Todo", None)]


def _short_eur(value: float) -> str:
    if abs(value) >= 1_000_000:
        return f"{fmt_number(value / 1_000_000, 1)} M€"
    if abs(value) >= 10_000:
        return f"{fmt_number(value / 1000, 0)} k€"
    if abs(value) >= 1000:
        return f"{fmt_number(value / 1000, 1)} k€"
    return f"{fmt_number(value, 0)} €"


class _HoverCanvas(QWidget):
    """Paints through a callable and remembers the mouse x for a crosshair."""

    def __init__(self, paint_fn) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._paint_fn = paint_fn
        self.hover_x: Optional[float] = None
        self.setMouseTracking(True)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding)
        self.setMinimumHeight(300)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self.hover_x = event.position().x()
        self.update()

    def leaveEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self.hover_x = None
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event) -> None:
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        self._paint_fn(painter, QRectF(self.rect()))
        painter.end()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Evolution
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class EvolutionPanel(QWidget):
    benchmark_changed = Signal(object)      # benchmark key or None

    def __init__(self, session: Session, user_id: int, theme: dict) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._session = session
        self._user_id = user_id
        self._t = theme
        self._history = PortfolioHistory()
        self._points: List[HistoryPoint] = []
        self._period = "Todo"
        self._build()

    def _build(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 16, 20, 16)

        self._card = QFrame()
        self._card.setObjectName("chartCard")
        card = QVBoxLayout(self._card)
        card.setContentsMargins(20, 14, 20, 14)
        card.setSpacing(10)

        header = QHBoxLayout()
        title = QLabel("Evolución de la cartera")
        title.setObjectName("chartTitle")
        header.addWidget(title)
        header.addStretch()
        self._period_group = QButtonGroup(self)
        self._period_group.setExclusive(True)
        for label, _days in PERIODS:
            button = QPushButton(label)
            button.setObjectName("periodButton")
            button.setCheckable(True)
            button.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
            button.setFixedHeight(28)
            button.setChecked(label == self._period)
            button.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, p=label: self._set_period(p))
            self._period_group.addButton(button)
            header.addWidget(button)
        header.addSpacing(12)
        self._cmb_benchmark = QComboBox()
        self._cmb_benchmark.setObjectName("filterCombo")
        self._cmb_benchmark.setFixedHeight(30)
        self._cmb_benchmark.addItem("Sin índice de referencia", None)
        for key, bench in BENCHMARKS.items():
            self._cmb_benchmark.addItem(f"Comparar con {bench.name}", key)
        saved = QSettings("FAMILYFIN", "FAMILYFIN").value(BENCHMARK_SETTING, DEFAULT_BENCHMARK)
        index = self._cmb_benchmark.findData(saved or None)
        self._cmb_benchmark.setCurrentIndex(max(index, 0))
        self._cmb_benchmark.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_benchmark_changed)
        header.addWidget(self._cmb_benchmark)
        card.addLayout(header)

        self._legend = QHBoxLayout()
        self._legend.setSpacing(6)
        card.addLayout(self._legend)

        self._canvas = _HoverCanvas(self._paint)
        card.addWidget(self._canvas, 1)

        self._lbl_summary = QLabel("")
        self._lbl_summary.setObjectName("chartSummary")
        self._lbl_summary.setWordWrap(True)
        card.addWidget(self._lbl_summary)
        root.addWidget(self._card, 1)

    # -- data --------------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def benchmark_key(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self._cmb_benchmark.currentData()

    def reload(self, broker: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        self._history = portfolio_history(self._session, self._user_id, broker=broker,
                                          benchmark_key=self.benchmark_key)
        self._apply_period()

    def _on_benchmark_changed(self, *_args) -> None:
        QSettings("FAMILYFIN", "FAMILYFIN").setValue(BENCHMARK_SETTING, self.benchmark_key or "")
        self.benchmark_changed.emit(self.benchmark_key)

    def _set_period(self, period: str) -> None:
        self._period = period
        self._apply_period()

    def _period_start(self) -> Optional[date]:
        points = self._history.points
        if not points:
            return None
        end = points[-1].day
        days = dict(PERIODS)[self._period]
        if days is None:
            return None
        if days == "ytd":
            return date(end.year, 1, 1)
        return end - timedelta(days=days)

    def _apply_period(self) -> None:
        self._points = self._history.since(self._period_start())
        self._rebuild_legend()
        self._update_summary()
        self._canvas.update()

    def _rebuild_legend(self) -> None:
        while self._legend.count():
            item = self._legend.takeAt(0)
            if item.widget():
                item.widget().deleteLater()
        entries = [(self._t["investment"], "Valor de la cartera", "●"),
                   (self._t["text_secondary"], "Capital invertido", "┅")]
        if self._has_benchmark():
            entries.append((BENCHMARK_COLOR, f"Mismo dinero en {self._history.benchmark_name}", "●"))
        for color, text, glyph in entries:
            dot = QLabel(glyph)
            dot.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 12px; background: transparent;")
            self._legend.addWidget(dot)
            label = QLabel(text)
            label.setObjectName("chartLegendLabel")
            self._legend.addWidget(label)
            self._legend.addSpacing(12)
        self._legend.addStretch()

    def _has_benchmark(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self._history.benchmark_name) and any(
            p.benchmark_eur is not None for p in self._points)

    def _update_summary(self) -> None:
        points = self._points
        if len(points) < 2:
            self._lbl_summary.setText("")
            return
        first, last = points[0], points[-1]
        # Value minus FIFO cost = unrealized gain; its change is independent of
        # how much money was put in or taken out during the period.
        start_gain = first.value_eur - first.invested_eur
        end_gain = last.value_eur - last.invested_eur
        text = (f"Del {fmt_date(first.day)} al {fmt_date(last.day)} la plusvalía latente ha pasado "
                f"de {fmt_eur(start_gain, signed=True)} a {fmt_eur(end_gain, signed=True)} "
                f"({fmt_eur(end_gain - start_gain, signed=True)}).")
        if self._has_benchmark() and first.benchmark_eur is not None and last.benchmark_eur is not None:
            diff = last.value_eur - last.benchmark_eur
            text += (f" Frente a {self._history.benchmark_name}: "
                     f"{fmt_eur(diff, signed=True)} {'a tu favor' if diff >= 0 else 'en contra'} hoy.")
        self._lbl_summary.setText(text)

    # -- painting ------------------------------------------------------------
    def _paint(self, painter: QPainter, rect: QRectF) -> None:
        t = self._t
        points = self._points
        if len(points) < 2:
            painter.setPen(QColor(t["text_secondary"]))
            painter.drawText(rect, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter,
                             "Aún no hay historial suficiente para dibujar la evolución.")
            return
        pad_l, pad_r, pad_t, pad_b = 64.0, 14.0, 10.0, 26.0
        area = QRectF(rect.x() + pad_l, rect.y() + pad_t,
                      rect.width() - pad_l - pad_r, rect.height() - pad_t - pad_b)
        show_bench = self._has_benchmark()
        values = [p.value_eur for p in points] + [p.invested_eur for p in points]
        if show_bench:
            values += [p.benchmark_eur for p in points if p.benchmark_eur is not None]
        low, high = min(values), max(values)
        span = (high - low) or max(abs(high), 1.0)
        low, high = max(0.0, low - span * 0.08), high + span * 0.08
        d0, d1 = points[0].day.toordinal(), points[-1].day.toordinal()
        dspan = max(d1 - d0, 1)

        def x_of(day: date) -> float:
            return area.left() + area.width() * (day.toordinal() - d0) / dspan
```
