## `app/web/routers/help.py`

```python
"""Manual de usuario (docs/manual) served by the web front-end.

* GET /ayuda/               the manual page
* GET /ayuda/img/{name}     its screenshots
* GET /ayuda/manual.pdf     the same manual as a PDF

Public on purpose (also linked from /login): the manual only shows the
demo data. The page is a self-contained document with an inline <style>
and <script>, so it carries its own CSP instead of the app's (the
hardening middleware keeps headers a response already sets): the script
is allowed by its hash, never by 'unsafe-inline'.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import re
from functools import lru_cache

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, RedirectResponse, Response

from app.manual import MANUAL_IMAGES, MANUAL_INDEX, MANUAL_PDF

router = APIRouter()

_IMAGE_NAME = re.compile(r"^[\w.-]+\.png$")
_SCRIPT = re.compile(r"<script>(.*?)</script>", re.S)
_BRAND = '<div class="brand">'
# The manual's header logo leads back to the app.
_BRAND_LINK = '<a class="brand" href="/" title="Volver a FAMILYFIN" style="text-decoration:none">'


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _manual(mtime: float) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
    html = MANUAL_INDEX.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    head, sep, tail = html.partition(_BRAND)
    if sep:
        html = head + _BRAND_LINK + tail.replace("</div>", "</a>", 1)
    hashes = " ".join(
        "'sha256-" + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(body.encode("utf-8")).digest()).decode() + "'"
        for body in _SCRIPT.findall(html)
    )
    csp = (
        "default-src 'self'; "
        f"script-src {hashes or chr(39) + 'none' + chr(39)}; "
        "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; "
        "img-src 'self' data:; "
        "font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; "
        "connect-src 'none'; "
        "object-src 'none'; "
        "base-uri 'none'; "
        "form-action 'none'; "
        "frame-ancestors 'none'"
    )
    return html.encode("utf-8"), csp


@router.get("/ayuda", include_in_schema=False)
def help_redirect() -> Response:
    # The page's images are relative (img/...): they need the trailing slash.
    return RedirectResponse("/ayuda/", status_code=303)


@router.get("/ayuda/")
def help_page() -> Response:
    if not MANUAL_INDEX.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    body, csp = _manual(MANUAL_INDEX.stat().st_mtime)
    return Response(body, media_type="text/html; charset=utf-8",
                    headers={"Content-Security-Policy": csp})


@router.get("/ayuda/img/{name}")
def help_image(name: str) -> Response:
    path = MANUAL_IMAGES / name
    if not _IMAGE_NAME.match(name) or not path.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    return FileResponse(path, media_type="image/png", headers={"Cache-Control": "max-age=86400"})


@router.get("/ayuda/manual.pdf")
def help_pdf() -> Response:
    if not MANUAL_PDF.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    return FileResponse(MANUAL_PDF, media_type="application/pdf", filename=MANUAL_PDF.name)

```

## `app/web/routers/imports.py`

```python
"""Importar: CaixaBank statement upload → preview with duplicates → confirm.

One or several statements of one account are uploaded together. Each file
is checked (size, extension, real Excel signature), parsed on the PC in a
private temp folder, and the preview of all of them is kept server-side
under a random token bound to the user and the browser session. Files that
cannot be used are listed with their reason; the rest can still be imported.
Nothing is written until the user confirms; the temp folder is deleted on
confirm, cancel or expiry.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import math
import re
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
from urllib.parse import urlencode

from fastapi import APIRouter, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, Request, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, Response
from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.models import Account, AuditAction, ImportBatch, Transaction
from app.web.deps import DB, USER, WebUser, notify_change
from app.web.render import audit, parse_int, render
from app.web.uploads import remove_directory

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()

MAX_FILE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_FILES = 12
MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024        # within security.MAX_STATEMENTS_BODY
EXTENSIONS = {".xls": b"\xd0\xcf\x11\xe0", ".xlsx": b"PK\x03\x04"}   # OLE2 / ZIP signatures
UNAVAILABLE = ("La importación no está disponible en este equipo: Windows ha bloqueado una librería "
               "necesaria (pandas). Puedes importar el extracto desde la aplicación de escritorio más tarde.")

# The ingestion pipeline (and pandas, whose native DLLs Windows Smart App
# Control can block) is imported inside the handlers, so a blocked pandas
# only disables importing instead of keeping the whole web server down.


class UploadRejected(ValueError):
    pass


def _safe_name(filename: Optional[str]) -> str:
    name = Path(filename or "").name                      # drop any path part
    stem, ext = Path(name).stem, Path(name).suffix.lower()
    stem = re.sub(r"[^\w .()-]", "_", stem).strip(" .")[:80] or "extracto"
    return f"{stem}{ext}"


def _read_upload(upload: UploadFile) -> tuple[str, bytes]:
    name = _safe_name(upload.filename)
    ext = Path(name).suffix
    if ext not in EXTENSIONS:
        raise UploadRejected("El fichero debe ser un extracto de CaixaBank en Excel (.xls o .xlsx).")
    data = upload.file.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES + 1)
    if len(data) > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
        raise UploadRejected("El fichero es demasiado grande (máximo 5 MB).")
    if not data:
        raise UploadRejected("El fichero está vacío.")
    if not data.startswith(EXTENSIONS[ext]):
        raise UploadRejected("El fichero no es un Excel válido.")
    return name, data


def _store(request: Request):
    return request.app.state.imports


def _page(request: Request, db: Session, user: WebUser, error: Optional[str] = None,
          account_id: Optional[int] = None, reasons: Sequence[Tuple[str, str]] = ()) -> Response:
    batches = (
        db.query(ImportBatch).filter(ImportBatch.user_id == user.id)
        .order_by(ImportBatch.import_timestamp.desc()).limit(5).all()
    )
    return render(request, "importar.html", {
        "accounts": db.query(Account).filter(Account.user_id == user.id).order_by(Account.id).all(),
        "account_id": account_id, "error": error, "reasons": reasons,
        "batches": batches, "max_mb": MAX_FILE_BYTES // (1024 * 1024),
        "max_files": MAX_FILES, "max_total_mb": MAX_TOTAL_BYTES // (1024 * 1024),
    }, user=user, active="importar")


def _failed(request: Request, db: Session, user: WebUser, account_id: Optional[int],
            rejected: Sequence[Tuple[str, str]]) -> Response:
    """No file of the upload can be used: one reason, or one per file."""
    if len(rejected) == 1:
        return _page(request, db, user, error=rejected[0][1], account_id=account_id)
    return _page(request, db, user, error="Ninguno de los extractos se puede importar:",
                 account_id=account_id, reasons=rejected)


@router.get("/importar")
def import_page(request: Request, user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    return _page(request, db, user)


@router.post("/importar")
def import_upload(
    request: Request,
    ficheros: List[UploadFile] = File(...),
    cuenta: str = Form(""),
    user: WebUser = USER,
    db: Session = DB,
) -> Response:
    account_id = parse_int(cuenta)
    chosen = [f for f in ficheros if f.filename]     # an empty part when nothing was picked
    if not chosen:
        return _page(request, db, user, error="Elige al menos un extracto.", account_id=account_id)
    if len(chosen) > MAX_FILES:
        return _page(request, db, user, error=f"Sube como máximo {MAX_FILES} extractos a la vez.",
                     account_id=account_id)
    accepted: List[Tuple[str, bytes]] = []
    rejected: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    total = 0
    for upload in chosen:
        try:
            name, data = _read_upload(upload)
        except UploadRejected as exc:
            rejected.append((_safe_name(upload.filename), str(exc)))
            continue
        total += len(data)
        if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
            return _page(request, db, user, account_id=account_id,
                         error=f"Los extractos suman más de {MAX_TOTAL_BYTES // (1024 * 1024)} MB. "
                               "Súbelos en varias veces.")
        accepted.append((name, data))
    if not accepted:
        return _failed(request, db, user, account_id, rejected)
    try:
        from app.ingestion.import_service import ensure_default_account
        from app.ingestion.importer import NoUsableStatement, RejectedFile, prepare_import
        from app.ingestion.validator import ValidationError
    except ImportError:
        logger.exception("Web: no se pudo cargar el módulo de importación")
        return _page(request, db, user, error=UNAVAILABLE, account_id=account_id)

    if account_id is None:
        account = ensure_default_account(db, user.id)
    else:
        account = db.get(Account, account_id)
        if account is None or account.user_id != user.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)

    store = _store(request)
    directory = store.new_directory()
    paths = []
    for n, (name, data) in enumerate(accepted, start=1):
        folder = directory / f"{n:02d}"
        folder.mkdir()
        paths.append(folder / name)
        paths[-1].write_bytes(data)
    try:
        # Sync endpoint: FastAPI runs it in a worker thread, so parsing never
        # blocks the server's event loop.
        preview = prepare_import(paths, db, user.id, account.id)
    except NoUsableStatement as exc:
        remove_directory(directory)
        if rejected or len(exc.rejected) > 1:
            return _failed(request, db, user, account.id, rejected + [(r.name, r.reason) for r in exc.rejected])
        return _page(request, db, user, error=f"No se pudo leer el extracto: {exc}", account_id=account.id)
    except (ValidationError, ValueError) as exc:
        remove_directory(directory)
        return _page(request, db, user, error=f"No se pudo leer el extracto: {exc}", account_id=account.id)
    except Exception:
        remove_directory(directory)
        logger.exception("Web: error inesperado al leer un extracto")
        return _page(request, db, user, error="No se pudo leer el extracto. ¿Es una exportación de CaixaBank?",
                     account_id=account.id)
    preview.rejected[:0] = [RejectedFile(name, reason) for name, reason in rejected]
    token = store.add(user.id, user.session.sid, account.id, [f.name for f in preview.files], directory, preview)
    return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/{token}", status_code=303)


def _pending(request: Request, user: WebUser, token: str):
    item = _store(request).get(token, user.id, user.session.sid)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    return item


def _num(value) -> Optional[float]:
    try:
        value = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return None if math.isnan(value) else value


def _rows(preview, indices: List[int], status: str) -> list:
    df = preview.df
    dup = preview.duplicate_result
    reasons = {**dup.skip_reasons, **dup.review_reasons}
    out = []
    for idx in indices:
        row = df.iloc[idx]
        day = row.get("transaction_date")
        out.append({
            "idx": idx,
            "date": day if isinstance(day, date) else None,
            "issuer": (row.get("issuer_name") or "") if isinstance(row.get("issuer_name"), str) else "",
            "concept": (row.get("concept") or "") if isinstance(row.get("concept"), str) else "",
            "amount": _num(row.get("amount")) or 0.0,
            "balance": _num(row.get("running_balance")),
            "status": status,
            "reason": reasons.get(idx, ""),
            "file": row.get("source_file") or "",
        })
    return out


# Registered before /importar/{token}, which would otherwise take "hecho".
@router.get("/importar/hecho")
def import_done(request: Request, lote: List[int] = Query([]), auto: int = 0,
                user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    ids = list(dict.fromkeys(lote))
    batches = db.query(ImportBatch).filter(ImportBatch.id.in_(ids), ImportBatch.user_id == user.id).all() if ids else []
    if not ids or len(batches) != len(ids):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    batches.sort(key=lambda b: ids.index(b.id))
    first, last = db.query(func.min(Transaction.transaction_date), func.max(Transaction.transaction_date)).filter(
        Transaction.user_id == user.id, Transaction.import_batch_id.in_(ids)).one()
    imported = sum(b.rows_imported for b in batches)
    return render(request, "importar_hecho.html", {
        "batches": batches, "imported": imported, "skipped": sum(b.rows_skipped for b in batches),
        "auto": max(0, min(auto, imported)), "first": first, "last": last,
    }, user=user, active="importar")


@router.get("/importar/{token}")
def import_preview(request: Request, token: str, user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    item = _pending(request, user, token)
    preview = item.preview
    dup = preview.duplicate_result
    rows = sorted(_rows(preview, dup.clean, "nuevo") + _rows(preview, dup.needs_review, "revisar"),
                  key=lambda r: (r["date"] or date.min, r["idx"]))
    skipped = _rows(preview, dup.auto_skip, "omitido")
    dates = [r["date"] for r in rows + skipped if r["date"]]
    account = db.get(Account, item.account_id)
    stats = preview.file_stats()
    return render(request, "importar_preview.html", {
        "token": token, "item": item, "account": account, "rows": rows, "skipped": skipped,
        "n_clean": len(dup.clean), "n_review": len(dup.needs_review), "n_skip": len(dup.auto_skip),
        "n_total": len(preview.df), "warnings": preview.warnings,
        "iban": preview.iban, "first": min(dates) if dates else None,
        "last": max(dates) if dates else None,
        "files": [(f, stats[f.name]) for f in preview.files], "rejected": preview.rejected,
        "many": len(preview.files) > 1,
    }, user=user, active="importar")


@router.post("/importar/{token}/confirmar")
def import_confirm(request: Request, token: str, importar: List[str] = Form([]),
                   user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    from app.ingestion.import_service import run_import   # loaded already: a preview exists

    item = _pending(request, user, token)
    review = set(item.preview.duplicate_result.needs_review)
    chosen = {parse_int(v) for v in importar}
    decisions = {idx: idx in chosen for idx in review}
    store = _store(request)
    try:
        result = run_import(db, user.id, item.preview, item.account_id, decisions)
    except LookupError:
        store.discard(token)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    store.discard(token)
    summary = result.summary
    for batch in db.query(ImportBatch).filter(ImportBatch.id.in_(summary.batch_ids)).order_by(ImportBatch.id):
        audit(db, request, user, "import_batches", batch.id, AuditAction.insert,
              new=f"extracto «{batch.filename}»: {batch.rows_imported} importados, {batch.rows_skipped} omitidos"
                  + (f" ({len(summary.batch_ids)} extractos, {result.auto_categorized} categorizados en total)"
                     if len(summary.batch_ids) > 1 else f", {result.auto_categorized} categorizados"))
    notify_change(request, user, "transactions")
    query = urlencode([("lote", i) for i in summary.batch_ids] + [("auto", result.auto_categorized)])
    return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/hecho?{query}", status_code=303)


@router.post("/importar/{token}/cancelar")
def import_cancel(request: Request, token: str, user: WebUser = USER) -> Response:
    if _store(request).get(token, user.id, user.session.sid) is not None:
        _store(request).discard(token)
    return RedirectResponse("/importar", status_code=303)

```

## `app/web/routers/investment_import.py`

```python
"""Inversiones: import a DEGIRO account statement from the web (W9d).

* GET  /inversiones/importar                    upload form
* POST /importar/inversiones                    upload → parse → token
* GET  /importar/inversiones/{token}            waiting page or editable preview
* POST /importar/inversiones/{token}/estado     poll a background step (htmx)
* POST /importar/inversiones/{token}/confirmar  symbols chosen → fetch data → import
* POST /importar/inversiones/{token}/cancelar
* GET  /importar/inversiones/{token}/hecho      result

The upload lives under /importar so it gets the upload body cap. The file is
parsed in a private temp folder that is deleted right away; the parsed
statement stays in memory under a random token bound to the user and the
browser session. Calls to Yahoo Finance (symbol suggestion, data of new
securities) run in a background thread and the page polls; the request is
never blocked on the network.

No duplicates: operations whose DEGIRO reference the user already has are
left out of the preview, ledger.import_drafts skips them again at write
time (another import may have happened meanwhile) and the database has a
unique index on (user, broker, broker_ref). A confirmed statement cannot be
confirmed twice: each pending import moves through its states under a lock.

MyInvestor statements need the movement kinds and estimated quantities
reviewed one by one: for now they are imported from the PC app only.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
import secrets
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import Future, ThreadPoolExecutor
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, Response
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.models import AuditAction
from app.investments.importers.base import KIND_BUY, KIND_IGNORE, KIND_SELL
from app.investments.importers.degiro import BROKER as DEGIRO, StatementError
from app.investments.importers.service import (
    ImportSummary,
    already_imported,
    apply_import,
    catalogue_isins,
    fetch_security_infos,
    parse_any,
    statement_cash_changes,
    symbols_to_fetch,
)
from app.investments.importers.symbols import listing_currency, suggest_symbols
from app.investments.market_data import MarketDataError
from app.investments.portfolio import LedgerError
from app.web.deps import DB, USER, WebUser, notify_change
from app.web.price_refresh import market_provider, start_price_refresh
from app.web.render import audit, is_htmx, render
from app.web.uploads import PendingImports, remove_directory

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()

TTL = 30 * 60
MAX_PER_USER = 3
MAX_FILE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
EXTENSIONS = (".xlsx", ".csv")
SYMBOL = re.compile(r"^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9.\-=^]{0,19}$")

# States of a pending import.
SEARCHING = "searching"      # symbol suggestions in the background
REVIEW = "review"            # preview shown, waiting for the user
FETCHING = "fetching"        # data of new securities in the background
APPLYING = "applying"        # writing (one request at a time)
DONE = "done"


class UploadRejected(ValueError):
    pass


@dataclass
class NewOperations:
    """The statement restricted to the operations the user does not have yet
    (what service.apply_import needs: broker, rows, products)."""
    broker: str
    rows: list
    products: Dict[str, dict]
    cash: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)    # the statement's newest balances
    cash_as_of: Optional[object] = None


@dataclass
class PendingStatement:
    token: str
    user_id: int
    sid: str
    filename: str
    statement: object                     # degiro.ParsedStatement
    pending: NewOperations
    known: int                            # operations already imported at upload time
    keys: List[str]                       # products of the new operations, display order
    state: str = SEARCHING
    job: Optional[Future] = None
    choices: Dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)    # key → SymbolChoice
    symbols: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)       # key → symbol typed
    error: Optional[str] = None
    summary: Optional[ImportSummary] = None
    cash_changes: Dict[str, tuple] = field(default_factory=dict)  # currency → (stored, statement)
    added: int = 0                        # operations written (result page)
    days: Optional[tuple] = None          # (first, last) trade date written
    created: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)
    lock: threading.Lock = field(default_factory=threading.Lock)

    @property
    def expired(self) -> bool:
        return time.monotonic() - self.created > TTL


class PendingStatements:
    """Parsed broker statements waiting for confirmation (memory only), and
    the worker threads that talk to the market-data provider."""

    def __init__(self, workers: int = 2) -> None:
        self._items: Dict[str, PendingStatement] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers, thread_name_prefix="familyfin-web-inv")

    def add(self, item: PendingStatement) -> str:
        with self._lock:
            self._sweep_locked()
            mine = sorted((p for p in self._items.values() if p.user_id == item.user_id),
                          key=lambda p: p.created)
            for old in mine[: max(0, len(mine) - MAX_PER_USER + 1)]:
                self._items.pop(old.token, None)
            self._items[item.token] = item
        return item.token

    def get(self, token: str, user_id: int, sid: str) -> Optional[PendingStatement]:
        with self._lock:
            self._sweep_locked()
            item = self._items.get(token)
            if item is None or item.user_id != user_id or item.sid != sid:
                return None
            return item

    def discard(self, token: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._items.pop(token, None)

    def submit(self, fn, *args) -> Future:
        return self._executor.submit(fn, *args)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._items.clear()

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.clear()
        self._executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            return len(self._items)

    def _sweep_locked(self) -> None:
        for token in [t for t, p in self._items.items() if p.expired]:
            self._items.pop(token, None)


def _store(request: Request) -> PendingStatements:
    return request.app.state.investment_imports


def _provider(request: Request):
    return market_provider(request.app)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Upload
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _safe_name(filename: Optional[str]) -> str:
    name = Path(filename or "").name
    stem, ext = Path(name).stem, Path(name).suffix.lower()
    stem = re.sub(r"[^\w .()-]", "_", stem).strip(" .")[:80] or "extracto"
    return f"{stem}{ext}"


def _read_upload(upload: UploadFile) -> tuple[str, bytes]:
    name = _safe_name(upload.filename)
    ext = Path(name).suffix
    if ext not in EXTENSIONS:
        raise UploadRejected("El fichero debe ser el «Estado de cuenta» de DEGIRO en Excel (.xlsx) o CSV.")
    data = upload.file.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES + 1)
    if len(data) > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
        raise UploadRejected("El fichero es demasiado grande (máximo 5 MB).")
    if not data:
        raise UploadRejected("El fichero está vacío.")
    if ext == ".xlsx" and not data.startswith(b"PK\x03\x04"):
        raise UploadRejected("El fichero no es un Excel válido.")
    if ext == ".csv":
        try:
            text = data.decode("utf-8-sig")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            raise UploadRejected("El CSV no está en UTF-8. Descárgalo de nuevo desde DEGIRO.") from None
        if "\x00" in text:
            raise UploadRejected("El fichero no es un CSV válido.")
    return name, data


def _upload_page(request: Request, user: WebUser, error: Optional[str] = None,
                 status_code: int = 200) -> Response:
    return render(request, "inv_importar.html", {
        "error": error, "max_mb": MAX_FILE_BYTES // (1024 * 1024),
    }, user=user, active="inversiones", status_code=status_code)


@router.get("/inversiones/importar")
def upload_page(request: Request, user: WebUser = USER) -> Response:
    return _upload_page(request, user)


def _new_operations(statement, known_refs: set) -> NewOperations:
    rows = [r for r in statement.rows if r.ref not in known_refs and r.kind != KIND_IGNORE]
    keys = {r.key for r in rows}
    products = {k: v for k, v in statement.products.items() if k in keys}
    return NewOperations(broker=statement.broker, rows=rows, products=products,
                         cash=dict(getattr(statement, "cash", None) or {}),
                         cash_as_of=getattr(statement, "cash_as_of", None))


@router.post("/importar/inversiones")
def upload(request: Request, fichero: UploadFile = File(...), user: WebUser = USER,
           db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    try:
        name, data = _read_upload(fichero)
    except UploadRejected as exc:
        return _upload_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400)
    # Private temp folder (swept with the CaixaBank uploads if the PC crashes).
    directory = PendingImports.new_directory()
    try:
        path = directory / name
        path.write_bytes(data)
        statement = parse_any(path)
    except StatementError as exc:
        return _upload_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400)
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Web: error inesperado al leer un extracto de bróker")
        return _upload_page(request, user, status_code=400,
                            error="No se pudo leer el extracto. ¿Es el «Estado de cuenta» de DEGIRO?")
    finally:
        remove_directory(directory)
    if statement.broker != DEGIRO:
        return _upload_page(request, user, status_code=400, error=(
            f"Desde la web, de momento, solo se importa el «Estado de cuenta» de DEGIRO. Los "
            f"movimientos de {statement.broker} se importan desde la aplicación del PC, donde se "
            "revisa el tipo de cada movimiento y las acciones estimadas."))

    known_refs = already_imported(db, user.id, statement)
    pending = _new_operations(statement, known_refs)
    keys = sorted(pending.products, key=lambda k: pending.products[k]["name"].lower())
    item = PendingStatement(
        token=secrets.token_urlsafe(18), user_id=user.id, sid=user.session.sid, filename=name,
        statement=statement, pending=pending, keys=keys,
        known=sum(1 for r in statement.rows if r.ref in known_refs),
        cash_changes=statement_cash_changes(db, user.id, statement))
    if pending.products:
        item.job = _store(request).submit(
            suggest_symbols, _provider(request), pending.products, catalogue_isins(db))
    else:
        item.state = REVIEW           # nothing new: show it straight away
    _store(request).add(item)
    return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/inversiones/{item.token}", status_code=303)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Preview
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _pending(request: Request, user: WebUser, token: str) -> PendingStatement:
    item = _store(request).get(token, user.id, user.session.sid)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    return item


def _symbol_rows(item: PendingStatement) -> List[dict]:
    rows = []
    for index, key in enumerate(item.keys):
        info = item.pending.products[key]
        choice = item.choices.get(key)
        chosen = item.symbols.get(key) or (choice.chosen if choice else "") or ""
        candidates = list(choice.candidates) if choice else []
        best = next((c for c in candidates if c.symbol == chosen), None)
        warn = False
        if choice is not None and choice.from_catalogue:
            detail = "Ya está en el catálogo"
        elif best is None and chosen:
            listing = listing_currency(chosen)
            warn = bool(listing and listing != info["currency"])
            detail = "Cotiza en otra divisa que la compra" if warn else "Elegido a mano"
        elif best is None:
            detail, warn = "Sin coincidencia: escribe el símbolo de Yahoo", True
        elif best.gap is not None:
            detail = f"{best.exchange} · precio {best.gap_text}"
        else:
            detail = f"{best.name} · {best.exchange} · compruébalo"
        rows.append({
            "index": index, "key": key, "name": info["name"], "currency": info["currency"],
            "symbol": chosen, "detail": detail, "warn": warn,
            "candidates": [(c.symbol, f"{c.name} · {c.exchange} · {c.gap_text}") for c in candidates],
            "operations": sum(1 for r in item.pending.rows if r.key == key),
        })
    return rows


def _operation_rows(item: PendingStatement) -> List[dict]:
    rows = []
    for r in sorted(item.pending.rows, key=lambda r: (r.day, r.ref), reverse=True):
        trade = r.kind in (KIND_BUY, KIND_SELL)
        rows.append({
            "day": r.day, "name": r.name, "kind": r.kind, "trade": trade,
            "quantity": r.quantity if trade else None,
            "price": r.price if trade else None, "currency": r.currency,
            "amount": r.amount_eur, "sign": -1 if r.kind == KIND_BUY else 1,
            "costs": r.fees_eur if trade else r.withheld_eur,
            "detail": r.gross_text if not trade else (r.note or ""),
        })
    return rows


def _preview(request: Request, user: WebUser, item: PendingStatement,
             status_code: int = 200) -> Response:
    st = item.statement
    trades = sum(1 for r in item.pending.rows if r.kind in (KIND_BUY, KIND_SELL))
    return render(request, "inv_importar_preview.html", {
        "token": item.token, "item": item, "first": st.first_day, "last": st.last_day,
        "n_trades": trades, "n_dividends": len(item.pending.rows) - trades,
        "n_known": item.known, "symbols": _symbol_rows(item), "rows": _operation_rows(item),
        "ignored": sorted(st.ignored.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]), "warnings": st.warnings,
        "error": item.error, "cash_changes": item.cash_changes,
    }, user=user, active="inversiones", status_code=status_code)


def _waiting(request: Request, user: WebUser, item: PendingStatement) -> Response:
    return render(request, "inv_importar_espera.html", {
        "token": item.token, "item": item, "importing": item.state == FETCHING,
    }, user=user, active="inversiones")


def _advance(request: Request, user: WebUser, db: Session, item: PendingStatement) -> None:
    """Move a finished background step on. Called with item.lock held."""
    if item.job is None or not item.job.done():
        return
    job, item.job = item.job, None
    if item.state == SEARCHING:
        try:
            item.choices = job.result()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.info("Web: búsqueda de símbolos fallida: %s", exc)
            item.choices = {}
            item.error = (f"No se pudo consultar Yahoo Finance ({exc}). "
                          "Escribe el símbolo de cada valor a mano.")
        item.state = REVIEW
    elif item.state == FETCHING:
        try:
            infos = job.result()
        except Exception as exc:
            message = str(exc) if isinstance(exc, MarketDataError) else f"Error: {exc}"
            item.error = f"No se pudieron obtener los datos de algún valor: {message}"
            item.state = REVIEW
            return
        _apply(request, user, db, item, infos)


def _apply(request: Request, user: WebUser, db: Session, item: PendingStatement, infos) -> None:
    item.state = APPLYING
    try:
        summary = apply_import(db, user.id, item.pending, item.symbols, infos)
    except LedgerError as exc:
        item.error, item.state = f"No se ha importado nada: {exc}", REVIEW
        return
    except IntegrityError:
        # The unique (user, broker, broker_ref) index caught an operation
        # imported meanwhile from another window or the PC app.
        db.rollback()
        item.error, item.state = ("No se ha importado nada: algunas operaciones se acaban de importar "
                                  "desde otra ventana. Vuelve a subir el extracto."), REVIEW
        return
    item.summary, item.state, item.error = summary, DONE, None
    result = summary.result
    # Plain values for the result page: the ORM rows detach with this session.
    days = [t.trade_date for t in result.added]
    item.added, item.days = len(result.added), (min(days), max(days)) if days else None
    audit(db, request, user, "investment_transactions", None, AuditAction.insert,
          new=f"extracto {item.pending.broker} «{item.filename}»: {summary.trades} compras/ventas, "
              f"{summary.dividends} dividendos, {result.skipped} ya importadas"
              + (f", efectivo {item.pending.cash}" if summary.cash_updated else ""))
    notify_change(request, user, "investments")
    if result.added:
        # Like the desktop import: download the history of the new securities.
        start_price_refresh(request.app, user.id)


@router.get("/importar/inversiones/{token}")
def preview(request: Request, token: str, user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    item = _pending(request, user, token)
    with item.lock:
        if item.state == SEARCHING:       # writes happen only on the POST /estado
            _advance(request, user, db, item)
        state = item.state
    if state == DONE:
        return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/inversiones/{token}/hecho", status_code=303)
    if state in (SEARCHING, FETCHING, APPLYING):
        return _waiting(request, user, item)
    return _preview(request, user, item)


@router.post("/importar/inversiones/{token}/estado")
def status(request: Request, token: str, user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    item = _pending(request, user, token)
    with item.lock:
        _advance(request, user, db, item)
        busy = item.state in (SEARCHING, FETCHING, APPLYING)
    if busy and is_htmx(request):
        return render(request, "partials/inv_import_poll.html", {"token": token}, user=user)
    target = f"/importar/inversiones/{token}" + ("/hecho" if item.state == DONE else "")
    if is_htmx(request):
        return Response(status_code=204, headers={"HX-Redirect": target})
    return RedirectResponse(target, status_code=303)


def _clean_symbol(value: str) -> str:
    return (value or "").strip().upper()


@router.post("/importar/inversiones/{token}/confirmar")
def confirm(request: Request, token: str, simbolo: List[str] = Form([]),
            user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    """`simbolo` holds one field per product, in the preview's order (item.keys)."""
    item = _pending(request, user, token)
    with item.lock:
        if item.state == SEARCHING:
            _advance(request, user, db, item)
        if item.state != REVIEW or not (item.pending.rows or item.cash_changes):
            # Already confirmed (double tap, second tab) or nothing to do: never twice.
            return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/inversiones/{token}", status_code=303)
        if len(simbolo) != len(item.keys):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400)
        symbols, problems = {}, []
        for key, value in zip(item.keys, simbolo):
            symbol = _clean_symbol(value)
            symbols[key] = symbol
            name = item.pending.products[key]["name"]
            if not symbol:
                problems.append(f"Falta el símbolo de «{name}».")
            elif not SYMBOL.match(symbol):
                problems.append(f"El símbolo «{symbol[:30]}» de «{name}» no es válido.")
        item.symbols = symbols
        if problems:
            item.error = " ".join(problems)
            return _preview(request, user, item, status_code=400)
        item.error = None
        to_fetch = symbols_to_fetch(db, symbols.values())
        if to_fetch:
            item.state = FETCHING
            item.job = _store(request).submit(fetch_security_infos, _provider(request), to_fetch)
            return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/inversiones/{token}", status_code=303)
        _apply(request, user, db, item, {})
        if item.state != DONE:
            return _preview(request, user, item, status_code=400)
    return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/inversiones/{token}/hecho", status_code=303)


@router.post("/importar/inversiones/{token}/cancelar")
def cancel(request: Request, token: str, user: WebUser = USER) -> Response:
    item = _store(request).get(token, user.id, user.session.sid)
    if item is not None:
        with item.lock:
            if item.state in (REVIEW, SEARCHING, DONE):
                _store(request).discard(token)
    return RedirectResponse("/inversiones/operaciones", status_code=303)


@router.get("/importar/inversiones/{token}/hecho")
def done(request: Request, token: str, user: WebUser = USER) -> Response:
    item = _pending(request, user, token)
    if item.state != DONE or item.summary is None:
        return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/inversiones/{token}", status_code=303)
    first, last = item.days or (None, None)
    return render(request, "inv_importar_hecho.html", {
        "item": item, "s": item.summary, "added": item.added, "first": first, "last": last,
    }, user=user, active="inversiones")

```

```python
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TABS = [

@router.post("/inversiones/cotizaciones/actualizar")

    outcome = start_price_refresh(request.app, user.id)
    if outcome == STARTED:
        audit(db, request, user, "price_history", None, AuditAction.update, new="actualizar cotizaciones")
    if not is_htmx(request):
        return RedirectResponse("/inversiones", status_code=303)
    return render(request, "partials/price_status.html",
                  {"pr": _price_status(request, recent=outcome == RECENT)}, user=user)


@router.get("/inversiones/cotizaciones/estado")

    """Polled while a refresh runs; when it has ended, reload the page content."""
    pr = _price_status(request)
    response = render(request, "partials/price_status.html", {"pr": pr}, user=user)
    result = pr["result"]
    if not pr["running"] and result is not None:
        if result.ok:

        else:

_MONTHS = ["", "ene", "feb", "mar", "abr", "may", "jun", "jul", "ago", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dic"]


def _day_label(day: date) -> str:
    return f"{day.day} {_MONTHS[day.month]} {day.year % 100:02d}"


def _history_chart(db: Session, user_id: int, period_key: str, benchmark: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    bench_key = benchmark if benchmark in BENCHMARKS else None
    history = portfolio_history(db, user_id, benchmark_key=bench_key)
    start: Optional[date] = None
    if history.points:
        end = history.points[-1].day
        days = {k: d for k, _, d in HISTORY_PERIODS}.get(period_key, 365)
        if days == "ytd":
            start = date(end.year, 1, 1)
        elif days is not None:
            start = end - timedelta(days=days)
    points = history.since(start)
    # One point per week beyond ~400 points keeps the phone chart smooth.
    step = max(1, len(points) // 400)
    sampled = points[::step]
    if points and sampled[-1] is not points[-1]:
        sampled.append(points[-1])
    series = [
        {"name": "Valor de la cartera", "color": "investment", "values": [round(p.value_eur, 2) for p in sampled]},
        {"name": "Capital invertido", "color": "muted", "dashed": True,
         "values": [round(p.invested_eur, 2) for p in sampled]},
    ]
    if history.benchmark_name and any(p.benchmark_eur is not None for p in sampled):
        series.append({"name": f"Mismo dinero en {history.benchmark_name}", "color": "accent",
                       "values": [None if p.benchmark_eur is None else round(p.benchmark_eur, 2)
                                  for p in sampled]})
    first, last = (points[0], points[-1]) if points else (None, None)
    return {
        "chart": {"type": "lines", "labels": [_day_label(p.day) for p in sampled], "series": series},
        "first": first,
        "last": last,
        "benchmark_name": history.benchmark_name,
    }


@router.get("/inversiones/evolucion")

    last = data["last"]

        **data,
        "periodo": periodo if periodo in {k for k, _, _ in HISTORY_PERIODS} else "1a",
        "periods": [(k, label) for k, label, _ in HISTORY_PERIODS],
        "benchmark": benchmark,
        "benchmarks": [("", "Sin índice")] + [(k, b.name) for k, b in BENCHMARKS.items()],
        "gain": gain,
    })

def _form_context(db: Session, user: WebUser, txn=None, error: Optional[str] = None,
                  values: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:

        "brokers": known_brokers(db, user.id),
    }


def _values_from_txn(txn) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    def num(value):
        return "" if value is None else f"{value:g}"
    return {
        "kind": InvestmentKind(txn.kind).value, "security_id": txn.security_id,
        "trade_date": txn.trade_date.isoformat(), "broker": txn.broker,
        "quantity": num(txn.quantity), "price": num(txn.price), "currency": txn.currency or "",
        "amount_eur": num(txn.amount_eur), "fees_eur": num(txn.fees_eur),
        "tax_withheld_eur": num(txn.tax_withheld_eur), "cash_paid_eur": num(txn.cash_paid_eur),
        "split_ratio": num(txn.split_ratio), "notes": txn.notes or "",
    }

                  _form_context(db, user, txn=txn, values=_values_from_txn(txn)), user=user)


@router.post("/inversiones/operaciones")
def save_operation(
    request: Request,
    operation_id: str = Form(""),
    kind: str = Form(...),
    security_id: str = Form(""),
    trade_date: str = Form(""),
    broker: str = Form("", max_length=64),
    quantity: str = Form(""),
    price: str = Form(""),
    currency: str = Form("", max_length=3),
    amount_eur: str = Form(""),
    fees_eur: str = Form(""),
    tax_withheld_eur: str = Form(""),
    cash_paid_eur: str = Form(""),
    split_ratio: str = Form(""),
    notes: str = Form("", max_length=1000),
    user: WebUser = USER,
    db: Session = DB,
) -> Response:
    values = dict(kind=kind, security_id=parse_int(security_id), trade_date=trade_date, broker=broker,
                  quantity=quantity, price=price, currency=currency, amount_eur=amount_eur,
                  fees_eur=fees_eur, tax_withheld_eur=tax_withheld_eur, cash_paid_eur=cash_paid_eur,
                  split_ratio=split_ratio, notes=notes)
    existing_id = parse_int(operation_id)
    txn = None
    if existing_id is not None:
        try:
            txn = get_transaction(db, user.id, existing_id)
        except LedgerError:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)

    def fail(message: str) -> Response:
        response = render(request, "partials/op_form.html",
                          _form_context(db, user, txn=txn, error=message, values=values),
                          user=user, status_code=200)
        return response

    op_kind = _kind(kind)
    day = parse_date(trade_date)
    if op_kind is None:
        return fail("Elige el tipo de operación.")
    if day is None:
        return fail("La fecha es obligatoria.")
    if day > date.today():
        return fail("La fecha no puede ser futura.")
    security = db.get(Security, values["security_id"]) if values["security_id"] else None
    if security is None:
        return fail("Selecciona un valor.")
    draft = TransactionDraft(
        security_id=security.id,
        kind=op_kind,
        trade_date=day,
        broker=broker,
        quantity=parse_float(quantity),
        price=parse_float(price),
        currency=(currency or security.currency or "EUR").strip()[:3] or None,
        amount_eur=parse_float(amount_eur) or 0.0,
        fees_eur=parse_float(fees_eur) or 0.0,
        tax_withheld_eur=parse_float(tax_withheld_eur) or 0.0,
        cash_paid_eur=parse_float(cash_paid_eur),
        split_ratio=parse_float(split_ratio),
        notes=notes,
        broker_ref=txn.broker_ref if txn is not None else None,
        id=existing_id,
    )
    try:
        saved = save_transaction(db, user.id, draft)
    except LedgerError as exc:
        return fail(str(exc))
    audit(db, request, user, "investment_transactions", saved.id,
          AuditAction.update if existing_id else AuditAction.insert,
          new=f"{op_kind.value} {security.symbol} {day.isoformat()} {draft.amount_eur:.2f} EUR")
    notify_change(request, user, "investments")
    response = Response(status_code=204)
    if is_htmx(request):
        hx_trigger(response, toast="Operación guardada", closeSheet=True, refreshPage=True)
    return response


@router.post("/inversiones/operaciones/{operation_id}/borrar")
def remove_operation(request: Request, operation_id: int, user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    try:
        txn = get_transaction(db, user.id, operation_id)
    except LedgerError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    summary = f"{InvestmentKind(txn.kind).value} security={txn.security_id} {txn.trade_date.isoformat()}"
    try:
        delete_transaction(db, user.id, operation_id)
    except LedgerError as exc:
        return render(request, "partials/op_form.html",
                      _form_context(db, user, txn=txn, error=str(exc), values=_values_from_txn(txn)),
                      user=user)
    audit(db, request, user, "investment_transactions", operation_id, AuditAction.delete, old=summary)
    notify_change(request, user, "investments")
    response = Response(status_code=204)
    hx_trigger(response, toast="Operación eliminada", closeSheet=True, refreshPage=True)
    return response

def _years(db: Session, user_id: int) -> List[int]:
    return report_years(db, user_id) or [date.today().year]


@router.get("/inversiones/fiscal")
def tax(request: Request, anio: Optional[int] = None, user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    years = _years(db, user.id)
    year = anio if anio in years else years[0]
    return _page(request, "inv_fiscal.html", "fiscal", user, {
        "years": years, "year": year, "r": tax_report(db, user.id, year),
    })


@router.get("/inversiones/fiscal/{year}.xlsx")
def tax_xlsx(year: int, user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    if year not in _years(db, user.id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    report = tax_report(db, user.id, year)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="familyfin-web-") as folder:
        path = export_xlsx(report, Path(folder) / f"fiscalidad_{year}.xlsx", owner=user.username)
        content = Path(path).read_bytes()
    return Response(
        content,
        media_type="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="FAMILYFIN_fiscalidad_{year}.xlsx"'},
    )
```

## `app/web/routers/library.py`

```python
"""Biblioteca de categorías: export / import of the user's categories and rules.

* GET  /mas/categorias/biblioteca            export button + upload form
* GET  /mas/categorias/exportar               the .profin-cats.json download
* POST /importar/categorias                   upload → server-side preview token
* GET  /importar/categorias/{token}?modo=…    preview (merge / replace)
* POST /importar/categorias/{token}/confirmar apply, audit, refresh the PC app

The upload lives under /importar so it gets the upload body cap. The parsed
file stays on the server under a random token bound to the user and the
browser session (never in the browser). Global rules are never imported
from the web: they are changed only from the PC app.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import secrets
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, Response
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.categorization import library_io
from app.db.models import AuditAction
from app.web.deps import DB, USER, WebUser, notify_change
from app.web.render import audit, render

router = APIRouter()

TTL = 15 * 60
MAX_PER_USER = 3


@dataclass
class PendingLibrary:
    token: str
    user_id: int
    sid: str
    filename: str
    lib: library_io.LibraryFile
    created: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)

    @property
    def expired(self) -> bool:
        return time.monotonic() - self.created > TTL


class PendingLibraries:
    """Parsed library files waiting for confirmation (in memory only)."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._items: Dict[str, PendingLibrary] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def add(self, user_id: int, sid: str, filename: str, lib: library_io.LibraryFile) -> str:
        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(18)
        with self._lock:
            self._sweep_locked()
            mine = sorted((p for p in self._items.values() if p.user_id == user_id), key=lambda p: p.created)
            for old in mine[: max(0, len(mine) - MAX_PER_USER + 1)]:
                self._items.pop(old.token, None)
            self._items[token] = PendingLibrary(token, user_id, sid, filename, lib)
        return token

    def get(self, token: str, user_id: int, sid: str) -> Optional[PendingLibrary]:
        with self._lock:
            self._sweep_locked()
            item = self._items.get(token)
            if item is None or item.user_id != user_id or item.sid != sid:
                return None
            return item

    def discard(self, token: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._items.pop(token, None)

    def _sweep_locked(self) -> None:
        for token in [t for t, p in self._items.items() if p.expired]:
            self._items.pop(token, None)


def _store(request: Request) -> PendingLibraries:
    return request.app.state.library_imports


def _page(request: Request, user: WebUser, error: Optional[str] = None, status_code: int = 200) -> Response:
    return render(request, "mas_biblioteca.html", {
        "error": error, "suffix": library_io.FILE_SUFFIX,
        "max_kb": library_io.MAX_FILE_BYTES // 1024,
    }, user=user, active="categorias", status_code=status_code)


@router.get("/mas/categorias/biblioteca")
def library_page(request: Request, user: WebUser = USER) -> Response:
    return _page(request, user)


@router.get("/mas/categorias/exportar")
def library_export(user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    payload = library_io.export_library(db, user.id, include_global=False, source_user=user.username)
    filename = library_io.suggested_filename(user.username)
    return Response(
        library_io.dumps(payload),
        media_type="application/json",
        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{filename}"'},
    )


@router.post("/importar/categorias")
def library_upload(request: Request, fichero: UploadFile = File(...), user: WebUser = USER) -> Response:
    data = fichero.file.read(library_io.MAX_FILE_BYTES + 1)
    if not data:
        return _page(request, user, error="El archivo está vacío.", status_code=400)
    try:
        lib = library_io.parse_library(data)
    except library_io.LibraryError as exc:
        return _page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400)
    name = (fichero.filename or "biblioteca").replace("\\", "/").rsplit("/", 1)[-1][:100]
    token = _store(request).add(user.id, user.session.sid, name, lib)
    return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/categorias/{token}", status_code=303)


def _pending(request: Request, user: WebUser, token: str) -> PendingLibrary:
    item = _store(request).get(token, user.id, user.session.sid)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    return item


def _rule_text(rule: library_io.LibRule) -> str:
    return (f"«{rule.pattern}»{library_io.movement_note(rule.transaction_type)} → "
            f"{rule.type} › {rule.category} (prioridad {rule.priority})")


def _mode(value: Optional[str]) -> str:
    return library_io.MODE_REPLACE if value == library_io.MODE_REPLACE else library_io.MODE_MERGE


@router.get("/importar/categorias/{token}")
def library_preview(request: Request, token: str, modo: Optional[str] = None,
                    user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    item = _pending(request, user, token)
    mode = _mode(modo)
    plan = library_io.plan_import(db, user.id, item.lib, mode, allow_global=False)
    return render(request, "mas_biblioteca_preview.html", {
        "token": token, "item": item, "plan": plan, "mode": mode,
        "new_rules": [_rule_text(r) for r in plan.new_rules],
        "priority_changes": [f"«{r.pattern}»: prioridad {old} → {r.priority}"
                             for r, old in plan.priority_changes],
    }, user=user, active="categorias")


@router.post("/importar/categorias/{token}/confirmar")
def library_confirm(request: Request, token: str, modo: str = Form(library_io.MODE_MERGE),
                    entiendo: str = Form(""), user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    item = _pending(request, user, token)
    mode = _mode(modo)
    if mode == library_io.MODE_REPLACE and not entiendo and             library_io.plan_import(db, user.id, item.lib, mode).deleted_rules:
        # Deleting rules needs the explicit tick on the preview.
        return RedirectResponse(f"/importar/categorias/{token}?modo={mode}", status_code=303)
    try:
        result = library_io.apply_import(db, user.id, item.lib, mode, allow_global=False)
    except library_io.LibraryError as exc:
        return _page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400)
    _store(request).discard(token)
    audit(db, request, user, "categories", None, AuditAction.insert,
          new=f"biblioteca «{item.filename}» ({mode}): "
              f"{result.types_created + result.categories_created} categorías, "
              f"{result.rules_created} reglas nuevas, {result.rules_updated} actualizadas, "
              f"{result.rules_deleted} borradas")
    notify_change(request, user, "transactions")
    return render(request, "mas_biblioteca_hecho.html", {
        "item": item, "result": result, "mode": mode,
    }, user=user, active="categorias")


@router.post("/importar/categorias/{token}/cancelar")
def library_cancel(request: Request, token: str, user: WebUser = USER) -> Response:
    if _store(request).get(token, user.id, user.session.sid) is not None:
        _store(request).discard(token)
    return RedirectResponse("/mas/categorias/biblioteca", status_code=303)
```

```python
"""Ajustes hub, accounts and import history (categories and rules: routers/admin.py;
family members: routers/users.py)."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import Response
from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.categorization.rules_engine import rule_scope
from app.config import DEMO_USERNAME
from app.db.models import (
    Account,
    AutoCategorizationRule,
    Category,
    CategoryLevel,
    ImportBatch,
    Transaction,
    User,
    TRANSACTIONS_NEWEST_FIRST,
)
from app.web.deps import DB, USER, WebUser
from app.web.render import render
from app.web.routers.users import can_manage_users, family_members

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/mas")
def more(request: Request, bienvenida: str = "", user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    counts = {
        "categorias": db.query(func.count(Category.id)).filter(
            Category.user_id == user.id, Category.level != CategoryLevel.type).scalar() or 0,
        "reglas": db.query(func.count(AutoCategorizationRule.id)).filter(
            rule_scope(db, user.id)).scalar() or 0,
        "cuentas": db.query(func.count(Account.id)).filter(Account.user_id == user.id).scalar() or 0,
        "importaciones": db.query(func.count(ImportBatch.id)).filter(ImportBatch.user_id == user.id).scalar() or 0,
    }
    last_import = (
        db.query(func.max(ImportBatch.import_timestamp)).filter(ImportBatch.user_id == user.id).scalar()
    )
    sessions = [s for s in request.app.state.sessions.active() if s.user_id == user.id]
    # Never list family names to the demo account (shown to visitors), and
    # it cannot change its password, name or delete itself.
    family = can_manage_users(db, user)
    members = family_members(db) if family else None
    me = db.get(User, user.id)
    invites = [
        {"id": inv.id, "expires_at": datetime.fromtimestamp(inv.expires)}
        for inv in request.app.state.invites.active_by(user.id)
    ] if family else []
    return render(request, "mas.html", {"counts": counts, "sessions": sessions, "last_import": last_import,
                                        "members": members, "demo_name": DEMO_USERNAME, "family": family,
                                        "member_since": me.created_at if me else None, "invites": invites,
                                        "welcome": bienvenida == "1" and not counts["categorias"]},
                  user=user, active="mas")


@router.get("/mas/cuentas")
def accounts(request: Request, user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    rows = db.query(Account).filter(Account.user_id == user.id).order_by(Account.account_name).all()
    stats = {
        account_id: (count, first, last)
        for account_id, count, first, last in db.query(
            Transaction.account_id, func.count(Transaction.id),
            func.min(Transaction.transaction_date), func.max(Transaction.transaction_date),
        ).filter(Transaction.user_id == user.id).group_by(Transaction.account_id)
    }
    balances = {}
    for account in rows:
        balances[account.id] = (
            db.query(Transaction.running_balance)
            .filter(Transaction.user_id == user.id, Transaction.account_id == account.id,
                    Transaction.running_balance.isnot(None))
            .order_by(*TRANSACTIONS_NEWEST_FIRST)
            .limit(1).scalar()
        )
    return render(request, "mas_cuentas.html", {"accounts": rows, "stats": stats, "balances": balances},
                  user=user, active="cuentas")


@router.get("/mas/importaciones")
def imports(request: Request, user: WebUser = USER, db: Session = DB) -> Response:
    rows = (
        db.query(ImportBatch).filter(ImportBatch.user_id == user.id)
        .order_by(ImportBatch.import_timestamp.desc()).limit(200).all()
    )
    return render(request, "mas_importaciones.html", {"batches": rows}, user=user, active="importar")
```
