```python
"""
tests/test_category_manager.py
===============================
First-run seeding and category CRUD — what "Cargar categorías por defecto"
and the Categorías screen rely on.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, event
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.db.database import _set_sqlite_pragma

from app.auth.auth_service import create_user
from app.categorization.category_manager import (
    assign_transaction_category,
    create_category,
    delete_category,
    get_all_categories,
    seed_default_categories,
    seed_default_rules,
    similar_uncategorized_ids,
    update_category_name,
)
from app.db.models import (
    CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL, Account, AutoCategorizationRule, Base, Category,
    CategoryLevel, Transaction, TransactionType,
)


@pytest.fixture
def session():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:")
    # Same connection setup as the app: ON DELETE SET NULL / CASCADE need
    # PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON.
    event.listen(engine, "connect", _set_sqlite_pragma)
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sess = sessionmaker(bind=engine)()
    yield sess
    sess.close()
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture
def user_id(session):
    return create_user(session, "ana", "clave-secreta-1").id


def test_seeding_is_idempotent_and_per_user(session, user_id):
    created = seed_default_categories(session, user_id)
    rules = seed_default_rules(session, user_id)
    assert created > 0 and rules > 0

    assert seed_default_categories(session, user_id) == 0
    assert seed_default_rules(session, user_id) == 0

    types = {c.name for c in get_all_categories(session, user_id, level=CategoryLevel.type)}
    assert types == {"GASTO", "INGRESO", "SERV. BANCARIO", "INVERSION"}
    other = create_user(session, "pedro", "clave-secreta-1").id
    assert get_all_categories(session, other) == []


def test_seeded_rules_point_to_the_users_own_categories(session, user_id):
    seed_default_categories(session, user_id)
    seed_default_rules(session, user_id)
    for rule in session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).all():
        assert rule.user_id == user_id
        assert rule.category.user_id == user_id
        assert rule.category.level == CategoryLevel.category


def test_duplicate_names_resolve_to_the_right_type(session, user_id):
    seed_default_categories(session, user_id)
    seed_default_rules(session, user_id)
    hbo_rule = (
        session.query(AutoCategorizationRule)
        .filter(AutoCategorizationRule.match_pattern == "HBO").one()
    )
    assert hbo_rule.category.parent.name == "GASTO"


def test_delete_category_uncategorizes_transactions_and_removes_rules(session, user_id):
    seed_default_categories(session, user_id)
    seed_default_rules(session, user_id)
    luz = next(c for c in get_all_categories(session, user_id) if c.name == "Luz")
    account = Account(user_id=user_id, account_name="Cuenta")
    session.add(account)
    session.flush()
    txn = Transaction(user_id=user_id, account_id=account.id,
                      transaction_date=date(2026, 9, 1), amount=-40.0,
                      type=TransactionType.expense, category_id=luz.id)
    session.add(txn)
    session.commit()

    delete_category(session, luz.id)

    session.refresh(txn)
    assert txn.category_id is None
    assert session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).filter_by(category_id=luz.id).count() == 0


def test_create_rename_and_validation(session, user_id):
    gasto = create_category(session, user_id, "GASTO", CategoryLevel.type,
                            transaction_type=TransactionType.expense)
    cat = create_category(session, user_id, "  Mascotas ", CategoryLevel.category, parent_id=gasto.id)
    assert cat.name == "Mascotas"
    assert update_category_name(session, cat.id, "Veterinario").name == "Veterinario"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        create_category(session, user_id, "Sin padre", CategoryLevel.category)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        update_category_name(session, cat.id, "   ")


def test_manual_assignment_is_marked_and_clearing_resets_source(session, user_id):
    gasto = create_category(session, user_id, "GASTO", CategoryLevel.type)
    cat = create_category(session, user_id, "Varios", CategoryLevel.category, parent_id=gasto.id)
    account = Account(user_id=user_id, account_name="Cuenta")
    session.add(account)
    session.flush()
    txn = Transaction(user_id=user_id, account_id=account.id,
                      transaction_date=date(2026, 9, 1), amount=-1.0,
                      type=TransactionType.expense)
    session.add(txn)
    session.commit()

    assign_transaction_category(session, txn.id, cat.id)
    assert (txn.category_id, txn.category_source) == (cat.id, CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL)
    assign_transaction_category(session, txn.id, None)
    assert (txn.category_id, txn.category_source) == (None, None)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        assign_transaction_category(session, 999_999, cat.id)


def test_apply_to_similar_only_touches_same_merchant_type_and_uncategorized(session, user_id):
    gasto = create_category(session, user_id, "GASTO", CategoryLevel.type)
    cat = create_category(session, user_id, "Supermercado", CategoryLevel.category, parent_id=gasto.id)
    other = create_category(session, user_id, "Varios", CategoryLevel.category, parent_id=gasto.id)
    account = Account(user_id=user_id, account_name="Cuenta")
    session.add(account)
    session.flush()

    def txn(issuer, amount=-10.0, kind=TransactionType.expense, concept=None, category_id=None, owner=user_id):
        t = Transaction(user_id=owner, account_id=account.id, transaction_date=date(2026, 9, 1),
                        amount=amount, type=kind, issuer_name=issuer, concept=concept,
                        category_id=category_id)
        session.add(t)
        session.flush()
        return t

    target = txn("EROSKI CITY URQUI", concept="EROSKI CITY URQUI | 04000022SIO COMPRA CON TARJETA")
    same = txn("eroski  city urqui ", concept="EROSKI CITY URQUI | 99999999XXX COMPRA CON TARJETA")
    refund = txn("EROSKI CITY URQUI", amount=5.0, kind=TransactionType.income)
    already = txn("EROSKI CITY URQUI", category_id=other.id)
    different = txn("EROSKI CENTER")
    pedro = create_user(session, "pedro", "clave-secreta-1").id
    foreign = txn("EROSKI CITY URQUI", owner=pedro)
    no_issuer = txn(None, concept="TRASPASO TARJETA DE CREDITO")
    no_issuer_same = txn(None, concept="Traspaso tarjeta de credito")
    session.commit()

    assert similar_uncategorized_ids(session, target.id) == [same.id]
    assert similar_uncategorized_ids(session, no_issuer.id) == [no_issuer_same.id]

    # Unticked: only the chosen movement changes.
    assert assign_transaction_category(session, target.id, cat.id) == 1
    assert same.category_id is None

    assert assign_transaction_category(session, target.id, cat.id, apply_to_similar=True) == 2
    assert (same.category_id, same.category_source) == (cat.id, CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL)
    assert refund.category_id is None and different.category_id is None and foreign.category_id is None
    assert already.category_id == other.id

    # Clearing never spreads to similar movements.
    assert assign_transaction_category(session, target.id, None, apply_to_similar=True) == 1
    assert same.category_id == cat.id


def test_rule_from_transaction_is_offered_once_and_fills_uncategorized(session, user_id):
    from app.categorization.admin_service import NotFound, add_rule_from_transaction, transaction_has_rule
    from app.db.models import CATEGORY_SOURCE_RULE, MatchType

    gasto = create_category(session, user_id, "GASTO", CategoryLevel.type)
    cat = create_category(session, user_id, "Supermercado", CategoryLevel.category, parent_id=gasto.id)
    account = Account(user_id=user_id, account_name="Cuenta")
    session.add(account)
    session.flush()
    txns = [Transaction(user_id=user_id, account_id=account.id, transaction_date=date(2026, 9, 1),
                        amount=-10.0, type=TransactionType.expense, issuer_name=issuer,
                        concept=f"{issuer} | 04000022SIO COMPRA CON TARJETA")
            for issuer in ("EROSKI CITY URQUI", "EROSKI CITY URQUI", "EROSKI CENTER")]
    session.add_all(txns)
    session.commit()
    target, twin, other = txns

    assert not transaction_has_rule(session, user_id, target.id)
    created = add_rule_from_transaction(session, user_id, target.id, cat.id)
    assert created is not None
    rule = created.rule
    assert (rule.match_pattern, rule.match_type, rule.user_id) == ("EROSKI CITY URQUI", MatchType.exact, user_id)
    assert set(created.categorized_ids) == {target.id, twin.id}
    assert (twin.category_id, twin.category_source) == (cat.id, CATEGORY_SOURCE_RULE)
    assert other.category_id is None                      # exact match only

    # A rule now covers it: not offered again, nothing new created.
    assert transaction_has_rule(session, user_id, twin.id)
    assert add_rule_from_transaction(session, user_id, twin.id, cat.id) is None
    assert session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).count() == 1

    pedro = create_user(session, "pedro", "clave-secreta-1").id
    with pytest.raises(NotFound):
        add_rule_from_transaction(session, pedro, other.id, cat.id)


def test_rule_from_transaction_is_limited_to_the_movement_type(session, user_id):
    """A rule made from a BIZUM paid only covers payments: a BIZUM received
    stays uncategorized and can get its own rule to an income category."""
    from app.categorization.admin_service import add_rule_from_transaction, transaction_has_rule

    gasto = create_category(session, user_id, "GASTO", CategoryLevel.type)
    ingreso = create_category(session, user_id, "INGRESO", CategoryLevel.type)
    ocio = create_category(session, user_id, "Ocio", CategoryLevel.category, parent_id=gasto.id)
    aporte = create_category(session, user_id, "Aporte", CategoryLevel.category, parent_id=ingreso.id)
    account = Account(user_id=user_id, account_name="Cuenta")
    session.add(account)
    session.flush()

    def bizum(amount):
        kind = TransactionType.expense if amount < 0 else TransactionType.income
        return Transaction(user_id=user_id, account_id=account.id, transaction_date=date(2026, 10, 1),
                           amount=amount, type=kind, issuer_name="BIZUM")

    paid, paid_later, received, received_later = txns = [bizum(a) for a in (-15.0, -8.0, 30.0, 12.0)]
    session.add_all(txns)
    session.commit()

    created = add_rule_from_transaction(session, user_id, paid.id, ocio.id)
    assert created.rule.transaction_type == TransactionType.expense
    assert set(created.categorized_ids) == {paid.id, paid_later.id}
    assert received.category_id is None and received_later.category_id is None

    assert not transaction_has_rule(session, user_id, received.id)
    created = add_rule_from_transaction(session, user_id, received.id, aporte.id)
    assert created.rule.transaction_type == TransactionType.income
    assert set(created.categorized_ids) == {received.id, received_later.id}
    assert received_later.category_id == aporte.id
```

```python
"""
tests/test_dashboard_summary.py
===============================
«Inversión» on the dashboard (desktop) and Resumen (web): movements in a
category of the investment type count as investment, not as income/expense.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.analytics.dashboard_summary import dashboard_summary, investment_category_ids
from app.auth.auth_service import create_user
from app.categorization.category_manager import seed_default_categories
from app.db.models import Account, Base, Category, Transaction, TransactionType

DAY = date(2026, 9, 15)


@pytest.fixture
def session():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sess = sessionmaker(bind=engine)()
    yield sess
    sess.close()
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture
def ana(session):
    user = create_user(session, "ana", "clave-secreta-1")
    seed_default_categories(session, user.id)
    account = Account(user_id=user.id, account_name="Cuenta")
    session.add(account)
    session.commit()
    return user.id, account.id


def _categories(session, user_id, name):
    return {c.id for c in session.query(Category).filter_by(user_id=user_id, name=name)}


def _category(session, user_id, name):
    (cid,) = _categories(session, user_id, name)
    return cid


def _add(session, user_id, account_id, amount, category_id=None, day=DAY):
    session.add(Transaction(
        user_id=user_id, account_id=account_id, transaction_date=day, amount=amount,
        type=TransactionType.expense if amount < 0 else TransactionType.income,
        issuer_name="X", category_id=category_id,
    ))
    session.commit()


def _summary(session, user_id):
    return dashboard_summary(session, user_id, date(2026, 9, 1), date(2026, 9, 30))


def test_seeded_investment_categories_are_found(session, ana):
    user_id, _ = ana
    ids = investment_category_ids(session, user_id)
    assert _category(session, user_id, "Aporte Broker") in ids
    assert _category(session, user_id, "Tressis") in ids
    assert _category(session, user_id, "INVERSION") in ids
    assert not _categories(session, user_id, "Hipoteca") & ids


def test_broker_transfer_counts_as_investment_not_expense(session, ana):
    user_id, account_id = ana
    broker = _category(session, user_id, "Aporte Broker")
    _add(session, user_id, account_id, -300.0, broker)
    _add(session, user_id, account_id, -50.0)                 # uncategorized: still an expense
    _add(session, user_id, account_id, 1000.0)

    s = _summary(session, user_id)

    assert s.investment == 300.0
    assert s.expense == 50.0
    assert s.income == 1000.0
    assert s.savings_rate == 95.0
    assert [name for name, _ in s.by_category] == ["Sin categorizar (1)"]
    assert [(m.income, m.expense) for m in s.monthly] == [(1000.0, 50.0)]


def test_money_back_from_the_broker_lowers_the_net_investment(session, ana):
    user_id, account_id = ana
    broker = _category(session, user_id, "Aporte Broker")
    _add(session, user_id, account_id, -300.0, broker)
    _add(session, user_id, account_id, 100.0, broker)

    s = _summary(session, user_id)

    assert s.investment == 200.0
    assert s.income == 0.0 and s.expense == 0.0


def test_no_investment_categories_keeps_the_old_figures(session):
    user = create_user(session, "beto", "clave-secreta-2")
    account = Account(user_id=user.id, account_name="Cuenta")
    session.add(account)
    session.commit()
    _add(session, user.id, account.id, -20.0)

    s = _summary(session, user.id)

    assert (s.expense, s.investment) == (20.0, 0.0)
```

```python
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from app.ingestion.excel_parser import parse_excel


def test_parse_excel_removes_repeated_caixabank_headers(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    header = [None] * 25
    header[4] = "F. Operación"
    header[5] = "F. Valor"

    first_transaction = [None] * 25
    first_transaction[1] = "2100 0000 00 0000000000"
    first_transaction[3] = "EUR"
    first_transaction[4] = "12/11/2021"
    first_transaction[5] = "10/11/2021"
    first_transaction[7] = 0.7
    first_transaction[8] = 100.0

    second_transaction = first_transaction.copy()
    second_transaction[4] = "11/11/2021"
    second_transaction[5] = "09/11/2021"

    raw = pd.DataFrame([
        [None] * 25,
        header,
        first_transaction,
        header,
        second_transaction,
    ])
    monkeypatch.setattr(pd, "read_excel", lambda *args, **kwargs: raw)

    source = tmp_path / "movimientos.xls"
    source.touch()
    result = parse_excel(Path(source))

    assert len(result) == 2
    assert result["transaction_date"].tolist() == [
        pd.Timestamp("2021-11-12").date(),
        pd.Timestamp("2021-11-11").date(),
    ]


def test_parse_excel_uses_negative_balance_column(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    """CaixaBank stores negative running balances in column 9 (Saldo -)."""
    header = [None] * 25
    header[4] = "F. Operación"
    header[5] = "F. Valor"
    header[8] = "Saldo (+)"
    header[9] = "Saldo (-)"

    positive_balance = [None] * 25
    positive_balance[1] = "2100 5602 67 1300043018"
    positive_balance[3] = "EUR"
    positive_balance[4] = "29/10/2021"
    positive_balance[5] = "29/10/2021"
    positive_balance[7] = 11.20
    positive_balance[8] = 1184.93

    negative_balance = positive_balance.copy()
    negative_balance[4] = "29/10/2021"
    negative_balance[7] = 36.36
    negative_balance[8] = None
    negative_balance[9] = -131.47

    raw = pd.DataFrame([[None] * 25, header, positive_balance,
                        negative_balance])
    monkeypatch.setattr(pd, "read_excel", lambda *args, **kwargs: raw)

    source = tmp_path / "movimientos.xls"
    source.touch()
    result = parse_excel(source)

    assert result["running_balance"].tolist() == [1184.93, -131.47]


def test_parse_excel_rounds_money_and_keeps_raw_details(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    header = [None] * 25
    header[4] = "F. Operación"

    row = [None] * 25
    row[1] = "2100 0000 00 0000000000"
    row[3] = "EUR"
    row[4] = "12/11/2021"
    row[7] = "12,339999999"
    row[8] = "100,004"
    row[14] = "Fecha de operación: 12-11-2021   MERCADONA"
    row[15] = "  TARJETA   1234 "
    row[16] = "COMPRA"

    raw = pd.DataFrame([header, row])
    monkeypatch.setattr(pd, "read_excel", lambda *args, **kwargs: raw)

    source = tmp_path / "movimientos.xls"
    source.touch()
    result = parse_excel(Path(source))

    assert result["amount"].tolist() == [-12.34]
    assert result["running_balance"].tolist() == [100.0]
    assert result["raw_details"].tolist() == ["TARJETA   1234 | COMPRA"]
    assert result["issuer_name"].tolist() == ["MERCADONA"]
```

## `tests/test_gui_smoke.py`

```python
"""
tests/test_gui_smoke.py
========================
Offscreen smoke test of the main shell: views are built lazily on first
navigation, the data views load from a throwaway database, and a theme
toggle reaches every built view. No real data folder is touched.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from datetime import date

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")

import pytest
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.auth.auth_service import create_user
from app.db.models import Account, Base, Transaction, TransactionType


@pytest.fixture
def qt_app():
    return QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])


@pytest.fixture
def session(tmp_path):
    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'profin.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sess = sessionmaker(bind=engine)()
    yield sess
    sess.close()
    engine.dispose()


def test_main_window_builds_views_lazily_and_themes_them(qt_app, session, monkeypatch, caplog):
    from app.gui import main_window as main_window_module

    # Automatic backups would snapshot the real data folder.
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window_module.MainWindow, "_run_auto_backup", lambda self: None)

    user = create_user(session, "ana", "clave-secreta-1")
    account = Account(user_id=user.id, account_name="Cuenta")
    session.add(account)
    session.flush()
    today = date.today()
    for amount in (-12.5, -7.25, 1500.0):
        session.add(Transaction(
            user_id=user.id, account_id=account.id, transaction_date=today,
            amount=amount,
            type=TransactionType.expense if amount < 0 else TransactionType.income,
            issuer_name="PRUEBA",
        ))
    session.commit()

    window = main_window_module.MainWindow(user=user, session=session, theme="light")
    window.show()  # as LoginWindow does after constructing it
    # Children added to an already visible window are shown by a queued call
    # on the next event-loop pass; the real app runs the loop, the test must.
    qt_app.processEvents()
    try:
        window._navigate("dashboard")
        assert set(window._views) == {"dashboard"}

        for key in ("expenses", "income", "investments", "transactions", "rules", "categories"):
            window._navigate(key)
            assert window._stack.currentWidget() is window._views[key]

        assert "import" not in window._views  # never visited → never built

        window._toggle_theme()
        for view in window._views.values():
            if hasattr(view, "_theme"):
                assert view._theme == window._theme

        window._navigate("unknown-view")
        assert window._current_view == "dashboard"

        # Views swallow load errors into the log; none may have happened.
        errors = [r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records if r.levelname in ("ERROR", "CRITICAL")]
        assert errors == []
        assert "2 transacciones" in window._views["expenses"]._lbl_count.text()
        assert "1 transacciones" in window._views["income"]._lbl_count.text()

        # The help button opens the bundled manual in the browser.
        opened = []
        monkeypatch.setattr(main_window_module.QDesktopServices, "openUrl", opened.append)
        window._btn_help.click()
        assert opened and opened[0].toLocalFile().endswith("docs/manual/index.html")
    finally:
        window.close()
        window.deleteLater()


def test_library_import_dialog_previews_merge_and_replace(qt_app, session):
    from app.categorization import library_io
    from app.categorization.category_manager import seed_default_categories, seed_default_rules
    from app.gui.library_dialog import LibraryImportDialog

    ana = create_user(session, "ana", "clave-secreta-1")
    beto = create_user(session, "beto", "clave-secreta-2")
    seed_default_categories(session, ana.id)
    seed_default_rules(session, ana.id)
    lib = library_io.parse_library(library_io.dumps(library_io.export_library(session, ana.id)))

    dialog = LibraryImportDialog(session, beto.id, lib, "ana.profin-cats.json")
    assert dialog.mode == library_io.MODE_MERGE and dialog.plan.has_changes
    assert dialog._ok.isEnabled()
    dialog._replace.setChecked(True)
    assert dialog.mode == library_io.MODE_REPLACE and dialog.plan.mode == library_io.MODE_REPLACE

    # Already up to date: nothing to import, the button is disabled.
    same = LibraryImportDialog(session, ana.id, lib, "ana.profin-cats.json")
    assert not same.plan.has_changes and not same._ok.isEnabled()

```

## `tests/test_import_pipeline.py`

```python
"""
tests/test_import_pipeline.py
==============================
End-to-end import of a real .xlsx laid out like a CaixaBank export:
parse → validate → duplicate check → commit → auto-categorize, then the
same file imported again must not create a single duplicate.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

import pytest
from openpyxl import Workbook
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.auth.auth_service import create_user
from app.categorization.category_manager import (
    seed_default_categories,
    seed_default_rules,
)
from app.categorization.rules_engine import apply_rules_and_commit
from app.db.models import (
    CATEGORY_SOURCE_RULE, Account, AuditLog, Category, ImportBatch,
    ImportStatus, Transaction, TransactionType,
)
from app.db.models import Base
from app.ingestion.importer import commit_import, prepare_import
from app.ingestion.validator import ValidationError

IBAN = "ES12 2100 0000 0000 0000 0000"


def _row(fecha, ingreso=None, gasto=None, saldo_pos=None, saldo_neg=None,
         comun="044", issuer="", details=(), iban=IBAN):
    row = [None] * 24
    row[1] = iban
    row[3] = "EUR"
    row[4] = fecha
    row[5] = fecha
    row[6] = ingreso
    row[7] = gasto
    row[8] = saldo_pos
    row[9] = saldo_neg
    row[10] = comun
    row[11] = "000"
    row[12] = "000000000000"
    row[14] = issuer
    for offset, text in enumerate(details):
        row[15 + offset] = text
    return row


def _write_export(path, rows):
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.append([None] * 24)
    ws.append([None, "MOVIMIENTOS DESDE 01/09/2026 HASTA 30/09/2026"] + [None] * 22)
    ws.append([None] * 24)
    # The real export labels every column, so the sheet is 24 columns wide
    # even when the trailing detail cells of every movement are empty.
    header = [f"Col {i}" for i in range(24)]
    header[4], header[5], header[6], header[7] = "F. Operación", "F. Valor", "Ingreso (+)", "Gasto (-)"
    ws.append(header)
    for row in rows:
        ws.append(row)
    wb.save(path)


EXPORT_ROWS = [
    _row("01/09/2026", gasto=45.3, saldo_pos=1954.7,
         issuer="Fecha de operación: 01-09-2026   IBERDROLA CLIENTES", details=("RECIBO LUZ",)),
    _row("02/09/2026", ingreso=1500.0, saldo_pos=3454.7, comun="012",
         issuer="MANPOWER TEAM E.T.T.", details=("NOMINA", "SEPTIEMBRE")),
    _row("03/09/2026", gasto=12.35, saldo_pos=3442.35, issuer="PANADERIA LOLA"),
    _row("04/09/2026", gasto=3500.0, saldo_neg=-57.65, issuer="TRANSFERENCIA A AHORRO"),
    _row("05/09/2026", gasto=0.0, saldo_neg=-57.65, comun="099", issuer="AJUSTE"),
]


@pytest.fixture
def session():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sess = sessionmaker(bind=engine)()
    yield sess
    sess.close()
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture
def family(session):
    user = create_user(session, "maria", "clave-secreta-1")
    account = Account(user_id=user.id, account_name="CaixaBank Principal")
    session.add(account)
    session.commit()
    seed_default_categories(session, user.id)
    seed_default_rules(session, user.id)
    return user.id, account.id


def _import(paths, session, user_id, account_id, decisions=None):
    """Mirror ImportView: clean rows are imported, review rows only if approved."""
    paths = paths if isinstance(paths, list) else [paths]
    preview = prepare_import(paths, session, user_id, account_id)
    chosen = {idx: True for idx in preview.duplicate_result.clean}
    chosen.update(decisions or {})
    summary = commit_import(preview, session, user_id, account_id, chosen)
    if summary.imported_ids:
        apply_rules_and_commit(session, summary.imported_ids, user_id)
    return preview, summary


def test_first_import_persists_categorizes_and_audits(tmp_path, session, family):
    user_id, account_id = family
    path = tmp_path / "movimientos.xlsx"
    _write_export(path, EXPORT_ROWS)

    preview, summary = _import(path, session, user_id, account_id)

    assert preview.iban == IBAN
    assert [w.rule for w in preview.warnings] == ["V-08"]
    assert summary.rows_imported == 5 and summary.rows_skipped == 0
    assert summary.status == ImportStatus.completed

    txns = {t.issuer_name: t for t in session.query(Transaction).all()}
    luz = txns["IBERDROLA CLIENTES"]
    assert luz.amount == -45.3 and luz.type == TransactionType.expense
    assert luz.transaction_date == date(2026, 9, 1)
    assert luz.raw_details == "RECIBO LUZ"
    assert luz.source_file == "movimientos.xlsx"
    assert session.get(Category, luz.category_id).name == "Luz"
    assert luz.category_source == CATEGORY_SOURCE_RULE

    nomina = txns["MANPOWER TEAM E.T.T."]
    assert nomina.amount == 1500.0 and nomina.type == TransactionType.income
    category = session.get(Category, nomina.category_id)
    assert (category.name, category.parent.name) == ("Nomina Maria", "INGRESO")

    assert txns["TRANSFERENCIA A AHORRO"].running_balance == -57.65
    assert txns["PANADERIA LOLA"].category_id is None
    assert txns["AJUSTE"].type == TransactionType.unknown

    audit_ids = {a.record_id for a in session.query(AuditLog).all()}
    assert audit_ids == {t.id for t in txns.values()}


def test_reimporting_the_same_file_creates_no_duplicates(tmp_path, session, family):
    user_id, account_id = family
    path = tmp_path / "movimientos.xlsx"
    _write_export(path, EXPORT_ROWS)
    _import(path, session, user_id, account_id)

    preview, summary = _import(path, session, user_id, account_id)

    dup = preview.duplicate_result
    assert sorted(dup.auto_skip) == [0, 1, 2, 3]
    assert dup.needs_review == [4]          # 0,00 € row: balance can't tell
    assert summary.rows_imported == 0
    assert session.query(Transaction).count() == 5
    assert session.query(ImportBatch).count() == 2


def test_overlapping_export_imports_only_new_rows(tmp_path, session, family):
    user_id, account_id = family
    first, second = tmp_path / "agosto.xlsx", tmp_path / "septiembre.xlsx"
    _write_export(first, EXPORT_ROWS[:3])
    _write_export(second, EXPORT_ROWS[1:4])
    _import(first, session, user_id, account_id)

    _, summary = _import(second, session, user_id, account_id)

    assert summary.rows_imported == 1
    assert summary.rows_skipped == 2
    assert session.query(Transaction).count() == 4


def test_unticked_clean_row_is_not_imported(tmp_path, session, family):
    # ImportView lets the user untick any row; a clean row set to False
    # used to be imported anyway.
    user_id, account_id = family
    path = tmp_path / "movimientos.xlsx"
    _write_export(path, EXPORT_ROWS)

    _, summary = _import(path, session, user_id, account_id, decisions={2: False})

    assert summary.rows_imported == 4 and summary.rows_skipped == 1
    assert "PANADERIA LOLA" not in {t.issuer_name for t in session.query(Transaction).all()}
    assert session.query(ImportBatch).one().rows_skipped == 1


def test_clean_rows_missing_from_the_decisions_are_imported(tmp_path, session, family):
    # The web sends decisions for the rows under review only.
    user_id, account_id = family
    path = tmp_path / "movimientos.xlsx"
    _write_export(path, EXPORT_ROWS)
    preview = prepare_import([path], session, user_id, account_id)

    summary = commit_import(preview, session, user_id, account_id, {})

    assert summary.rows_imported == 5


def test_same_day_movements_follow_the_bank_order(tmp_path, session, family):
    # CaixaBank lists a statement newest first; on a day with several
    # movements the latest balance is the one of the day's LAST movement.
    from app.analytics.dashboard_summary import dashboard_summary
    from app.analytics.transaction_search import filtered_transactions_page

    user_id, account_id = family
    path = tmp_path / "octubre.xlsx"
    _write_export(path, [
        _row("24/10/2026", gasto=20.0, saldo_pos=930.0, issuer="TERCERO"),
        _row("24/10/2026", gasto=30.0, saldo_pos=950.0, issuer="SEGUNDO"),
        _row("24/10/2026", ingreso=80.0, saldo_pos=980.0, issuer="PRIMERO"),
        _row("23/10/2026", gasto=100.0, saldo_pos=900.0, issuer="DIA ANTERIOR"),
    ])

    _import(path, session, user_id, account_id)

    summary = dashboard_summary(session, user_id, date(2026, 10, 1), date(2026, 10, 31))
    assert summary.balance == 930.0
    assert [r.issuer_name for r in summary.recent] == ["TERCERO", "SEGUNDO", "PRIMERO", "DIA ANTERIOR"]
    page, _ = filtered_transactions_page(
        session, user_id, session.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.user_id == user_id), "", 0, 10)
    assert [t.issuer_name for t in page] == ["TERCERO", "SEGUNDO", "PRIMERO", "DIA ANTERIOR"]

    # A later statement continues the numbering: its movements come after.
    later = tmp_path / "noviembre.xlsx"
    _write_export(later, [_row("24/10/2026", gasto=10.0, saldo_pos=920.0, issuer="CUARTO")])
    _import(later, session, user_id, account_id)
    assert dashboard_summary(session, user_id, date(2026, 10, 1), date(2026, 10, 31)).balance == 920.0


def test_file_with_two_accounts_is_rejected_before_any_write(tmp_path, session, family):
    user_id, account_id = family
    path = tmp_path / "mezcla.xlsx"
    _write_export(path, [EXPORT_ROWS[0], _row("02/09/2026", gasto=1.0, saldo_pos=1.0,
                                             issuer="X", iban="ES99 0000")])
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        prepare_import([path], session, user_id, account_id)
    assert session.query(Transaction).count() == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Several statements in one import
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_overlapping_statements_in_one_import_store_each_movement_once(tmp_path, session, family):
    user_id, account_id = family
    september, overlap = tmp_path / "septiembre.xlsx", tmp_path / "semana.xlsx"
    _write_export(september, EXPORT_ROWS[:4])
    _write_export(overlap, EXPORT_ROWS[2:])           # rows 2-3 also in september

    preview, summary = _import([overlap, september], session, user_id, account_id)

    assert [f.name for f in preview.files] == ["septiembre.xlsx", "semana.xlsx"]   # chronological
    stats = preview.file_stats()
    assert (stats["septiembre.xlsx"].clean, stats["septiembre.xlsx"].auto_skip) == (4, 0)
    assert (stats["semana.xlsx"].clean, stats["semana.xlsx"].auto_skip) == (1, 2)
    assert "septiembre.xlsx" in preview.duplicate_result.skip_reasons[5]
    assert summary.rows_imported == 5 and summary.rows_skipped == 2
    assert len(summary.batch_ids) == 2

    batches = {b.filename: b for b in session.query(ImportBatch).all()}
    assert (batches["septiembre.xlsx"].rows_imported, batches["septiembre.xlsx"].rows_skipped) == (4, 0)
    assert (batches["semana.xlsx"].rows_imported, batches["semana.xlsx"].rows_skipped) == (1, 2)
    ajuste = session.query(Transaction).filter_by(issuer_name="AJUSTE").one()
    assert ajuste.source_file == "semana.xlsx" and ajuste.import_batch_id == batches["semana.xlsx"].id
    assert session.query(Transaction).count() == 5


def test_zero_amount_row_in_two_overlapping_statements_is_not_asked_twice(tmp_path, session, family):
    user_id, account_id = family
    first, second = tmp_path / "a.xlsx", tmp_path / "b.xlsx"
    _write_export(first, EXPORT_ROWS[3:])
    _write_export(second, [*EXPORT_ROWS[3:], _row("06/09/2026", gasto=1.0, saldo_neg=-58.65, issuer="X")])

    preview = prepare_import([first, second], session, user_id, account_id)

    dup = preview.duplicate_result
    assert dup.needs_review == [] and sorted(dup.auto_skip) == [2, 3]
    assert sorted(dup.clean) == [0, 1, 4]


def test_the_same_statement_twice_is_reported_and_imported_once(tmp_path, session, family):
    user_id, account_id = family
    path = tmp_path / "movimientos.xlsx"
    _write_export(path, EXPORT_ROWS)
    copy = tmp_path / "copia" / "movimientos.xlsx"
    copy.parent.mkdir()
    copy.write_bytes(path.read_bytes())

    preview, summary = _import([path, copy], session, user_id, account_id)

    assert [r.name for r in preview.rejected] == ["movimientos (2).xlsx"]
    assert "mismo fichero" in preview.rejected[0].reason
    assert summary.rows_imported == 5 and len(summary.batch_ids) == 1


def test_statement_of_another_account_is_left_out(tmp_path, session, family):
    user_id, account_id = family
    ours, other = tmp_path / "nuestra.xlsx", tmp_path / "otra.xlsx"
    _write_export(ours, EXPORT_ROWS[:3])
    _write_export(other, [_row("02/09/2026", gasto=1.0, saldo_pos=1.0, issuer="X", iban="ES99 9999 1234")])

    preview, summary = _import([ours, other, tmp_path / "falta.xlsx"], session, user_id, account_id)

    reasons = {r.name: r.reason for r in preview.rejected}
    assert set(reasons) == {"otra.xlsx", "falta.xlsx"}
    assert "otra cuenta (··1234)" in reasons["otra.xlsx"]
    assert summary.rows_imported == 3


def test_no_usable_statement_raises_with_every_reason(tmp_path, session, family):
    user_id, account_id = family
    bad = tmp_path / "roto.xlsx"
    bad.write_bytes(b"PK\x03\x04 not really a workbook")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as exc:
        prepare_import([bad, tmp_path / "falta.xlsx"], session, user_id, account_id)
    assert "roto.xlsx" in str(exc.value) and "falta.xlsx" in str(exc.value)


def test_a_failed_commit_writes_nothing_from_any_statement(tmp_path, session, family, monkeypatch):
    user_id, account_id = family
    first, second = tmp_path / "a.xlsx", tmp_path / "b.xlsx"
    _write_export(first, EXPORT_ROWS[:2])
    _write_export(second, EXPORT_ROWS[2:4])
    preview = prepare_import([first, second], session, user_id, account_id)

    def boom():
        raise RuntimeError("disco lleno")
    monkeypatch.setattr(session, "commit", boom)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        commit_import(preview, session, user_id, account_id, {})
    monkeypatch.undo()

    assert session.query(Transaction).count() == 0
    assert session.query(ImportBatch).count() == 0


def test_run_import_learns_the_account_iban(tmp_path, session, family):
    from app.ingestion.import_service import ensure_default_account, run_import

    user_id, _ = family
    session.query(Account).delete()
    session.commit()
    account = ensure_default_account(session, user_id)
    assert account.iban_last4 == "0000"
    path = tmp_path / "movimientos.xlsx"
    _write_export(path, [_row("01/09/2026", gasto=5.0, saldo_pos=95.0, issuer="BAR",
                              iban="ES12 2100 0000 0000 0000 7363")])

    preview = prepare_import([path], session, user_id, account.id)
    run_import(session, user_id, preview, account.id, {})

    session.expire_all()
    assert session.get(Account, account.id).iban_last4 == "7363"
```

```python
"""
tests/test_importer.py
=======================
commit_import(): persisted fields, audit trail, and duplicate decisions.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.auth.auth_service import create_user
from app.db.models import Account, AuditLog, Base, Transaction
from app.ingestion.duplicate_detector import DuplicateCheckResult
from app.ingestion.importer import ImportPreview, StatementFile, commit_import


@pytest.fixture
def db_session():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)()
    yield session
    session.close()
    engine.dispose()


def _preview(rows: list[dict], duplicates: DuplicateCheckResult) -> ImportPreview:
    defaults = {
        "transaction_date": date(2026, 9, 1),
        "value_date":       date(2026, 9, 1),
        "amount":           -20.0,
        "running_balance":  500.0,
        "concepto_comun":   "044",
        "concepto_propio":  "000",
        "issuer_name":      "MERCADONA",
        "concept":          "MERCADONA | TARJETA",
        "raw_col14":        "MERCADONA",
        "raw_details":      "TARJETA   1234",
        "currency":         "EUR",
        "iban_raw":         "ES00",
        "source_file":      "movimientos.xls",
    }
    df = pd.DataFrame([{**defaults, **row} for row in rows])
    statement = StatementFile(
        name="movimientos.xls", path=Path("C:/banco/movimientos.xls"), iban="ES00",
        rows=len(df), first=date(2026, 9, 1), last=date(2026, 9, 1),
    )
    return ImportPreview(df=df, files=[statement], duplicate_result=duplicates)


def test_commit_import_persists_raw_details_and_audit_record_id(db_session):
    user = create_user(db_session, "ana", "clave-secreta-1")
    account = Account(user_id=user.id, account_name="Cuenta")
    db_session.add(account)
    db_session.commit()

    preview = _preview([{}], DuplicateCheckResult(clean=[0]))
    summary = commit_import(preview, db_session, user.id, account.id, {})

    txn = db_session.get(Transaction, summary.imported_ids[0])
    assert txn.raw_details == "TARJETA   1234"
    assert txn.source_file == "movimientos.xls"
    audit = db_session.query(AuditLog).one()
    assert audit.record_id == txn.id


def test_commit_import_skips_unresolved_review_rows(db_session):
    user = create_user(db_session, "ana", "clave-secreta-1")
    account = Account(user_id=user.id, account_name="Cuenta")
    db_session.add(account)
    db_session.commit()

    duplicates = DuplicateCheckResult(clean=[0], needs_review=[1, 2])
    preview = _preview([{}, {"amount": 0.0}, {"amount": 0.0}], duplicates)
    summary = commit_import(preview, db_session, user.id, account.id, {2: True})

    assert summary.rows_imported == 2
    assert summary.rows_skipped == 1
    # Rows go in oldest first (bank order), so pick the review row by its amount.
    (flagged,) = [db_session.get(Transaction, i) for i in summary.imported_ids
                  if db_session.get(Transaction, i).amount == 0.0]
    assert flagged.is_duplicate_flagged is True

```

## `tests/test_investments_cash.py`

```python
"""
tests/test_investments_cash.py
==============================
Cash left at the brokers (broker_cash): read from the DEGIRO statement's
«Saldo», stored by the import (never overwritten by an older statement),
and added to the portfolio's total value and allocation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

import pytest
from openpyxl import Workbook

from app.db.models import BrokerCash, FxRate
from app.investments.cash import cash_changes, save_statement_cash, user_cash
from app.investments.importers.degiro import parse_statement
from app.investments.performance import CASH_LABEL, allocation
from app.investments.snapshot import portfolio_snapshot
from tests.test_investments_import import HEADER, ROWS, _as_values, db, run_import  # noqa: F401
from tests.test_investments_snapshot import AS_OF, B, op
from tests.test_investments_snapshot import db as snap_db  # noqa: F401


def write_with_balances(path, rows, balances):
    """Like write_xlsx (newest first) but with a «Saldo» per row: balances[i]
    is (currency, amount) for rows[i] (oldest first)."""
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.append(HEADER)
    for row, (currency, amount) in reversed(list(zip(rows, balances))):
        values = _as_values(row)
        values[9], values[10] = currency, amount
        ws.append(values)
    wb.save(path)
    return path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reading the statement
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_newest_balance_per_currency_is_the_cash(tmp_path):
    balances = [("EUR", 100.0 + i) for i in range(len(ROWS))]
    balances[-3] = ("USD", 7.5)                    # the last USD balance (before the sale)
    statement = parse_statement(write_with_balances(tmp_path / "a.xlsx", ROWS, balances))
    assert statement.cash == {"EUR": 100.0 + len(ROWS) - 1, "USD": 7.5}
    assert statement.cash_as_of == date(2026, 3, 3)


def test_within_the_same_minute_the_first_row_of_the_file_is_the_newest(tmp_path):
    # Real DEGIRO export: a sweep and the transfer row share 15:31; the file
    # lists the transfer first and its «Saldo» is the cash DEGIRO shows.
    rows = [("26-10-2026", "15:31", None, None, "Degiro Cash Sweep Transfer", None, "EUR", 709.71),
            ("26-10-2026", "15:31", None, None, "Transferir desde su Cuenta de Efectivo en flatex",
             None, "EUR", None)]
    path = write_with_balances(tmp_path / "b.xlsx", rows, [("EUR", 1712.13), ("EUR", 1002.42)])
    assert parse_statement(path).cash == {"EUR": 1002.42}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Storing it
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_an_older_statement_never_overwrites_newer_cash(db):  # noqa: F811
    s, uid = db.s, db.pedro.id
    assert save_statement_cash(s, uid, "DEGIRO", {"EUR": 1002.42, "USD": 0.0}, date(2026, 10, 26))
    assert cash_changes(s, uid, "DEGIRO", {"EUR": 355.3}, date(2026, 9, 2)) == {}
    assert not save_statement_cash(s, uid, "DEGIRO", {"EUR": 355.3}, date(2026, 9, 2))
    assert [(c.currency, c.amount) for c in user_cash(s, uid)] == [("EUR", 1002.42)]   # USD 0 hidden
    # A newer one replaces it; the same one changes nothing.
    assert cash_changes(s, uid, "DEGIRO", {"EUR": 50.0}, date(2026, 11, 2)) == {"EUR": (1002.42, 50.0)}
    assert save_statement_cash(s, uid, "DEGIRO", {"EUR": 50.0}, date(2026, 11, 2))
    assert not save_statement_cash(s, uid, "DEGIRO", {"EUR": 50.0}, date(2026, 11, 2))
    assert user_cash(s, db.maria.id) == []                   # per user
    assert s.query(BrokerCash).count() == 2


def test_import_stores_the_cash_even_without_new_operations(db, tmp_path):  # noqa: F811
    balances = [("EUR", 10.0)] * (len(ROWS) - 1) + [("EUR", 1234.56)]
    path = write_with_balances(tmp_path / "a.xlsx", ROWS, balances)
    summary = run_import(db, db.pedro, path)
    assert summary.cash_updated and len(summary.result.added) == 8
    assert user_cash(db.s, db.pedro.id)[0].amount == 1234.56

    balances[-1] = ("EUR", 99.0)                             # same operations, new balance
    path = write_with_balances(tmp_path / "b.xlsx", ROWS, balances)
    statement = parse_statement(path)
    statement.cash_as_of = date(2026, 3, 4)
    from app.investments.importers.service import apply_import
    from tests.test_investments_import import SYMBOLS
    again = apply_import(db.s, db.pedro.id, statement, SYMBOLS, {})
    assert again.result.added == [] and again.cash_updated
    assert user_cash(db.s, db.pedro.id)[0].amount == 99.0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portfolio value
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_total_value_adds_the_cash_in_eur(snap_db):  # noqa: F811
    db = snap_db
    op(db, db.pedro, db.enr, B, date(2025, 2, 3), 10, 1000.0)                   # 10×150 = 1500
    save_statement_cash(db.s, db.pedro.id, "DEGIRO", {"EUR": 1002.42, "USD": 25.0}, AS_OF)
    totals = portfolio_snapshot(db.s, db.pedro.id, as_of=AS_OF).totals
    assert totals.market_value_eur == pytest.approx(1500.0)                     # securities only
    assert totals.cash_eur == pytest.approx(1002.42 + 20.0)                     # 25 USD / 1.25
    assert totals.total_value_eur == pytest.approx(2522.42)
    assert totals.unrealized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(500.0)                   # gains: securities
    assert portfolio_snapshot(db.s, db.maria.id, as_of=AS_OF).totals.cash == []
    assert portfolio_snapshot(db.s, db.pedro.id, as_of=AS_OF, broker="Otro").totals.cash_eur == 0

    by_value = dict(allocation(db.s, db.pedro.id, "security", as_of=AS_OF))
    assert by_value[CASH_LABEL] == pytest.approx(1022.42)
    assert dict(allocation(db.s, db.pedro.id, "currency", as_of=AS_OF))["USD"] == pytest.approx(20.0)
    assert dict(allocation(db.s, db.pedro.id, "broker", as_of=AS_OF))["DEGIRO"] == pytest.approx(2522.42)


def test_cash_without_fx_rate_is_reported_not_guessed(snap_db):  # noqa: F811
    db = snap_db
    op(db, db.pedro, db.enr, B, date(2025, 2, 3), 10, 1000.0)
    save_statement_cash(db.s, db.pedro.id, "DEGIRO", {"CHF": 100.0}, AS_OF)
    totals = portfolio_snapshot(db.s, db.pedro.id, as_of=AS_OF).totals
    assert totals.cash_eur == 0 and totals.cash_missing_fx == ["CHF"]
    db.s.add(FxRate(currency="CHF", rate_date=AS_OF, rate=0.5))
    db.s.commit()
    assert portfolio_snapshot(db.s, db.pedro.id, as_of=AS_OF).totals.cash_eur == pytest.approx(200.0)

```

## `tests/test_investments_gui.py`

```python
"""
tests/test_investments_gui.py
=============================
Offscreen tests of the Inversiones view and its dialogs: empty state,
entry form (EUR estimate, close-of-day hint, held shares, ledger errors),
editing/deleting from the table, Yahoo search. A fake provider replaces
Yahoo and every database is a temp file.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from datetime import date, timedelta
from types import SimpleNamespace

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")

import pytest
from PySide6.QtCore import QDate, QElapsedTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.db.database import _build_engine
from app.db.models import (
    AssetType,
    Base,
    FxRate,
    InvestmentKind,
    InvestmentTransaction,
    PriceHistory,
    Security,
    User,
)
from app.gui.investment_dialogs import SecuritySearchDialog, TransactionDialog
from app.gui.investments_view import InvestmentsView
from app.investments.ledger import TransactionDraft, save_transaction
from app.investments.market_data import SearchResult, SecurityInfo
from app.investments.refresh_worker import PriceRefresher
from app.config import THEMES

TODAY = date.today()


class FakeProvider:
    name = "Fake"

    def __init__(self):
        self.closes = {}

    def search(self, text, limit=10):
        return [SearchResult("TKE.DE", "Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.", AssetType.stock, "XETRA"),
                SearchResult("TTWO", "Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.", AssetType.stock, "NASDAQ")]

    def security_info(self, symbol):
        return SecurityInfo(symbol=symbol, name="Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.",
                            asset_type=AssetType.stock, currency="EUR", exchange="XETRA")

    def daily_closes(self, symbols, start, end=None):
        return {s: rows for s, rows in self.closes.items() if s in symbols}


def wait_until(condition, timeout_ms=5000):
    app = QApplication.instance()
    timer = QElapsedTimer()
    timer.start()
    while not condition() and timer.elapsed() < timeout_ms:
        app.processEvents()
    return condition()


@pytest.fixture
def env(tmp_path):
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    engine = _build_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'gui.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    factory = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    session = factory()
    user = User(username="pedro", password_hash="x")
    gev = Security(symbol="GEV", name="GE Vernova Inc.", currency="USD", exchange="NYSE")
    enr = Security(symbol="ENR.DE", name="Siemens Energy AG", currency="EUR", exchange="XETRA")
    session.add_all([user, gev, enr])
    session.flush()
    day = TODAY - timedelta(days=1)
    session.add_all([
        PriceHistory(security_id=gev.id, price_date=day, close=957.63),
        PriceHistory(security_id=enr.id, price_date=day, close=142.6),
        FxRate(currency="USD", rate_date=day, rate=1.25),
    ])
    session.commit()
    provider = FakeProvider()
    ns = SimpleNamespace(app=app, session=session, factory=factory, user=user, gev=gev,
                         enr=enr, provider=provider, theme=THEMES["light"], day=day)
    yield ns
    session.close()
    engine.dispose()


def make_view(env):
    refresher = PriceRefresher(provider=env.provider, session_factory=env.factory)
    return InvestmentsView(env.user, env.session, "light", provider=env.provider,
                           refresher=refresher)


def dialog(env, **kw):
    return TransactionDialog(env.session, env.user.id, env.provider, env.theme, **kw)


def select_security(dlg, security):
    dlg._cmb_security.setCurrentIndex(dlg._cmb_security.findData(security.id))


def buy(env, security, qty, eur, d=None):
    return save_transaction(env.session, env.user.id, TransactionDraft(
        security_id=security.id, kind=InvestmentKind.buy, trade_date=d or env.day,
        broker="DEGIRO", quantity=qty, amount_eur=eur))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# View
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_view_shows_empty_state_then_operations(env):
    view = make_view(env)
    try:
        assert view._ops_stack.currentIndex() == 0
        buy(env, env.enr, 10, 1426.0)
        view.reload()
        assert view._ops_stack.currentIndex() == 1
        assert view._model.rowCount() == 1
        row = [view._model.item(0, c).text() for c in range(view._model.columnCount())]
        assert row[1] == "Compra" and "ENR.DE" in row[2] and row[4] == "10"
        assert row[6] == "−1.426,00 €"
        assert view._lbl_count.text() == "1 operación"
    finally:
        view.shutdown()


def test_view_filters_by_kind_and_text(env):
    buy(env, env.enr, 10, 1426.0)
    buy(env, env.gev, 1, 800.0)
    view = make_view(env)
    try:
        assert view._model.rowCount() == 2
        view._inp_search.setText("siemens")
        assert view._model.rowCount() == 1
        view._inp_search.clear()
        view._cmb_kind.setCurrentIndex(view._cmb_kind.findData(InvestmentKind.sell))
        assert view._model.rowCount() == 0
    finally:
        view.shutdown()


def test_delete_from_view_respects_ledger(env, monkeypatch):
    first = buy(env, env.enr, 10, 1426.0, d=env.day - timedelta(days=5))
    save_transaction(env.session, env.user.id, TransactionDraft(
        security_id=env.enr.id, kind=InvestmentKind.sell, trade_date=env.day,
        broker="DEGIRO", quantity=10, amount_eur=1500.0))
    view = make_view(env)
    warnings = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(QMessageBox, "question", lambda *a, **k: QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes)
    monkeypatch.setattr(QMessageBox, "warning", lambda *a, **k: warnings.append(a[2]))
    try:
        # Select the buy (older row) and try to delete it: the later sale depends on it.
        for row in range(view._proxy.rowCount()):
            if view._proxy.index(row, 1).data() == "Compra":
                view._table.selectRow(row)
```

## `tests/test_investments_import.py`

```python
"""
tests/test_investments_import.py
================================
DEGIRO account statement import: parsing (.xlsx and .csv), symbol
suggestion, and the all-or-nothing import with duplicate detection.
The statement is synthetic (made-up amounts) but follows DEGIRO's layout.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
from datetime import date, timedelta
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from openpyxl import Workbook
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.database import _build_engine
from app.db.models import AssetType, Base, InvestmentKind, InvestmentTransaction, Security, User
from app.investments.importers.degiro import StatementError, parse_statement
from app.investments.importers.service import (
    apply_import,
    catalogue_isins,
    fetch_security_infos,
    symbols_to_fetch,
)
from app.investments.importers.symbols import search_queries, suggest_symbols
from app.investments.ledger import TransactionDraft, save_transaction
from app.investments.market_data import SearchResult, SecurityInfo
from app.investments.portfolio import LedgerError

HEADER = ["Fecha", "Hora", "Fecha valor", "Producto", "ISIN", "Descripción", "Tipo",
          "Variación", None, "Saldo", None, "ID Orden"]
ACME, ETF, SIE, USCO = "US0000000001", "IE0000000002", "DE0000000003", "US0000000004"

# Oldest first here; the file is written newest first like DEGIRO does.
ROWS = [
    ("01-08-2025", "09:00", None, None, "flatex Deposit", None, "EUR", 5000),
    ("12-08-2025", "10:00", "ACME CORP", ACME, "Compra 10 Acme Corp.@100 EUR (US0000000001)", None, "EUR", -1000, "o1"),
    ("12-08-2025", "10:00", "ACME CORP", ACME, "Costes de transacción y/o externos de DEGIRO", None, "EUR", -3.9, "o1"),
    # one order filled twice
    ("13-08-2025", "16:04", "WORLD ETF", ETF, "Compra 17 World ETF USD Dis@50 EUR (IE0000000002)", None, "EUR", -850, "o2"),
    ("13-08-2025", "16:04", "WORLD ETF", ETF, "Costes de transacción y/o externos de DEGIRO", None, "EUR", -1, "o2"),
    ("13-08-2025", "16:11", "WORLD ETF", ETF, "Compra 1 World ETF USD Dis@50 EUR (IE0000000002)", None, "EUR", -50, "o2"),
    ("15-08-2025", "12:00", "SIEMENS X", SIE, "Compra 5 Siemens X AG@20 EUR (DE0000000003)", None, "EUR", -100, "o3"),
    ("15-08-2025", "12:00", "SIEMENS X", SIE, "Spanish Transaction Tax", None, "EUR", -0.2, "o3"),
    ("15-08-2025", "12:00", "SIEMENS X", SIE, "Costes de transacción y/o externos de DEGIRO", None, "EUR", -2, "o3"),
    # a USD trade converted with AutoFX (conversion rows carry the order id)
    ("20-08-2025", "15:30", "US CO", USCO, "Compra 2 US Co Inc@110 USD (US0000000004)", None, "USD", -220, "o4"),
    ("20-08-2025", "15:30", None, None, "Retirada Cambio de Divisa", None, "EUR", -200, "o4"),
    ("20-08-2025", "15:30", None, None, "Ingreso Cambio de Divisa", 1.1, "USD", 220, "o4"),
    ("20-08-2025", "15:30", "US CO", USCO, "Costes de transacción y/o externos de DEGIRO", None, "EUR", -1, "o4"),
    # USD dividends: tax booked minutes apart, converted the next morning together
    ("01-10-2025", "08:37", "ACME CORP", ACME, "Retención del dividendo", None, "USD", -0.6, None),
    ("01-10-2025", "08:41", "ACME CORP", ACME, "Dividendo", None, "USD", 4.0, None),
    ("01-10-2025", "09:00", "WORLD ETF", ETF, "Dividendo", None, "USD", 6.6, None),
    ("02-10-2025", "06:50", None, None, "Retirada Cambio de Divisa", 1.2, "USD", -10.0, None),
    ("02-10-2025", "06:50", None, None, "Ingreso Cambio de Divisa", None, "EUR", 8.33, None),
    # EUR dividend: no conversion
    ("03-10-2025", "08:00", "SIEMENS X", SIE, "Dividendo", None, "EUR", 1.5, None),
    ("03-10-2025", "08:00", "SIEMENS X", SIE, "Retención del dividendo", None, "EUR", -0.4, None),
    ("05-01-2026", "10:00", None, None, "Comisión de conectividad con el mercado 2026 (Xetra - XET)", None, "EUR", -2.5, None),
    ("06-01-2026", "10:00", None, None, "Degiro Cash Sweep Transfer", None, "EUR", 12.0, None),
    ("03-03-2026", "15:30", "WORLD ETF", ETF, "Venta 18 World ETF USD Dis@55 EUR (IE0000000002)", None, "EUR", 990, "o5"),
    ("03-03-2026", "15:30", "WORLD ETF", ETF, "Costes de transacción y/o externos de DEGIRO", None, "EUR", -3, "o5"),
]


def _as_values(row):
    day, clock, product, isin, desc, rate, currency, amount, *rest = row
    return [day, clock, day, product, isin, desc, rate, currency, amount, "EUR", 0, rest[0] if rest else None]


def write_xlsx(path, rows=ROWS):
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Estado de cuenta"
    ws.append(HEADER)
    for row in reversed(rows):
        ws.append(_as_values(row))
    wb.save(path)
    return path


def write_csv(path, rows=ROWS):
    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        writer = csv.writer(handle)
        writer.writerow(["" if h is None else h for h in HEADER])
        for row in reversed(rows):
            values = _as_values(row)
            # DEGIRO's CSV uses decimal commas for amounts and rates
            values = ["" if v is None else (f"{v:.2f}".replace(".", ",") if isinstance(v, (int, float))
                                            and i in (6, 8, 10) else v) for i, v in enumerate(values)]
            writer.writerow(values)
    return path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parsing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.fixture(params=["xlsx", "csv"])
def statement(request, tmp_path):
    writer = write_xlsx if request.param == "xlsx" else write_csv
    return parse_statement(writer(tmp_path / f"Account.{request.param}"))

    acme = trades["o1"]
    assert (acme.kind, acme.trade_date, acme.quantity, acme.price, acme.amount_eur, acme.fees_eur) == (
        "buy", date(2025, 8, 12), 10, 100, 1003.9, 3.9)
    etf = trades["o2"]
    assert (etf.quantity, etf.fills, etf.price, etf.amount_eur) == (18, 2, 50, 901.0)
    assert trades["o3"].fees_eur == pytest.approx(2.2)            # DEGIRO fee + Spanish tax
    sale = trades["o5"]
    assert (sale.kind, sale.quantity, sale.amount_eur) == ("sell", 18, 987.0)

def test_dividends_take_the_euros_actually_credited(statement):
    divs = {d.isin: d for d in statement.dividends}
    acme, etf, sie = divs[ACME], divs[ETF], divs[SIE]
    assert (acme.gross, acme.withheld) == (pytest.approx(4.0), pytest.approx(0.6))
    # 10 USD converted into 8.33 EUR, shared 3.4 : 6.6
    assert acme.net_eur == pytest.approx(2.83) and etf.net_eur == pytest.approx(5.50)
    assert acme.withheld_eur == pytest.approx(0.5) and acme.rate == 1.2
    assert (sie.net_eur, sie.withheld_eur) == (pytest.approx(1.1), pytest.approx(0.4))
    assert acme.ref == f"DIV|{ACME}|2025-10-01"


def test_everything_else_is_ignored_and_listed(statement):

                                      "Degiro Cash Sweep Transfer"}
    assert statement.warnings == []
    assert (statement.first_day, statement.last_day) == (date(2025, 8, 1), date(2026, 3, 3))


def test_dividend_without_conversion_is_warned(tmp_path):

    statement = parse_statement(write_xlsx(tmp_path / "a.xlsx", rows))
    acme = next(d for d in statement.dividends if d.isin == ACME)
    assert acme.net_eur is None

def test_xlsx_with_a_wrong_dimension_is_read_whole(tmp_path):
    # Real DEGIRO export (Oct 2026): <dimension ref="A1"/> although the sheet
    # has 12 columns and ~120 rows; read-only openpyxl used to see one cell.
    import re
    import zipfile

    good = write_xlsx(tmp_path / "good.xlsx")
    bad = tmp_path / "bad.xlsx"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(good) as src, zipfile.ZipFile(bad, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as dst:
        for info in src.infolist():
            data = src.read(info.filename)
            if info.filename == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
                data = re.sub(rb'<dimension ref="[^"]*"/>', b'<dimension ref="A1"/>', data)
                assert b'<dimension ref="A1"/>' in data
            dst.writestr(info, data)
    statement = parse_statement(bad)
    assert len(statement.trades) == 5 and len(statement.dividends) == 3


def test_other_files_are_rejected(tmp_path):
    wb = Workbook()
    wb.active.append(["Concepto", "Importe"])
    wb.save(tmp_path / "otro.xlsx")
    with pytest.raises(StatementError, match="Estado de cuenta"):
        parse_statement(tmp_path / "otro.xlsx")
    (tmp_path / "x.pdf").write_bytes(b"%PDF")
    with pytest.raises(StatementError, match="Formato"):
        parse_statement(tmp_path / "x.pdf")

class FakeProvider:
    name = "fake"

    def __init__(self):
        self.searches = []

    def search(self, text, limit=10):
        self.searches.append(text)
        table = {
            ACME: [SearchResult("ACME", "Acme Corp.", AssetType.stock, "NASDAQ")],
            "Acme Corp.": [SearchResult("ACM.F", "Acme", AssetType.stock, "Frankfurt"),
                           SearchResult("ACM.DE", "Acme", AssetType.stock, "XETRA")],
            "WORLD ETF": [SearchResult("WLDA.DE", "World Acc", AssetType.etf, "XETRA"),
                          SearchResult("WLD.AS", "World Dis", AssetType.etf, "Amsterdam")],
        }
        return table.get(text, [])

    def daily_closes(self, symbols, start, end=None):
        data = {"ACM.F": 99.0, "ACM.DE": 99.6, "WLDA.DE": 56.0, "WLD.AS": 50.2}
        end = end or date.today()                    # a price refresh asks up to today
        days = [start + timedelta(days=i) for i in range((end - start).days + 1)]
        return {s: [(d, data[s]) for d in days] for s in symbols if s in data}

    def security_info(self, symbol):
        return SecurityInfo(symbol=symbol, name=f"{symbol} name", asset_type=AssetType.stock,
                            currency="EUR", exchange="XETRA")

@pytest.fixture

def run_import(db, user, path):
    statement = parse_statement(path)
    infos = fetch_security_infos(FakeProvider(), symbols_to_fetch(db.s, SYMBOLS.values()))
    return apply_import(db.s, user.id, statement, SYMBOLS, infos)


def test_import_creates_securities_and_operations(db):
    summary = run_import(db, db.pedro, write_xlsx(db.path / "a.xlsx"))
    assert (summary.trades, summary.dividends, summary.result.skipped) == (5, 3, 0)
    assert catalogue_isins(db.s)[ACME] == "ACM.DE"
    etf_buy = (db.s.query(InvestmentTransaction).filter_by(broker_ref="o2").one())
    assert (etf_buy.quantity, etf_buy.amount_eur, etf_buy.broker) == (18, 901.0, "DEGIRO")
    assert "2 ejecuciones" in etf_buy.notes

    assert (div.kind, div.amount_eur, div.tax_withheld_eur) == (InvestmentKind.dividend, 2.83, 0.5)


def test_reimport_skips_everything_and_other_users_are_independent(db):

    maria = run_import(db, db.maria, path)
    assert len(maria.result.added) == 8

def test_overlapping_statement_imports_only_new_operations(db):
    run_import(db, db.pedro, write_xlsx(db.path / "old.xlsx", ROWS[:-2]))
    summary = run_import(db, db.pedro, write_xlsx(db.path / "new.xlsx"))
    assert [t.broker_ref for t in summary.result.added] == ["o5"]


def test_import_is_all_or_nothing(db):
    # Without the ETF purchase the statement's ETF sale is impossible: the
    # whole import must be rejected, not just that operation.
    rows = [r for r in ROWS if r[-1] != "o2"]
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError, match="solo había 0"):
        run_import(db, db.pedro, write_xlsx(db.path / "bad.xlsx", rows))
    assert db.s.query(InvestmentTransaction).count() == 0
    assert db.s.query(Security).count() == 0          # securities rolled back too


def test_import_respects_existing_manual_operations(db):
    run_import(db, db.pedro, write_xlsx(db.path / "a.xlsx", ROWS[:3]))
    acme = db.s.query(Security).filter_by(symbol="ACM.DE").one()
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, TransactionDraft(
        security_id=acme.id, kind=InvestmentKind.sell, trade_date=date(2025, 9, 1),
        broker="DEGIRO", quantity=10, amount_eur=1100.0))
    summary = run_import(db, db.pedro, write_xlsx(db.path / "b.xlsx"))
    assert summary.result.skipped == 1 and len(summary.result.added) == 7
```

```python
        "0PWORLD.F": _closes(date(2026, 2, 1), date(2026, 3, 31), 25.0),  # 100/25 = 4 ; 104/25 = 4.16 → all
        "0PGLOBAL.F": _closes(date(2026, 9, 1), date(2026, 9, 20), 12.0),

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def wait_until(condition, timeout_ms=5000):
    app = QApplication.instance()
    timer = QElapsedTimer()
    timer.start()
    while not condition() and timer.elapsed() < timeout_ms:
        app.processEvents()
    return condition()


def test_dialog_estimates_lets_the_user_fix_and_imports(db):
    QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    from app.gui.investment_import import COL_KIND, COL_QTY, ImportStatementDialog

    dialog = ImportStatementDialog(db.s, db.ana.id, "ana", FakeProvider(), THEMES["light"])
    dialog.load_file(write_csv(db.path / "mi.csv"))
    assert wait_until(lambda: not dialog.busy and dialog._btn_import.isEnabled())
    rows = dialog._rows
    lab_buy = next(i for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r.name.startswith("LABORATORIOS") and r.kind == KIND_BUY)
    assert dialog._ops.item(lab_buy, COL_QTY).text() == "6"

    # The user corrects the estimate and turns a dividend into "Ignorar".
    dialog._ops.item(lab_buy, COL_QTY).setText("5")
    assert wait_until(lambda: rows[lab_buy].quantity == 5 and not rows[lab_buy].quantity_estimated)
    div = next(i for i, r in enumerate(dialog._rows) if r.kind == KIND_DIVIDEND)
    combo = dialog._ops.cellWidget(div, COL_KIND)
    combo.setCurrentIndex(combo.findData(KIND_IGNORE))
    assert wait_until(lambda: "Ignorar" in [dialog._ops.cellWidget(div, COL_KIND).currentText()])

    # 5 bought, 6 estimated for the sale → the sale must be corrected too, or the
    # import is refused as a whole.
    dialog._import()
    assert wait_until(lambda: not dialog._runner.busy)
    QApplication.instance().processEvents()
    assert dialog.summary is None and "No se ha importado nada" in dialog._lbl_status.text()
    sale = next(i for i, r in enumerate(dialog._rows) if r.name.startswith("LABORATORIOS") and r.kind == KIND_SELL)
    dialog._ops.item(sale, COL_QTY).setText("5")
    assert wait_until(lambda: dialog._rows[sale].quantity == 5)
    dialog._import()
    assert wait_until(lambda: dialog.summary is not None)
    assert dialog.summary.ignored == 1 and dialog.summary.dividends == 1
```

```python
per-user scoping, field normalization, filters, brokers and the EUR
estimate used by the entry form.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.database import _build_engine
from app.db.models import Base, InvestmentKind, InvestmentTransaction, Security, User
from app.investments.ledger import (
    DEFAULT_BROKERS,
    TransactionDraft,
    delete_transaction,
    estimate_amount_eur,
    known_brokers,
    list_transactions,
    picker_securities,
    save_transaction,
)
from app.investments.portfolio import LedgerError

BUY, SELL, DIV, SPLIT = (InvestmentKind.buy, InvestmentKind.sell,
                         InvestmentKind.dividend, InvestmentKind.split)


@pytest.fixture
def db(tmp_path):
    engine = _build_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'ledger.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    session = Session(engine)
    pedro = User(username="pedro", password_hash="x")
    maria = User(username="maria", password_hash="x")
    gev = Security(symbol="GEV", name="GE Vernova Inc.", currency="USD")
    enr = Security(symbol="ENR.DE", name="Siemens Energy AG", currency="EUR")
    amz = Security(symbol="AMZ.DE", name="Amazon.com, Inc.", currency="EUR")
    session.add_all([pedro, maria, gev, enr, amz])
    session.commit()
    yield SimpleNamespace(s=session, pedro=pedro, maria=maria, gev=gev, enr=enr, amz=amz)
    session.close()
    engine.dispose()


def draft(sec, kind, d, qty=None, eur=0.0, **kw):
    kw.setdefault("broker", "DEGIRO")
    return TransactionDraft(security_id=sec.id, kind=kind, trade_date=d,
                            quantity=qty, amount_eur=eur, **kw)


def test_save_new_buy_and_sell(db):
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.gev, BUY, date(2025, 3, 3), 2, 575.4, price=300.0))
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.gev, SELL, date(2026, 3, 3), 1, 700.0))
    assert db.s.query(InvestmentTransaction).count() == 2


def test_oversell_is_rejected_and_nothing_is_written(db):
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.gev, BUY, date(2025, 3, 3), 2, 575.4))
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError, match="solo había 2"):
        save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.gev, SELL, date(2026, 3, 3), 3, 900.0))
    assert db.s.query(InvestmentTransaction).count() == 1


def test_holdings_are_per_user(db):
    save_transaction(db.s, db.maria.id, draft(db.gev, BUY, date(2025, 3, 3), 5, 1500.0))
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError):
        save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.gev, SELL, date(2026, 1, 1), 1, 300.0))


def test_editing_a_buy_that_breaks_a_later_sale_is_rejected(db):
    buy = save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0))
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, SELL, date(2025, 6, 1), 8, 1200.0))
    edit = draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 5, 500.0, id=buy.id)
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError):
        save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, edit)
    db.s.refresh(buy)
    assert buy.quantity == 10


def test_moving_a_buy_to_another_security_checks_the_old_one(db):
    buy = save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0))
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, SELL, date(2025, 6, 1), 8, 1200.0))
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError):
        save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id,
                         draft(db.amz, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0, id=buy.id))


def test_editing_updates_in_place(db):
    buy = save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0))
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id,
                     draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 3), 12, 1234.567, id=buy.id, notes="  x "))
    rows = db.s.query(InvestmentTransaction).all()
    assert len(rows) == 1
    assert (rows[0].quantity, rows[0].amount_eur, rows[0].trade_date, rows[0].notes) == (
        12, 1234.57, date(2025, 1, 3), "x")


def test_cannot_edit_or_delete_another_users_operation(db):
    buy = save_transaction(db.s, db.maria.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0))
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError, match="otro usuario"):
        save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id,
                         draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 1, 1.0, id=buy.id))
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError, match="otro usuario"):
        delete_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, buy.id)


def test_delete_is_blocked_when_a_later_sale_depends_on_it(db):
    buy = save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0))
    sell = save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, SELL, date(2025, 6, 1), 8, 1200.0))
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError, match="No se puede borrar"):
        delete_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, buy.id)
    delete_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, sell.id)
    delete_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, buy.id)
    assert db.s.query(InvestmentTransaction).count() == 0


def test_invalid_fields_and_missing_broker(db):
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError, match="bróker"):
        save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 1, 10.0, broker=" "))
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError, match="acciones"):
        save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 0, 10.0))


def test_normalization_clears_fields_the_kind_does_not_use(db):
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0,
                                              tax_withheld_eur=5.0, split_ratio=3.0))
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, DIV, date(2025, 3, 2), 10, 8.5,
                                              price=1.0, tax_withheld_eur=1.5))
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, SPLIT, date(2025, 4, 2), 10, 99.0,
                                              split_ratio=2.0))
    buy, div, split = db.s.query(InvestmentTransaction).order_by(InvestmentTransaction.trade_date)
    assert (buy.tax_withheld_eur, buy.split_ratio) == (0.0, None)
    assert (div.quantity, div.price, div.tax_withheld_eur) == (None, None, 1.5)
    assert (split.quantity, split.amount_eur, split.split_ratio) == (None, 0.0, 2.0)


def test_list_filters_and_order(db):
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0))
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.gev, BUY, date(2025, 2, 2), 1, 300.0,
                                              broker="EquatePlus"))
    save_transaction(db.s, db.maria.id, draft(db.amz, BUY, date(2025, 3, 2), 1, 200.0))
    rows = list_transactions(db.s, db.pedro.id)
    assert [r.security.symbol for r in rows] == ["GEV", "ENR.DE"]
    assert [r.security.symbol for r in list_transactions(db.s, db.pedro.id, text="siemens")] == ["ENR.DE"]
    assert [r.broker for r in list_transactions(db.s, db.pedro.id, broker="EquatePlus")] == ["EquatePlus"]
    assert list_transactions(db.s, db.pedro.id, kind=SELL) == []


def test_known_brokers_most_recent_first_then_defaults(db):
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.enr, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 1, 10.0, broker="Trade Republic"))
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.gev, BUY, date(2025, 5, 2), 1, 10.0, broker="EquatePlus"))
    brokers = known_brokers(db.s, db.pedro.id)
    assert brokers[:2] == ["EquatePlus", "Trade Republic"]
    assert set(DEFAULT_BROKERS) <= set(brokers) and len(brokers) == len(set(brokers))


def test_picker_lists_own_securities_first(db):
    save_transaction(db.s, db.pedro.id, draft(db.gev, BUY, date(2025, 1, 2), 1, 10.0))
    assert [s.symbol for s in picker_securities(db.s, db.pedro.id)] == ["GEV", "AMZ.DE", "ENR.DE"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind, fx, expected", [
    (BUY, 1.0, 1002.5),          # EUR security: exact
    (SELL, 1.0, 997.5),
    (BUY, 1.25, 802.5),          # USD: 1000 USD / 1.25 + fees
    (BUY, None, None),
])
def test_estimate_amount_eur(kind, fx, expected):
    assert estimate_amount_eur(kind, 10, 100.0, 2.5, fx) == expected
```
