```python
"""
tests/test_investments_performance.py
=====================================
Portfolio value history, the "same money in the index" benchmark,
allocation groupings, and benchmark refresh.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, timedelta
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.database import _build_engine
from app.db.models import AssetType, Base, FxRate, InvestmentKind, PriceHistory, Security, User
from app.investments.benchmarks import BENCHMARKS
from app.investments.ledger import TransactionDraft, save_transaction
from app.investments.performance import allocation, ensure_benchmark, portfolio_history
from app.investments.prices import refresh_market_data

D1, D2, D3 = date(2026, 1, 5), date(2026, 1, 6), date(2026, 1, 7)


@pytest.fixture
def db(tmp_path):
    engine = _build_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'perf.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    s = Session(engine)
    user = User(username="pedro", password_hash="x")
    enr = Security(symbol="ENR.DE", name="Siemens Energy AG", currency="EUR")
    gev = Security(symbol="GEV", name="GE Vernova Inc.", currency="USD")
    fund = Security(symbol="0P00008XG7.F", name="Boreas", currency="EUR", asset_type=AssetType.fund)
    s.add_all([user, enr, gev, fund])
    s.flush()
    for day, e, g in ((D1, 100.0, 500.0), (D2, 110.0, 550.0), (D3, 120.0, 600.0)):
        s.add(PriceHistory(security_id=enr.id, price_date=day, close=e))
        s.add(PriceHistory(security_id=gev.id, price_date=day, close=g))
        s.add(FxRate(currency="USD", rate_date=day, rate=1.25))
    s.commit()
    yield SimpleNamespace(s=s, user=user, enr=enr, gev=gev, fund=fund)
    s.close()
    engine.dispose()


def op(db, sec, kind, d, qty=None, eur=0.0, broker="DEGIRO"):
    save_transaction(db.s, db.user.id, TransactionDraft(
        security_id=sec.id, kind=kind, trade_date=d, broker=broker, quantity=qty, amount_eur=eur))


B, S = InvestmentKind.buy, InvestmentKind.sell


def test_history_values_holdings_each_day(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, D1, 10, 1000.0)
    op(db, db.gev, B, D2, 1, 440.0, broker="EquatePlus")
    points = portfolio_history(db.s, db.user.id, end=D3).points
    assert [p.day for p in points] == [D1, D2, D3]
    assert [round(p.value_eur, 2) for p in points] == [1000.0, 1100.0 + 440.0, 1200.0 + 480.0]
    assert [p.invested_eur for p in points] == [1000.0, 1440.0, 1440.0]
    assert all(p.benchmark_eur is None for p in points)


def test_history_after_a_sale_drops_the_shares(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, D1, 10, 1000.0)
    op(db, db.enr, S, D2, 5, 550.0)
    last = portfolio_history(db.s, db.user.id, end=D3).points[-1]
    assert last.value_eur == pytest.approx(600.0) and last.invested_eur == pytest.approx(500.0)


def test_security_without_prices_counts_at_cost(db):
    op(db, db.fund, B, D1, 10, 1200.0, broker="Tressis")
    points = portfolio_history(db.s, db.user.id, end=D3).points
    assert [p.day for p in points] == [D1, D3]          # no market days known: start and end
    assert all(p.value_eur == 1200.0 for p in points)


def test_benchmark_follows_same_cash_flows(db):
    bench = ensure_benchmark(db.s, "msci_world")
    for day, close in ((D1, 50.0), (D2, 55.0), (D3, 60.0)):
        db.s.add(PriceHistory(security_id=bench.id, price_date=day, close=close))
    db.s.commit()
    op(db, db.enr, B, D1, 10, 1000.0)      # 20 index units
    op(db, db.enr, S, D2, 5, 550.0)        # sells 10 units
    history = portfolio_history(db.s, db.user.id, end=D3, benchmark_key="msci_world")
    assert history.benchmark_name == BENCHMARKS["msci_world"].name
    assert [round(p.benchmark_eur, 2) for p in history.points] == [1000.0, 550.0, 600.0]


def test_history_since_and_empty(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, D1, 10, 1000.0)
    history = portfolio_history(db.s, db.user.id, end=D3)
    assert [p.day for p in history.since(D2)] == [D2, D3]
    assert portfolio_history(db.s, 999, end=D3).points == []


def test_allocation_by_each_dimension(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, D1, 10, 1000.0, broker="Trade Republic")
    op(db, db.gev, B, D1, 1, 400.0, broker="EquatePlus")
    op(db, db.fund, B, D1, 1, 300.0, broker="Tressis")
    op(db, db.enr, B, D2, 5, 550.0, broker="DEGIRO")
    assert allocation(db.s, db.user.id, "security", as_of=D3) == [
        ("Siemens Energy AG", 1800.0), ("GE Vernova Inc.", 480.0), ("Boreas", 300.0)]
    assert allocation(db.s, db.user.id, "broker", as_of=D3) == [
        ("Trade Republic", 1200.0), ("DEGIRO", 600.0), ("EquatePlus", 480.0), ("Tressis", 300.0)]
    assert allocation(db.s, db.user.id, "currency", as_of=D3) == [("EUR", 2100.0), ("USD", 480.0)]
    assert allocation(db.s, db.user.id, "asset_type", as_of=D3) == [("Acciones", 2280.0), ("Fondos", 300.0)]


class _Provider:
    name = "fake"

    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def daily_closes(self, symbols, start, end=None):
        self.calls.append((sorted(symbols), start))
        return {}


def test_benchmarks_are_refreshed_only_when_there_are_operations(db):
    ensure_benchmark(db.s, "sp500")
    provider = _Provider()
    refresh_market_data(db.s, provider, today=D3)
    assert provider.calls == []
    op(db, db.enr, B, D1, 10, 1000.0)
    refresh_market_data(db.s, provider, today=D3)
    symbols, start = provider.calls[0]
    assert "SXR8.DE" in symbols and start == D1 - timedelta(days=7)
```

## `tests/test_investments_portfolio.py`

```python
"""
tests/test_investments_portfolio.py
===================================
Positions, FIFO lots, realized gains, valuation and XIRR of the Inversiones
module. Pure calculations use plain dataclasses; one test goes through the
ORM to prove the engine reads real InvestmentTransaction rows.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date
from typing import Optional

import pytest
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.database import _build_engine
from app.db.models import (
    AssetType,
    Base,
    InvestmentKind,
    InvestmentTransaction,
    PriceHistory,
    Security,
    User,
)
from app.investments.portfolio import (
    LedgerError,
    build_positions,
    ledger_error,
    realized_by_year,
    validate_fields,
    value_position,
)
from app.investments.returns import investor_cash_flows, xirr


@dataclass
class T:
    kind: InvestmentKind
    trade_date: date
    quantity: Optional[float] = None
    amount_eur: float = 0.0
    security_id: int = 1
    fees_eur: float = 0.0
    tax_withheld_eur: float = 0.0
    cash_paid_eur: Optional[float] = None
    split_ratio: Optional[float] = None
    id: Optional[int] = None


def buy(d, qty, eur, **kw):
    return T(InvestmentKind.buy, d, qty, eur, **kw)


def sell(d, qty, eur, **kw):
    return T(InvestmentKind.sell, d, qty, eur, **kw)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FIFO and positions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_sale_consumes_oldest_lots_first():
    ledger = [
        buy(date(2024, 1, 10), 10, 1000.0, id=1),   # 100 €/share
        buy(date(2024, 6, 10), 10, 1500.0, id=2),   # 150 €/share
        sell(date(2025, 3, 1), 15, 2400.0, id=3),   # 160 €/share
    ]
    position = build_positions(ledger)[1]

    assert [(r.acquired, r.quantity) for r in position.realized] == [
        (date(2024, 1, 10), 10), (date(2024, 6, 10), 5),
    ]
    first, second = position.realized
    assert first.cost_eur == pytest.approx(1000.0)
    assert first.proceeds_eur == pytest.approx(1600.0)
    assert second.cost_eur == pytest.approx(750.0)
    assert second.proceeds_eur == pytest.approx(800.0)
    assert position.realized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(650.0)
    # What is left is the newer lot at its own price.
    assert position.quantity == pytest.approx(5)
    assert position.cost_basis_eur == pytest.approx(750.0)
    assert position.average_cost_eur == pytest.approx(150.0)


def test_ledger_order_does_not_matter_only_dates():
    ledger = [
        sell(date(2025, 3, 1), 15, 2400.0, id=3),
        buy(date(2024, 6, 10), 10, 1500.0, id=2),
        buy(date(2024, 1, 10), 10, 1000.0, id=1),
    ]
    assert build_positions(ledger)[1].realized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(650.0)


def test_selling_more_than_held_is_rejected_in_spanish():
    ledger = [buy(date(2024, 1, 10), 10, 1000.0), sell(date(2024, 2, 1), 11, 1200.0)]
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError, match="solo había 10"):
        build_positions(ledger)


def test_sale_dated_before_the_purchase_is_rejected():
    ledger = [buy(date(2024, 5, 1), 10, 1000.0), sell(date(2024, 4, 1), 5, 600.0)]
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError, match="01/04/2024"):
        build_positions(ledger)


def test_same_day_buy_and_sell_replays_buy_first():
    d = date(2024, 5, 1)
    ledger = [sell(d, 10, 1100.0, id=2), buy(d, 10, 1000.0, id=1)]
    position = build_positions(ledger)[1]
    assert not position.is_open
    assert position.realized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(100.0)


def test_fractional_fund_units_sold_in_full_leave_no_residue():
    ledger = [
        buy(date(2023, 1, 2), 6.803561, 1000.0),
        buy(date(2023, 2, 1), 3.333333, 500.0),
        sell(date(2024, 1, 2), 10.136894, 1700.0),
    ]
    position = build_positions(ledger)[1]
    assert not position.is_open
    assert position.lots == []
    assert position.realized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(200.0)


def test_split_multiplies_shares_and_keeps_cost():
    ledger = [
        buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 10, 1000.0),
        T(InvestmentKind.split, date(2024, 6, 1), split_ratio=2.0),
        sell(date(2024, 7, 1), 20, 1200.0),
    ]
    position = build_positions(ledger)[1]
    assert position.realized[0].quantity == pytest.approx(20)
    assert position.realized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(200.0)


def test_grant_keeps_tax_basis_and_cash_paid_apart():
    ledger = [
        T(InvestmentKind.grant, date(2024, 3, 1), 10, 1000.0, cash_paid_eur=0.0),
        sell(date(2024, 9, 1), 10, 1300.0),
    ]
    position = build_positions(ledger)[1]
    # Tax: gain over the market value that was already taxed as salary.
    assert position.realized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(300.0)


def test_positions_are_kept_per_security():
    ledger = [
        buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 10, 1000.0, security_id=1),
        buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 5, 900.0, security_id=2),
        sell(date(2024, 2, 1), 5, 1000.0, security_id=2),
    ]
    positions = build_positions(ledger)
    assert positions[1].quantity == pytest.approx(10)
    assert not positions[2].is_open


def test_dividends_are_accumulated_without_changing_shares():
    ledger = [
        buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 10, 1000.0),
        T(InvestmentKind.dividend, date(2024, 6, 1), amount_eur=8.5, tax_withheld_eur=1.5),
        T(InvestmentKind.dividend, date(2024, 12, 1), amount_eur=8.5, tax_withheld_eur=1.5),
    ]
    position = build_positions(ledger)[1]
    assert position.quantity == pytest.approx(10)
    assert position.dividends_eur == pytest.approx(17.0)
    assert position.dividends_withheld_eur == pytest.approx(3.0)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.mark.parametrize("txn, message", [
    (buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 0, 100.0), "acciones"),
    (buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 1, 0.0), "mayor que cero"),
    (sell(date(2024, 1, 1), 1, -5.0), "negativo"),
    (T(InvestmentKind.dividend, date(2024, 1, 1), amount_eur=0.0), "dividendo"),
    (T(InvestmentKind.split, date(2024, 1, 1), split_ratio=1.0), "split"),
    (buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 1, 100.0, fees_eur=-1.0), "Comisiones"),
])
def test_validate_fields_reports_problems_in_spanish(txn, message):
    errors = validate_fields(txn)
    assert errors and message in " ".join(errors)


def test_editing_an_old_buy_down_is_caught_by_the_later_sale():
    ledger = [buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 10, 1000.0, id=1), sell(date(2024, 5, 1), 8, 900.0, id=2)]
    assert ledger_error(ledger) is None
    edited = [buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 5, 500.0, id=1), ledger[1]]
    error = ledger_error(edited)
    assert error is not None and error.transaction is ledger[1]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Valuation and yearly report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_value_position_converts_usd_to_eur():
    position = build_positions([buy(date(2024, 1, 1), 10, 900.0)])[1]
    value = value_position(position, price=110.0, fx_rate=1.10,
                           previous_price=99.0, previous_fx_rate=1.10)
    assert value.market_value_eur == pytest.approx(1000.0)
    assert value.unrealized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(100.0)
    assert value.unrealized_pct == pytest.approx(100.0 / 900.0)
    assert value.day_change_eur == pytest.approx(100.0)


def test_value_position_eur_security_without_previous_close():

    value = value_position(position, price=142.6)
    assert value.market_value_eur == pytest.approx(285.2)
    assert value.day_change_eur is None


def test_realized_by_year_splits_gains_losses_and_dividends():
    ledger = [
        buy(date(2023, 1, 1), 10, 1000.0, security_id=1),
        buy(date(2023, 1, 1), 10, 1000.0, security_id=2),
        sell(date(2024, 5, 1), 10, 1300.0, security_id=1),   # +300 in 2024
        sell(date(2025, 5, 1), 10, 800.0, security_id=2),    # -200 in 2025
        T(InvestmentKind.dividend, date(2024, 6, 1), amount_eur=17.0,
          tax_withheld_eur=3.0, security_id=2),
    ]

    assert list(years) == [2024, 2025]
    assert years[2024].gains_eur == pytest.approx(300.0)
    assert years[2024].dividends_eur == pytest.approx(17.0)
    assert years[2024].withheld_eur == pytest.approx(3.0)
    assert years[2025].losses_eur == pytest.approx(-200.0)
    assert years[2025].net_gain_eur == pytest.approx(-200.0)

def test_xirr_accounts_for_timing_of_contributions():

    flows = [

def test_engine_reads_orm_rows_and_security_with_trades_cannot_be_deleted(orm_session):
    s = orm_session
    user = User(username="pedro", password_hash="x")
    gev = Security(symbol="GEV", name="GE Vernova Inc.", asset_type=AssetType.stock,
                   currency="USD", exchange="NYSE")
    s.add_all([user, gev])
    s.flush()
    s.add_all([
        InvestmentTransaction(user_id=user.id, security_id=gev.id, broker="EquatePlus",
                              kind=InvestmentKind.buy, trade_date=date(2025, 3, 3),
                              quantity=2, price=300.0, currency="USD", amount_eur=575.40),
        InvestmentTransaction(user_id=user.id, security_id=gev.id, broker="EquatePlus",
                              kind=InvestmentKind.sell, trade_date=date(2026, 3, 3),
                              quantity=1, price=800.0, currency="USD", amount_eur=700.0),
        PriceHistory(security_id=gev.id, price_date=date(2026, 9, 25), close=957.63),
    ])
    s.commit()

    rows = s.query(InvestmentTransaction).filter_by(user_id=user.id).all()
    position = build_positions(rows)[gev.id]
    assert position.quantity == pytest.approx(1)
    assert position.realized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(700.0 - 287.70)

    s.delete(gev)
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
        s.commit()
    s.rollback()

    # Deleting the user removes their ledger (cascade) but not the shared security.
    s.delete(s.get(User, user.id))
    s.commit()
    assert s.query(InvestmentTransaction).count() == 0
    assert s.query(Security).count() == 1
```

```python
class FakeProvider:
    name = "Fake"

    def __init__(self, closes=None, fail=False):
        self.closes = closes or {}
        self.fail = fail
        self.calls = []
        self.info_calls = []

    def search(self, text, limit=10):
        return []

    def security_info(self, symbol):
        self.info_calls.append(symbol)
        if symbol == "NOPE":
            raise MarketDataError("Yahoo Finance no tiene datos del valor NOPE.")
        return SecurityInfo(symbol=symbol, name=f"{symbol} Inc.", asset_type=AssetType.stock,
                            currency="USD", exchange="NYSE", sector="Industrials",
                            country="United States")

    def daily_closes(self, symbols, start, end=None):
        self.calls.append((sorted(symbols), start))
        if self.fail:
            raise MarketDataError("No se pudo conectar con Yahoo Finance.")
        return {s: [(d, v) for d, v in rows if d >= start]
                for s, rows in self.closes.items() if s in symbols}


def days(start, values):
    return [(start + timedelta(days=i), v) for i, v in enumerate(values)]

def _stub_yf(frame=None, error=None, quotes=None, info=None):
    def download(*args, **kwargs):
        if error:
            raise error
        return frame

    return SimpleNamespace(
        download=download,
        Search=lambda *a, **k: SimpleNamespace(quotes=quotes or []),
        Ticker=lambda symbol: SimpleNamespace(info=info or {}),
    )


def test_yahoo_daily_closes_parses_multiindex_and_drops_nan(monkeypatch):
    index = pd.to_datetime(["2026-09-24", "2026-09-25"])
    columns = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([["Close", "Open"], ["AMZ.DE", "GEV"]])
    frame = pd.DataFrame([[216.75, 955.0, 1, 1], [218.45, float("nan"), 1, 1]],
                         index=index, columns=columns)
    provider = YahooProvider()
    monkeypatch.setattr(provider, "_yf", lambda: _stub_yf(frame))
    closes = provider.daily_closes(["GEV", "AMZ.DE", "MISSING"], start=date(2026, 9, 1))
    assert closes["AMZ.DE"] == [(date(2026, 9, 24), 216.75), (date(2026, 9, 25), 218.45)]
    assert closes["GEV"] == [(date(2026, 9, 24), 955.0)]
    assert "MISSING" not in closes

    with pytest.raises(MarketDataError, match="conexión"):
        provider.daily_closes(["GEV"], start=date(2026, 9, 1))
    monkeypatch.setattr(provider, "_yf", lambda: _stub_yf(frame=pd.DataFrame()))
    with pytest.raises(MarketDataError):
        provider.daily_closes(["GEV"], start=date(2026, 9, 1))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Background refresher
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _wait_for(signal, timeout_ms=10000):
    received = []
    loop = QEventLoop()
    signal.connect(lambda value: (received.append(value), loop.quit()))
    QTimer.singleShot(timeout_ms, loop.quit)
    loop.exec()
    return received


def test_refresher_runs_in_background_and_tracks_last_success(db):
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    refresher = PriceRefresher(provider=FakeProvider(full_closes()),
                               session_factory=db.factory)
    assert refresher.refresh()
    assert not refresher.refresh()              # one refresh at a time
    received = _wait_for(refresher.finished)
    assert received and received[0].ok
    assert refresher.last_success is not None and not refresher.running
    assert not refresher.refresh_if_stale()     # fresh: nothing to do
    db.session.expire_all()
    assert db.session.query(PriceHistory).count() > 0
    assert app is not None


def test_refresher_failure_does_not_mark_success(db):
    QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    refresher = PriceRefresher(provider=FakeProvider(fail=True), session_factory=db.factory)
    refresher.refresh()
    received = _wait_for(refresher.finished)
    assert received and not received[0].ok
    assert refresher.last_success is None
```

```python
"""
tests/test_investments_snapshot.py

Portfolio snapshot behind the Posiciones tab: valuation with FX, day

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.database import _build_engine
from app.db.models import Base, FxRate, InvestmentKind, PriceHistory, Security, User
from app.investments.ledger import TransactionDraft, save_transaction

def op(db, user, sec, kind, d, qty=None, eur=0.0, broker="DEGIRO", **kw):
    save_transaction(db.s, user.id, TransactionDraft(
        security_id=sec.id, kind=kind, trade_date=d, broker=broker,
        quantity=qty, amount_eur=eur, **kw))


B, S, D = InvestmentKind.buy, InvestmentKind.sell, InvestmentKind.dividend


def test_values_positions_in_eur_with_day_change_and_weights(db):
    op(db, db.pedro, db.gev, B, date(2025, 3, 3), 2, 1200.0, broker="EquatePlus")   # 2×1000/1.25 = 1600
    op(db, db.pedro, db.enr, B, date(2025, 2, 3), 10, 1000.0)                        # 10×150 = 1500
    snap = portfolio_snapshot(db.s, db.pedro.id, as_of=AS_OF)
    gev, enr = snap.rows                          # sorted by market value
    assert gev.security.symbol == "GEV"
    assert gev.market_value_eur == pytest.approx(1600.0)
    assert gev.unrealized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(400.0)
    assert gev.unrealized_pct == pytest.approx(400 / 1200)
    assert gev.day_change_eur == pytest.approx(2 * 50 / 1.25)
    assert gev.day_change_pct == pytest.approx(50 / 950)
    assert enr.day_change_eur == pytest.approx(100.0)
    assert gev.weight + enr.weight == pytest.approx(1.0)

    totals = snap.totals
    assert totals.market_value_eur == pytest.approx(3100.0)
    assert totals.cost_basis_eur == pytest.approx(2200.0)
    assert totals.unrealized_gain_eur == pytest.approx(900.0)
    assert totals.day_change_eur == pytest.approx(180.0)
    assert totals.day_change_pct == pytest.approx(180.0 / (3100.0 - 180.0))
    assert totals.open_positions == 2 and totals.missing_prices == []
    assert totals.xirr is not None and totals.xirr > 0
    assert totals.last_price_date == AS_OF


def test_realized_and_dividends_of_the_year_and_closed_positions(db):
    op(db, db.pedro, db.enr, B, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0)

def test_missing_price_is_valued_at_cost_and_listed(db):
```

```python
"""
tests/test_investments_tax.py
=============================
Pending dividends/splits detection, split-adjusted history, the yearly tax
report (FIFO lots, anti-repurchase rule, dividends) and its Excel export.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db.database import _build_engine
from app.db.models import (
    PRICE_SOURCE_MANUAL,
    AssetType,
    Base,
    FxRate,
    InvestmentKind,
    PriceHistory,
    Security,
    User,
)
from app.investments.events import pending_events
from app.investments.ledger import TransactionDraft, delete_transaction, save_transaction
from app.investments.market_data import CorporateActions
from app.investments.performance import portfolio_history
from app.investments.prices import set_manual_price
from app.investments.tax_report import add_months, export_xlsx, report_years, tax_report

B, S, D, SP = (InvestmentKind.buy, InvestmentKind.sell, InvestmentKind.dividend,
               InvestmentKind.split)


@pytest.fixture
def db(tmp_path):
    engine = _build_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'tax.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    s = Session(engine)
    user = User(username="pedro", password_hash="x")
    other = User(username="maria", password_hash="x")
    gev = Security(symbol="GEV", name="GE Vernova Inc.", currency="USD", isin="US36828A1016")
    enr = Security(symbol="ENR.DE", name="Siemens Energy AG", currency="EUR")
    fund = Security(symbol="0P00008XG7.F", name="Boreas", currency="EUR", asset_type=AssetType.fund)
    s.add_all([user, other, gev, enr, fund])
    s.flush()
    s.add(FxRate(currency="USD", rate_date=date(2026, 1, 2), rate=1.25))
    s.commit()
    yield SimpleNamespace(s=s, user=user, other=other, gev=gev, enr=enr, fund=fund,
                          path=tmp_path)
    s.close()
    engine.dispose()


def op(db, sec, kind, d, qty=None, eur=0.0, user=None, **kw):
    return save_transaction(db.s, (user or db.user).id, TransactionDraft(
        security_id=sec.id, kind=kind, trade_date=d, broker=kw.pop("broker", "DEGIRO"),
        quantity=qty, amount_eur=eur, **kw))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pending corporate actions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_unregistered_dividends_and_splits_are_proposed(db):
    op(db, db.gev, B, date(2025, 3, 3), 4, 1000.0)
    actions = {"GEV": CorporateActions(
        dividends=((date(2024, 12, 20), 0.25), (date(2026, 1, 5), 0.5), (date(2026, 3, 17), 0.5)),
        splits=((date(2026, 2, 1), 2.0),))}
    op(db, db.gev, D, date(2026, 3, 30), eur=1.36, tax_withheld_eur=0.24)   # pays the March one
    events = pending_events(db.s, db.user.id, actions, today=date(2026, 9, 27))
    assert [(e.kind, e.ex_date) for e in events] == [
        (SP, date(2026, 2, 1)), (D, date(2026, 1, 5))]
    split, dividend = events
    assert split.ratio == 2.0 and split.shares == 4
    assert dividend.shares == 4 and dividend.gross_eur == pytest.approx(4 * 0.5 / 1.25)
    assert dividend.key == "dividend|GEV|2026-01-05"
    # Dismissed ones disappear; before the first purchase nothing is proposed.
    assert pending_events(db.s, db.user.id, actions, dismissed={dividend.key, split.key},
                          today=date(2026, 9, 27)) == []


def test_no_dividend_proposed_when_nothing_was_held_or_for_other_users(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2025, 1, 2), 10, 1000.0)
    op(db, db.enr, S, date(2025, 6, 1), 10, 1200.0)
    actions = {"ENR.DE": CorporateActions(dividends=((date(2026, 2, 27), 0.7),))}
    assert pending_events(db.s, db.user.id, actions) == []
    assert pending_events(db.s, db.other.id, actions) == []


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Splits: history and price cache
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_history_uses_split_adjusted_closes_correctly(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2026, 1, 5), 10, 1000.0)          # paid 100 €/share pre-split
    op(db, db.enr, SP, date(2026, 1, 7), split_ratio=2.0)      # resets the price cache
    # What the provider returns after a 2-for-1 split on 2026-01-07: earlier closes halved.
    for day, close in ((date(2026, 1, 5), 50.0), (date(2026, 1, 6), 55.0), (date(2026, 1, 7), 60.0)):
        db.s.add(PriceHistory(security_id=db.enr.id, price_date=day, close=close))
    db.s.commit()
    values = [round(p.value_eur, 2) for p in portfolio_history(db.s, db.user.id,
                                                               end=date(2026, 1, 7)).points]
    assert values == [1000.0, 1100.0, 1200.0]


def test_saving_or_deleting_a_split_resets_downloaded_prices_only(db):
    db.s.add(PriceHistory(security_id=db.enr.id, price_date=date(2026, 1, 5), close=50.0))
    db.s.commit()
    set_manual_price(db.s, db.enr.id, date(2026, 1, 6), 51.0)
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2026, 1, 5), 10, 1000.0)
    split = op(db, db.enr, SP, date(2026, 1, 7), split_ratio=2.0)
    rows = db.s.query(PriceHistory).filter_by(security_id=db.enr.id).all()
    assert [(r.price_date, r.source) for r in rows] == [(date(2026, 1, 6), PRICE_SOURCE_MANUAL)]
    db.s.add(PriceHistory(security_id=db.enr.id, price_date=date(2026, 1, 8), close=60.0))
    db.s.commit()
    delete_transaction(db.s, db.user.id, split.id)
    assert db.s.query(PriceHistory).filter_by(security_id=db.enr.id, source="yahoo").count() == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_add_months_clamps_end_of_month():
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 31), -1) == date(2026, 2, 28)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 11, 15), 2) == date(2027, 1, 15)


def test_sales_are_reported_per_fifo_lot_with_totals(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2024, 1, 10), 10, 1000.0)
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2024, 6, 10), 10, 1500.0)
    op(db, db.enr, S, date(2025, 3, 1), 15, 2400.0)
    report = tax_report(db.s, db.user.id, 2025)
    assert [(s.acquired, s.quantity) for s in report.sales] == [
        (date(2024, 1, 10), 10), (date(2024, 6, 10), 5)]
    assert report.proceeds_eur == pytest.approx(2400.0)
    assert report.cost_eur == pytest.approx(1750.0)
    assert report.gains_eur == pytest.approx(650.0) and report.losses_eur == 0
    assert report.blocked_losses_eur == 0 and report.computable_net_eur == pytest.approx(650.0)
    assert tax_report(db.s, db.user.id, 2024).sales == []


def test_loss_with_repurchase_within_two_months_is_blocked(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2025, 1, 10), 10, 1500.0)
    op(db, db.enr, S, date(2025, 5, 2), 10, 1000.0)          # -500
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2025, 6, 20), 4, 420.0)           # 49 days later
    report = tax_report(db.s, db.user.id, 2025)
    line = report.sales[0]
    assert line.gain_eur == pytest.approx(-500.0)
    assert line.blocked_eur == pytest.approx(-200.0)          # 4 of 10 shares repurchased
    assert line.repurchases == [date(2025, 6, 20)]
    assert report.net_eur == pytest.approx(-500.0)
    assert report.computable_net_eur == pytest.approx(-300.0)


def test_shares_bought_just_before_and_still_held_block_the_loss(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2024, 1, 10), 10, 1500.0)
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2025, 4, 1), 10, 1000.0)          # within 2 months before the sale
    op(db, db.enr, S, date(2025, 5, 2), 10, 1000.0)          # FIFO sells the 2024 lot: -500
    line = tax_report(db.s, db.user.id, 2025).sales[0]
    assert line.blocked_eur == pytest.approx(-500.0)
    assert line.repurchases == [date(2025, 4, 1)]


def test_repurchase_outside_the_window_or_a_gain_is_not_flagged(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2025, 1, 10), 10, 1500.0)
    op(db, db.enr, S, date(2025, 5, 2), 10, 1000.0)
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2025, 7, 10), 4, 420.0)           # > 2 months later
    assert tax_report(db.s, db.user.id, 2025).sales[0].blocked_eur == 0


def test_funds_use_a_one_year_window(db):
    op(db, db.fund, B, date(2025, 1, 10), 10, 1500.0, broker="Tressis")
    op(db, db.fund, S, date(2025, 5, 2), 10, 1000.0, broker="Tressis")
    op(db, db.fund, B, date(2025, 12, 1), 10, 900.0, broker="Tressis")
    assert tax_report(db.s, db.user.id, 2025).sales[0].blocked_eur == pytest.approx(-500.0)


def test_dividends_gross_withholding_and_years(db):
    op(db, db.gev, B, date(2025, 3, 3), 4, 1000.0)
    op(db, db.gev, D, date(2025, 4, 30), eur=8.5, tax_withheld_eur=1.5)
    op(db, db.gev, D, date(2026, 1, 20), eur=1.7, tax_withheld_eur=0.3)

    assert (report.dividends_gross_eur, report.dividends_withheld_eur, report.dividends_net_eur) == (
        pytest.approx(10.0), pytest.approx(1.5), pytest.approx(8.5))
    assert report_years(db.s, db.user.id) == [2026, 2025]
    assert report_years(db.s, db.other.id) == []


def test_excel_export_has_three_sheets_with_values(db):
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2025, 1, 10), 10, 1500.0)
    op(db, db.enr, S, date(2025, 5, 2), 10, 1000.0)
    op(db, db.enr, B, date(2025, 6, 20), 4, 420.0)
    op(db, db.gev, B, date(2025, 3, 3), 4, 1000.0)
    op(db, db.gev, D, date(2025, 4, 30), eur=8.5, tax_withheld_eur=1.5)
    path = export_xlsx(tax_report(db.s, db.user.id, 2025), db.path / "informe.xlsx", owner="pedro")
    wb = load_workbook(path)
    assert wb.sheetnames == ["Resumen", "Ganancias y pérdidas", "Dividendos"]
    summary = {row[0]: row[1] for row in wb["Resumen"].iter_rows(values_only=True) if row and row[0]}
    assert summary["Resultado neto"] == pytest.approx(-500.0)
    assert summary["Resultado computable"] == pytest.approx(-300.0)
    assert summary["Dividendos íntegros (brutos)"] == pytest.approx(10.0)
    sale = list(wb["Ganancias y pérdidas"].iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True))[0]
    assert sale[0] == "Siemens Energy AG" and sale[9] == pytest.approx(-500.0)
    assert sale[10] == pytest.approx(-200.0) and sale[11] == "20/06/2025"
    dividend = list(wb["Dividendos"].iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True))[0]
    assert dividend[2] == "US36828A1016" and dividend[5] == pytest.approx(10.0)
```

## `tests/test_library_io.py`

```python
"""
tests/test_library_io.py
========================
Export / import of the categorization library (categories + rules):
round trip, idempotency, merge vs replace, global rules, validation of
hostile or damaged files, and all-or-nothing apply.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import gzip
import json
from datetime import date

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, event
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.auth.auth_service import create_user
from app.categorization import library_io as lio
from app.categorization.category_manager import seed_default_categories, seed_default_rules
from app.db.database import _set_sqlite_pragma
from app.db.models import (
    CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL, Account, AutoCategorizationRule, Base, Category,
    CategoryLevel, MatchType, Transaction, TransactionType,
)


@pytest.fixture
def session():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:")
    event.listen(engine, "connect", _set_sqlite_pragma)
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sess = sessionmaker(bind=engine)()
    yield sess
    sess.close()
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture
def ana(session):
    return create_user(session, "ana", "clave-secreta-1").id


@pytest.fixture
def beto(session):
    return create_user(session, "beto", "clave-secreta-2").id


def _cat(session, user_id, type_name, name):
    type_node = session.query(Category).filter_by(user_id=user_id, name=type_name,
                                                  level=CategoryLevel.type).one()
    return session.query(Category).filter_by(user_id=user_id, parent_id=type_node.id, name=name).one()


def _add_rule(session, user_id, category, pattern, kind=MatchType.contains, priority=100):
    rule = AutoCategorizationRule(user_id=user_id, category_id=category.id, match_pattern=pattern,
                                  match_type=kind, priority=priority)
    session.add(rule)
    session.commit()
    return rule


def _snapshot(session, user_id):
    """Tree and personal rules by natural key — what a round trip must keep."""
    cats = sorted((c.parent.name if c.parent else "", c.name, c.level.value)
                  for c in session.query(Category).filter_by(user_id=user_id))
    rules = sorted((r.category.parent.name, r.category.name, r.match_pattern, r.match_type.value, r.priority)
                   for r in session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).filter_by(user_id=user_id))
    return cats, rules


def _roundtrip(session, user_id, **kw):
    return lio.parse_library(lio.dumps(lio.export_library(session, user_id, **kw)))


@pytest.fixture
def seeded(session, ana):
    seed_default_categories(session, ana)
    seed_default_rules(session, ana)
    return ana


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_roundtrip_into_empty_user_reproduces_tree_and_rules(session, seeded, beto):
    lib = _roundtrip(session, seeded)
    assert lib.checksum_ok
    result = lio.apply_import(session, beto, lib)
    assert result.categories_created > 0 and result.rules_created > 0
    assert _snapshot(session, beto) == _snapshot(session, seeded)


def test_export_is_deterministic_apart_from_timestamp(session, seeded):
    first = json.loads(lio.dumps(lio.export_library(session, seeded)))
    second = json.loads(lio.dumps(lio.export_library(session, seeded)))
    for payload in (first, second):
        payload.pop("exported_at")
        payload.pop("checksum")
    assert first == second


def test_export_has_no_ids_and_carries_versions(session, seeded):
    payload = lio.export_library(session, seeded, source_user="ana")
    assert payload["format"] == lio.FORMAT_NAME and payload["format_version"] == lio.FORMAT_VERSION
    assert payload["app_version"] and payload["db_schema_version"] >= 1
    assert '"id"' not in lio.dumps(payload).decode()


def test_import_twice_changes_nothing_the_second_time(session, seeded, beto):
    lib = _roundtrip(session, seeded)
    lio.apply_import(session, beto, lib)
    plan = lio.plan_import(session, beto, lib)
    assert not plan.has_changes
    result = lio.apply_import(session, beto, lib)
    assert (result.categories_created, result.rules_created) == (0, 0)


def test_same_category_name_under_two_types_is_kept_apart(session, ana, beto):
    for type_name, tx in (("GASTO", TransactionType.expense), ("INGRESO", TransactionType.income)):
        root = Category(user_id=ana, name=type_name, level=CategoryLevel.type, transaction_type=tx)
        session.add(root)
        session.flush()
        session.add(Category(user_id=ana, parent_id=root.id, name="Hipoteca", level=CategoryLevel.category))
    session.commit()
    _add_rule(session, ana, _cat(session, ana, "INGRESO", "Hipoteca"), "DEVOLUCION HIPOTECA")

    lio.apply_import(session, beto, _roundtrip(session, ana))
    rule = session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).filter_by(user_id=beto).one()
    assert rule.category.parent.name == "INGRESO"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge / replace
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.fixture
def two_libraries(session, ana, beto):
    """ana: GASTO › Super (MERCADONA 100, LIDL 100). beto: GASTO › Super (MERCADONA 50, ALDI)."""
    for uid in (ana, beto):
        root = Category(user_id=uid, name="GASTO", level=CategoryLevel.type,
                        transaction_type=TransactionType.expense)
        session.add(root)
        session.flush()
        session.add(Category(user_id=uid, parent_id=root.id, name="Super", level=CategoryLevel.category))
    session.commit()
    _add_rule(session, ana, _cat(session, ana, "GASTO", "Super"), "MERCADONA")
    _add_rule(session, ana, _cat(session, ana, "GASTO", "Super"), "LIDL")
    _add_rule(session, beto, _cat(session, beto, "GASTO", "Super"), "mercadona", priority=50)
    _add_rule(session, beto, _cat(session, beto, "GASTO", "Super"), "ALDI")
    return _roundtrip(session, ana)


def _patterns(session, user_id):
    return {(r.match_pattern.upper(), r.priority)
            for r in session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).filter_by(user_id=user_id)}


def test_merge_only_adds(session, beto, two_libraries):
    plan = lio.plan_import(session, beto, two_libraries, lio.MODE_MERGE)
    assert [r.pattern for r in plan.new_rules] == ["LIDL"]
    assert not plan.deleted_rules and not plan.priority_changes
    lio.apply_import(session, beto, two_libraries, lio.MODE_MERGE)
    assert _patterns(session, beto) == {("MERCADONA", 50), ("ALDI", 100), ("LIDL", 100)}


def test_replace_makes_personal_rules_equal_to_the_file(session, beto, two_libraries):
    plan = lio.plan_import(session, beto, two_libraries, lio.MODE_REPLACE)
    assert len(plan.deleted_rules) == 1 and "ALDI" in plan.deleted_rules[0]
    assert [(r.pattern, old) for r, old in plan.priority_changes] == [("MERCADONA", 50)]
    result = lio.apply_import(session, beto, two_libraries, lio.MODE_REPLACE)
    assert (result.rules_created, result.rules_updated, result.rules_deleted) == (1, 1, 1)
    assert _patterns(session, beto) == {("MERCADONA", 100), ("LIDL", 100)}


def test_replace_never_deletes_categories_or_touches_transactions(session, beto, two_libraries):
    root = session.query(Category).filter_by(user_id=beto, name="GASTO").one()
    extra = Category(user_id=beto, parent_id=root.id, name="Solo de Beto", level=CategoryLevel.category)
    session.add(extra)
    account = Account(user_id=beto, account_name="Cuenta")
    session.add(account)
    session.flush()
    txn = Transaction(user_id=beto, account_id=account.id, transaction_date=date(2026, 1, 2),
                      concept="ALDI", amount=-5.0, type=TransactionType.expense,
                      category_id=extra.id, category_source=CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL)
    session.add(txn)
    session.commit()

    lio.apply_import(session, beto, two_libraries, lio.MODE_REPLACE)
    session.refresh(txn)
    assert session.get(Category, extra.id) is not None
    assert (txn.category_id, txn.category_source) == (extra.id, CATEGORY_SOURCE_MANUAL)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Global rules
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_global_rules_need_both_flags(session, ana, beto, two_libraries):
    _add_rule(session, None, _cat(session, ana, "GASTO", "Super"), "CARREFOUR")
    without = _roundtrip(session, ana)
    assert all(r.scope == lio.SCOPE_PERSONAL for r in without.rules)

    lib = _roundtrip(session, ana, include_global=True)
    assert any(r.scope == lio.SCOPE_GLOBAL for r in lib.rules)

    # The existing global rule is recognized, not duplicated.
    plan = lio.plan_import(session, beto, lib, allow_global=True)
    assert all(r.scope == lio.SCOPE_PERSONAL for r in plan.new_rules)

    session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).filter_by(user_id=None).delete()
    session.commit()
    plan = lio.plan_import(session, beto, lib, allow_global=False)
    assert plan.skipped_global == 1 and plan.warnings
    lio.apply_import(session, beto, lib, allow_global=False)
    assert session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).filter_by(user_id=None).count() == 0

    lio.apply_import(session, beto, lib, allow_global=True)
    rule = session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).filter_by(user_id=None).one()
    assert rule.category.user_id == beto


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _valid_payload():
    return {
        "format": lio.FORMAT_NAME, "format_version": 1,
        "types": [{"name": "GASTO", "transaction_type": "expense", "categories": ["Super"]}],
        "rules": [{"type": "GASTO", "category": "Super", "pattern": "LIDL",
                   "match_type": "contains", "priority": 100, "scope": "personal"}],
    }


def test_valid_payload_parses_and_gzip_is_accepted():
    raw = lio.dumps(_valid_payload())
    assert lio.parse_library(raw).checksum_ok
    assert lio.parse_library(gzip.compress(raw)).rules[0].pattern == "LIDL"


def test_hand_edited_file_is_flagged_not_rejected():
    payload = json.loads(lio.dumps(_valid_payload()))
    payload["rules"][0]["pattern"] = "ALDI"
    lib = lio.parse_library(json.dumps(payload).encode())
    assert not lib.checksum_ok and lib.rules[0].pattern == "ALDI"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutate, message", [
    (lambda p: p.update(format="otra.cosa"), "biblioteca"),
    (lambda p: p.update(format_version=99), "versión de formato 99"),
    (lambda p: p["rules"][0].update(match_type="regex", pattern="(sin cerrar"), "regular"),
    (lambda p: p["rules"][0].update(priority=0), "Prioridad"),
    (lambda p: p["rules"][0].update(priority=True), "Prioridad"),
    (lambda p: p["rules"][0].update(category="Inexistente"), "no está en el archivo"),
    (lambda p: p["rules"][0].update(scope="todos"), "Ámbito"),
    (lambda p: p["types"][0].update(transaction_type="robo"), "desconocido"),
    (lambda p: p["types"][0].update(name="x" * 200), "supera"),
    (lambda p: p["types"].append(dict(p["types"][0])), "dos veces"),
    (lambda p: p.pop("rules"), "secciones"),
])
def test_invalid_files_are_rejected_with_a_clear_message(mutate, message):
    payload = _valid_payload()
    mutate(payload)
    with pytest.raises(lio.LibraryError, match=message):
        lio.parse_library(json.dumps(payload).encode())


def test_garbage_oversized_and_gzip_bomb_are_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(lio.LibraryError, match="JSON"):
        lio.parse_library(b"\x00\x01not json")
    with pytest.raises(lio.LibraryError, match="grande"):
        lio.parse_library(b" " * (lio.MAX_FILE_BYTES + 1))
    bomb = gzip.compress(b" " * (lio.MAX_FILE_BYTES * 4))
    assert len(bomb) < lio.MAX_FILE_BYTES
    with pytest.raises(lio.LibraryError, match="grande"):
        lio.parse_library(bomb)


def test_older_format_is_upgraded(monkeypatch):
    payload = _valid_payload()
    monkeypatch.setattr(lio, "FORMAT_VERSION", 2)
    monkeypatch.setitem(lio._UPGRADES, 1, lambda p: {**p, "format_version": 2})
    assert lio.parse_library(json.dumps(payload).encode()).rules[0].pattern == "LIDL"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Atomicity
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_failure_half_way_leaves_the_database_unchanged(session, beto, two_libraries, monkeypatch):
    before = _snapshot(session, beto)
    real_add = session.add
    calls = {"n": 0}

    def flaky_add(obj):
        if isinstance(obj, AutoCategorizationRule):
            raise RuntimeError("disco lleno")
        calls["n"] += 1
        return real_add(obj)

    lib = lio.LibraryFile(types=list(two_libraries.types) + [lio.LibType("NUEVO", None, ("X",))],
                          rules=two_libraries.rules)
    monkeypatch.setattr(session, "add", flaky_add)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        lio.apply_import(session, beto, lib)
    monkeypatch.undo()
    assert calls["n"] > 0          # categories were added before the failure…
    assert _snapshot(session, beto) == before   # …and rolled back with it


def test_suggested_filename_is_safe():
    name = lio.suggested_filename("Ana María/../x", when=date(2026, 10, 9))
    assert name == "profin-categorias-Ana_Mar_a_x-20261009.profin-cats.json"


def test_rule_movement_type_survives_the_roundtrip(session, ana, beto):
    seed_default_categories(session, ana)
    seed_default_categories(session, beto)
    ocio = _cat(session, ana, "GASTO", "Ocio, Eventos y Bodas")
    aporte = _cat(session, ana, "INGRESO", "Aporte Comun Pedro")
    for category, kind in ((ocio, TransactionType.expense), (aporte, TransactionType.income), (ocio, None)):
        rule = _add_rule(session, ana, category, "BIZUM")
        rule.transaction_type = kind
    session.commit()

    lib = _roundtrip(session, ana)
    assert sorted((r.category, r.transaction_type or "") for r in lib.rules if r.pattern == "BIZUM") == [
        ("Aporte Comun Pedro", "income"), ("Ocio, Eventos y Bodas", ""), ("Ocio, Eventos y Bodas", "expense")]
    assert lio.apply_import(session, beto, lib).rules_created == 3
    got = sorted((r.category.name, r.transaction_type.value if r.transaction_type else "")
                 for r in session.query(AutoCategorizationRule).filter_by(user_id=beto, match_pattern="BIZUM"))
    assert got == [("Aporte Comun Pedro", "income"), ("Ocio, Eventos y Bodas", ""),
                   ("Ocio, Eventos y Bodas", "expense")]
    # Importing again changes nothing: the movement type is part of the key.
    assert not lio.plan_import(session, beto, lib).new_rules


def test_rule_movement_type_is_optional_and_validated():
    assert lio.parse_library(lio.dumps(_valid_payload())).rules[0].transaction_type is None
    payload = _valid_payload()
    payload["rules"][0]["transaction_type"] = "income"
    assert lio.parse_library(lio.dumps(payload)).rules[0].transaction_type == "income"
    payload["rules"][0]["transaction_type"] = "investment"
    with pytest.raises(lio.LibraryError, match="movimiento"):
        lio.parse_library(lio.dumps(payload))
```

```python
"""
tests/test_period_summary.py
=============================
SQL-side aggregates behind the Gastos / Ingresos views.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.analytics.period_summary import (
    UNCATEGORIZED_LABEL,
    category_totals,
    period_totals,
    summarize_period,
)
from app.auth.auth_service import create_user
from app.db.models import (
    Account, Base, Category, CategoryLevel, Transaction, TransactionType,
)


@pytest.fixture
def db_session():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)()
    yield session
    session.close()
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture
def family(db_session):
    ana = create_user(db_session, "ana", "clave-secreta-1")
    otro = create_user(db_session, "otro", "clave-secreta-1")
    accounts = {}
    for user in (ana, otro):
        account = Account(user_id=user.id, account_name="Cuenta")
        db_session.add(account)
        db_session.flush()
        accounts[user.id] = account.id
    gasto = Category(user_id=ana.id, name="GASTO", level=CategoryLevel.type,
                     transaction_type=TransactionType.expense)
    db_session.add(gasto)
    db_session.flush()
    super_ = Category(user_id=ana.id, parent_id=gasto.id, name="Supermercados",
                      level=CategoryLevel.category)
    luz = Category(user_id=ana.id, parent_id=gasto.id, name="Luz",
                   level=CategoryLevel.category)
    db_session.add_all([super_, luz])
    db_session.commit()

    def add(user, day, amount, category=None, issuer="X"):
        db_session.add(Transaction(
            user_id=user.id, account_id=accounts[user.id],
            transaction_date=day, amount=amount,
            type=TransactionType.expense if amount < 0 else TransactionType.income,
            category_id=category.id if category else None, issuer_name=issuer,
        ))

    add(ana, date(2026, 8, 30), -10.10, super_, "MERCADONA")
    add(ana, date(2026, 9, 1), -20.20, super_, "LIDL")
    add(ana, date(2026, 9, 1), -30.00, luz, "IBERDROLA")
    add(ana, date(2026, 9, 15), -5.05, None, "BAR")
    add(ana, date(2026, 9, 15), 1500.00, None, "NOMINA")   # income, excluded
    add(otro, date(2026, 9, 1), -999.0, None, "OTHER USER")  # other user, excluded
    db_session.commit()
    return ana


def test_summarize_period_totals_and_kpis(db_session, family):
    summary = summarize_period(
        db_session, family.id, TransactionType.expense,
        date(2026, 8, 1), date(2026, 9, 30),

    assert summary.total == 65.35
    assert summary.count == 4
    assert summary.max_amount == 30.0
    assert summary.categorized == 3
    assert summary.average == round(65.35 / 4, 2)


def test_summarize_period_groupings(db_session, family):
    summary = summarize_period(
        db_session, family.id, TransactionType.expense,

    assert summary.by_category == [
        ("Supermercados", 30.3), ("Luz", 30.0), (UNCATEGORIZED_LABEL, 5.05),
    ]

        date(2026, 8, 1), date(2026, 9, 1),
    ]
    assert summary.by_month_category[1][1][0] == ("Luz", 30.0)
    # Chronological across months (was sorted as "dd/mm" text before).
    assert [day for day, _ in summary.by_day] == [
        date(2026, 8, 30), date(2026, 9, 1), date(2026, 9, 15),
    ]
    assert summary.by_day[1] == (date(2026, 9, 1), 50.2)
    assert [row.description for row in summary.latest] == [
        "BAR", "IBERDROLA", "LIDL", "MERCADONA",
    ]
    assert summary.latest[0].category is None

def test_empty_period(db_session, family):

    )
    assert (summary.total, summary.count, summary.by_day, summary.latest) == (0.0, 0, [], [])
```

## `tests/test_release_tooling.py`

```python
"""
tests/test_release_tooling.py
==============================
Release pipeline guarantees:
  - ExportVersionHandler.export_version() runs without prompts and writes the
    full release notes into CHANGELOG.md (never loses older entries).
  - tools/release_tools.py collects every change since the last tag, refuses
    notes that miss a commit / area / schema migration, packages the whole
    one-dir build, and detects a GitHub Release that differs from the notes.
  - Invariants of this repository that a release relies on.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

import tools.ExportVersionHandler as evh
import tools.release_tools as rt

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

CHANGELOG_SEED = """# FAMILYFIN — Changelog

> Auto-generated by `tools/ExportVersionHandler.py`

---

**Snapshot:** `FAMILYFIN.R.0.3.0.md`  |  **Files:** 1  |  **Handler:** v1.0.0
**Date:** 2026-09-16 01:19  |  **Type:** Release
**Description:** Entrada anterior.
"""

NOTES = """### Resumen

Esta versión protege las categorías puestas a mano y hace copias de seguridad automáticas.

### Novedades

- Copias de seguridad automáticas.

### Áreas afectadas

- **Base de datos y migraciones**: `app/db/database.py`
"""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ExportVersionHandler
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.fixture
def evh_root(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    (tmp_path / "app").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "app" / "config.py").write_text(
        'APP_NAME    = "FAMILYFIN"\nAPP_VERSION = "0.3.0"\nAPP_RELEASE_DATE = "2026-09-16"\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (tmp_path / "main.py").write_text("print('hola')\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "CHANGELOG.md").write_text(CHANGELOG_SEED, encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setattr(evh, "ROOT", tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(evh, "VERSIONS_DIR", tmp_path / "versions")
    monkeypatch.setattr("builtins.input", lambda *a: pytest.fail("export_version prompted"))
    return tmp_path


def test_export_version_is_non_interactive_and_writes_full_notes(evh_root):
    summary, body = rt.split_notes(NOTES)
    evh.export_version(version="0.4.0", ver_type="R", also_prj=True,
                       description=summary, notes=body)

    config = (evh_root / "app" / "config.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert 'APP_VERSION = "0.4.0"' in config
    assert f'APP_RELEASE_DATE = "{date.today().isoformat()}"' in config
    assert (evh_root / "versions" / "FAMILYFIN.R.0.4.0.md").is_file()
    assert (evh_root / "versions" / "FAMILYFIN.R.0.4.0.prj").is_file()

    changelog = (evh_root / "CHANGELOG.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    entries = changelog.split("\n---\n")
    assert entries[0].startswith("# FAMILYFIN — Changelog")
    assert "`FAMILYFIN.R.0.4.0.md`" in entries[1]
    assert f"**Description:** {summary}" in entries[1]
    assert "- Copias de seguridad automáticas." in entries[1]
    assert "`FAMILYFIN.R.0.3.0.md`" in entries[2]   # older entry kept, below


def test_export_version_rejects_notes_with_separator_before_writing(evh_root):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        evh.export_version(version="0.4.0", ver_type="R", also_prj=False,
                           description="x", notes="- uno\n---\n- dos")
    assert 'APP_VERSION = "0.3.0"' in (evh_root / "app" / "config.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert (evh_root / "CHANGELOG.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == CHANGELOG_SEED


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# release_tools on a throwaway git repository
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _git(root: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args], cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
    ).stdout


DB_V1 = "SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS = (\n    (1, _migration_1_category_source),\n)\n"
DB_V3 = (
    "SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS = (\n    (1, _migration_1_category_source),\n"
    "    (2, _migration_2_indexes_and_cents),\n    (3, _migration_3_fix),\n)\n"
)


@pytest.fixture
def repo(tmp_path):
    root = tmp_path / "repo"
    (root / "app" / "db").mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / "app" / "gui").mkdir()
    (root / "docs" / "agent").mkdir(parents=True)
    _git(root, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    _git(root, "config", "user.email", "t@example.com")
    _git(root, "config", "user.name", "Test")
    _git(root, "config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
    (root / "app" / "config.py").write_text('APP_VERSION = "0.3.0"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "app" / "db" / "database.py").write_text(DB_V1, encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "app" / "gui" / "view.py").write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "docs" / "agent" / "agent_log.md").write_text(
        "## 2026-09-01 — Old work\n", encoding="utf-8")
    _git(root, "add", ".")
    _git(root, "commit", "-q", "-m", "chore(release): v0.3.0")
    _git(root, "tag", "-a", "v0.3.0", "-m", "v0.3.0")

    (root / "app" / "db" / "database.py").write_text(DB_V3, encoding="utf-8")
    _git(root, "commit", "-qam", "feat(db): migrations v2 and v3")
    (root / "app" / "gui" / "view.py").write_text("x = 2\n", encoding="utf-8")
    _git(root, "commit", "-qam", "fix: dashboard crash")
    (root / "app" / "config.py").write_text('APP_VERSION = "0.3.1"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    _git(root, "commit", "-qam", "chore(release): v0.3.1")
    with (root / "docs" / "agent" / "agent_log.md").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("\n## 2099-01-01 — New work\n")
    _git(root, "commit", "-qam", "docs: log")
    return root


def test_collect_changes_since_last_tag(repo):
    changes = rt.collect_changes(repo)

    assert changes.since_tag == "v0.3.0"
    subjects = [c.subject for c in changes.commits]
    assert subjects == ["docs: log", "fix: dashboard crash", "feat(db): migrations v2 and v3"]
    assert (changes.schema_from, changes.schema_to) == (1, 3)
    # config.py only had its version bumped → not a change of the "Interfaz" area
    assert set(changes.files_by_area) == {"db", "gui", "docs"}
    assert changes.files_by_area["gui"] == ["app/gui/view.py"]
    assert changes.log_entries == ["2099-01-01 — New work"]


def test_draft_contains_every_fact_and_is_not_publishable(repo):
    changes = rt.collect_changes(repo)
    draft = rt.draft_notes(changes, "0.4.0")

    for commit in changes.commits:
        assert commit.sha in draft
    assert rt.migration_sentence(1, 3) in draft
    for label in ("Base de datos y migraciones", "Interfaz", "Documentación"):
        assert label in draft
    assert rt.verify_notes(draft, changes)   # TODOs and comments left → refused


def test_verify_notes_accepts_complete_notes_and_names_what_is_missing(repo):
    changes = rt.collect_changes(repo)
    good = rt.draft_notes(changes, "0.4.0")
    good = re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->\n?", "", good, flags=re.DOTALL)
    good = good.replace(
        "TODO: 2-4 frases sobre qué cambia al actualizar a 0.4.0.",
        "La base de datos se repara sola y el panel principal ya no se cierra con error.",
    )
    good = re.sub(r"- TODO: (.*) \(`(\w+)`\)", r"- \1 (`\2`)", good)
    assert rt.verify_notes(good, changes) == []

    missing = good.replace(changes.commits[0].sha, "xxxxxxx").replace("**Interfaz**", "**UI**")
    missing = missing.replace(rt.migration_sentence(1, 3), "Se migra la base.")
    problems = "\n".join(rt.verify_notes(missing, changes))
    assert changes.commits[0].sha in problems
    assert "Interfaz" in problems
    assert "v1 a v3" in problems


def test_split_notes_separates_summary():
    summary, body = rt.split_notes(NOTES)
    assert summary.startswith("Esta versión protege")
    assert "### Resumen" not in body
    assert body.startswith("### Novedades")


def test_area_mapping_and_ignored_paths():
    assert rt.area_for("app/db/database.py").key == "db"
    assert rt.area_for("app/analytics/period_summary.py").key == "analytics"
    assert rt.area_for("tests/test_x.py").user_facing is False
    assert rt.area_for("CHANGELOG.md") is None
    assert rt.area_for("versions/FAMILYFIN.R.0.3.0.md") is None


def test_parse_version_orders_betas_before_final():
    assert rt.parse_version("0.4.0-beta.1") < rt.parse_version("0.4.0")
    assert rt.parse_version("0.4.0") > rt.parse_version("0.3.9")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rt.parse_version("v0.4")


def _fake_build(root: Path, complete: bool = True) -> Path:
    folder = rt.build_dir("0.4.0", "R", root)
    (folder / "_internal" / "PySide6").mkdir(parents=True)
    (folder / "PROFIN.R.0.4.0.exe").write_bytes(b"MZ")
    (folder / "_internal" / "PySide6" / "Qt6Core.dll").write_bytes(b"dll")
    if complete:
        (folder.parent / "PROFIN.R.0.4.0.build-ok").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    return folder


def test_package_build_zips_exe_and_internal_folder(tmp_path):
    _fake_build(tmp_path)

    target = rt.package_build("0.4.0", "R", tmp_path)

    with zipfile.ZipFile(target) as archive:
        names = set(archive.namelist())
    assert "PROFIN.R.0.4.0/PROFIN.R.0.4.0.exe" in names
    assert "PROFIN.R.0.4.0/_internal/PySide6/Qt6Core.dll" in names


def test_package_build_refuses_a_build_that_did_not_finish(tmp_path):
    _fake_build(tmp_path, complete=False)   # e.g. PyInstaller crashed in COLLECT
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="build-ok"):
        rt.package_build("0.4.0", "R", tmp_path)


def test_package_build_refuses_exe_without_internal(tmp_path):
    folder = rt.build_dir("0.4.0", "R", tmp_path)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    (folder / "PROFIN.R.0.4.0.exe").write_bytes(b"MZ")
    (folder.parent / "PROFIN.R.0.4.0.build-ok").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
        rt.package_build("0.4.0", "R", tmp_path)


def _released_repo(repo: Path, notes: str) -> None:
    """Simulate steps 4-6 of the skill on the throwaway repo."""
    summary, body = rt.split_notes(notes)
    (repo / "app" / "config.py").write_text(
        f'APP_VERSION = "0.4.0"\nAPP_RELEASE_DATE = "{date.today().isoformat()}"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    (repo / "versions").mkdir()
    for suffix in (".md", ".prj"):
        (repo / "versions" / f"FAMILYFIN.R.0.4.0{suffix}").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
    (repo / "CHANGELOG.md").write_text(
        "# FAMILYFIN — Changelog\n\n---\n\n**Snapshot:** `FAMILYFIN.R.0.4.0.md`\n"
        f"**Description:** {summary}\n\n{body}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    _git(repo, "add", ".")
    _git(repo, "commit", "-qm", "chore(release): v0.4.0")
    notes_file = repo.parent / "notes.md"
    notes_file.write_text(notes, encoding="utf-8")
    _git(repo, "tag", "-a", "v0.4.0", "--cleanup=verbatim", "-F", str(notes_file))
    zip_path = rt.build_zip("0.4.0", "R", repo)
    zip_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    zip_path.write_bytes(b"PK")


def test_postflight_checks_changelog_tag_package_and_github_release(repo):
    _released_repo(repo, NOTES)
    assert rt.postflight("0.4.0", "R", NOTES, root=repo) == []

    release = {
        "tagName": "v0.4.0", "body": NOTES, "isDraft": False, "isPrerelease": False,
        "assets": [{"name": "PROFIN.R.0.4.0-windows.zip"}],
    }
    import json
    ok_runner = lambda args: json.dumps(release)
    assert rt.postflight("0.4.0", "R", NOTES, root=repo, published=True, runner=ok_runner) == []

    bad = {**release, "body": "Otra cosa", "assets": [{"name": "PROFIN.R.0.4.0.exe"}]}
    problems = rt.postflight("0.4.0", "R", NOTES, root=repo, published=True,
                             runner=lambda args: json.dumps(bad))
    assert any("texto de la release" in p for p in problems)
    assert any("windows.zip" in p for p in problems)


def test_postflight_detects_tag_message_stripped_of_headings(repo):
    _released_repo(repo, NOTES)
    _git(repo, "tag", "-d", "v0.4.0")
    notes_file = repo.parent / "notes.md"
    _git(repo, "tag", "-a", "v0.4.0", "-F", str(notes_file))   # default cleanup=strip
    problems = rt.postflight("0.4.0", "R", NOTES, root=repo)
    assert any("mensaje del tag" in p for p in problems)


def test_postflight_detects_changelog_without_notes(repo):
    _released_repo(repo, NOTES)
    (repo / "CHANGELOG.md").write_text(
        "# FAMILYFIN — Changelog\n\n---\n\n**Snapshot:** `FAMILYFIN.R.0.4.0.md`\n"
        "**Description:** (no description)\n", encoding="utf-8")
    problems = rt.postflight("0.4.0", "R", NOTES, root=repo)
    assert any("resumen" in p for p in problems)
    assert any("cuerpo" in p for p in problems)

def test_app_version_matches_latest_changelog_entry():

def test_build_spec_reads_version_from_config():

def test_build_script_writes_marker_only_after_success(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import tools.build_windows as bw

    monkeypatch.setattr(bw, "ROOT", tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "app").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "app" / "config.py").write_text('APP_VERSION = "0.4.0"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    marker = tmp_path / "dist" / "PROFIN.R.0.4.0.build-ok"

    def crashed(*args, **kwargs):
        raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(1, "pyinstaller")

    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["build_windows.py", "--channel", "release"])
    monkeypatch.setattr(bw.subprocess, "run", crashed)
    (tmp_path / "dist").mkdir()
    marker.write_text("stale", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        bw.main()
    assert not marker.exists()          # stale marker removed, never rewritten

    def succeeded(*args, **kwargs):
        exe = tmp_path / "dist" / "PROFIN.R.0.4.0" / "PROFIN.R.0.4.0.exe"
        exe.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        exe.write_bytes(b"MZ")

    monkeypatch.setattr(bw.subprocess, "run", succeeded)
    assert bw.main() == 0
    assert marker.is_file()
```

```python
"""
Search and filters of the Reglas screen (app.categorization.rule_search),
the desktop RulesView on a filtered/sorted table (actions must hit the rule
of the selected row, not the row index of the unfiltered list) and the web
/mas/reglas page.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import time
from datetime import datetime

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.categorization.rule_search import (
    SCOPE_GLOBAL,
    SCOPE_PERSONAL,
    USAGE_WITH,
    USAGE_WITHOUT,
    RuleFilters,
    build_rule_rows,
    count_label,
    filter_options,
    filter_rule_rows,
)
from app.db.models import (
    AutoCategorizationRule,
    Base,
    Category,
    CategoryLevel,
    MatchType,
    TransactionType,
    User,
)
# Web fixtures (pytest picks up fixtures imported into the module).
from tests.test_web import _hx, app, factory, family, logged_in  # noqa: F401


@pytest.fixture
def db_session():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sess = sessionmaker(bind=engine)()
    yield sess
    sess.close()
    engine.dispose()


def _cat(s, user, name, parent=None, ttype=None):
    cat = Category(user_id=user.id, name=name,
                   parent_id=parent.id if parent else None,
                   level=CategoryLevel.category if parent else CategoryLevel.type,
                   transaction_type=ttype)
    s.add(cat)
    s.flush()
    return cat


@pytest.fixture
def rules(db_session):
    s = db_session
    ana = User(username="ana", password_hash="x")
    beto = User(username="beto", password_hash="x")
    s.add_all([ana, beto])
    s.flush()
    gasto = _cat(s, ana, "GASTO", ttype=TransactionType.expense)
    ingreso = _cat(s, ana, "INGRESO", ttype=TransactionType.income)
    alim = _cat(s, ana, "Alimentación", gasto)
    transp = _cat(s, ana, "Transporte", gasto)
    nomina = _cat(s, ana, "Nómina", ingreso)
    b_gasto = _cat(s, beto, "GASTO", ttype=TransactionType.expense)
    b_alim = _cat(s, beto, "Alimentación", b_gasto)
    b_ropa = _cat(s, beto, "Ropa", b_gasto)

    def rule(user, cat, pattern, mt, priority):
        r = AutoCategorizationRule(user_id=user.id if user else None, category_id=cat.id,
                                   match_pattern=pattern, match_type=mt, priority=priority,
                                   created_at=datetime(2026, 3, 7, 12, 0))
        s.add(r)
        s.flush()
        return r.id

    ids = {
        "mercadona": rule(ana, alim, "MERCADONA", MatchType.contains, 10),
        "repsol": rule(ana, transp, "^REPSOL", MatchType.regex, 20),
        "nomina": rule(ana, nomina, "NOMINA EMPRESA", MatchType.exact, 5),
        "lidl": rule(None, b_alim, "LIDL", MatchType.contains, 100),     # global → ana's Alimentación
        "zara": rule(None, b_ropa, "ZARA", MatchType.contains, 100),     # global, no equivalent for ana
        "secret": rule(beto, b_alim, "SECRETO", MatchType.contains, 1),  # beto's own: never shown to ana
    }
    s.commit()
    return s, ana, ids, {"alim": alim.id, "transp": transp.id}


def _shown(rows, **kw):
    return {r.id for r in filter_rule_rows(rows, RuleFilters(**kw))}


def test_rows_resolve_categories_and_scope(rules):
    s, ana, ids, cats = rules
    rows = {r.id: r for r in build_rule_rows(s, ana.id)}
    assert ids["secret"] not in rows and len(rows) == 5
    assert rows[ids["lidl"]].category_id == cats["alim"]          # mapped to ana's tree
    assert rows[ids["lidl"]].type_name == "GASTO" and rows[ids["lidl"]].is_global
    assert rows[ids["zara"]].category_id is None and rows[ids["zara"]].category_name == "Ropa"
    categories, types = filter_options(list(rows.values()))
    assert [c[1] for c in categories] == ["Alimentación", "Transporte", "Nómina"]
    assert types == ["GASTO", "INGRESO"]


def test_search_each_field(rules):
    s, ana, ids, _ = rules
    rows = build_rule_rows(s, ana.id, matches={ids["mercadona"]: 3})
    assert _shown(rows, text="mercadona") == {ids["mercadona"]}                 # pattern
    assert _shown(rows, text="repsol") == {ids["repsol"]}                       # pattern with regex chars
    assert _shown(rows, text="regex") == {ids["repsol"]}                        # match type label/value
    assert _shown(rows, text="expresión regular") == {ids["repsol"]}            # web wording
    assert _shown(rows, text="exacto") == {ids["nomina"]}
    assert _shown(rows, text="alimentacion") == {ids["mercadona"], ids["lidl"]}  # category, accent-folded
    assert _shown(rows, text="ropa") == {ids["zara"]}                           # unresolved global's category
    assert _shown(rows, text="ingreso") == {ids["nomina"]}                      # parent type
    assert _shown(rows, text="global") == {ids["lidl"], ids["zara"]}            # scope
    assert _shown(rows, text="personal") == {ids["mercadona"], ids["repsol"], ids["nomina"]}
    assert _shown(rows, text="20") == {ids["repsol"]}                           # priority, whole number
    assert _shown(rows, text="3") == {ids["mercadona"]}                         # linked transactions
    assert _shown(rows, text="07/03/2026") == set(ids.values()) - {ids["secret"]}  # creation date
    assert _shown(rows, text="2026") == set()                                   # a bare year is not a date


def test_search_and_words_case_and_accents(rules):
    s, ana, ids, _ = rules
    rows = build_rule_rows(s, ana.id)
    assert _shown(rows, text="mercadona alimentación") == {ids["mercadona"]}
    assert _shown(rows, text="mercadona transporte") == set()
    assert _shown(rows, text="GLOBAL Alimentacion") == {ids["lidl"]}
    assert _shown(rows, text="NÓMINA") == {ids["nomina"]}
    assert _shown(rows, text="nomina   EXACTO   ingreso") == {ids["nomina"]}
    assert _shown(rows, text="   ") == {r.id for r in rows}


def test_filters_combine_with_search(rules):
    s, ana, ids, cats = rules
    rows = build_rule_rows(s, ana.id, matches={ids["mercadona"]: 3, ids["lidl"]: 1})
    assert _shown(rows, category_id=cats["alim"]) == {ids["mercadona"], ids["lidl"]}
    assert _shown(rows, type_name="gasto") == {ids["mercadona"], ids["repsol"], ids["lidl"], ids["zara"]}
    assert _shown(rows, match_type=MatchType.regex) == {ids["repsol"]}
    assert _shown(rows, scope=SCOPE_GLOBAL) == {ids["lidl"], ids["zara"]}
    assert _shown(rows, scope=SCOPE_PERSONAL, usage=USAGE_WITHOUT) == {ids["repsol"], ids["nomina"]}
    assert _shown(rows, usage=USAGE_WITH) == {ids["mercadona"], ids["lidl"]}
    assert _shown(rows, category_id=cats["alim"], text="global") == {ids["lidl"]}
    assert _shown(rows, scope=SCOPE_GLOBAL, text="mercadona") == set()
    assert RuleFilters().is_empty() and not RuleFilters(scope=SCOPE_GLOBAL).is_empty()


def test_count_label():
    assert count_label(37, 412, True) == "Mostrando 37 de 412 reglas"
    assert count_label(412, 412, False) == "412 reglas"
    assert count_label(1, 1, False) == "1 regla"


def test_thousand_rules_build_and_filter_fast(rules):
    s, ana, ids, cats = rules
    s.add_all(
        AutoCategorizationRule(user_id=ana.id, category_id=cats["alim" if i % 2 else "transp"],
                               match_pattern=f"COMERCIO NÚMERO {i}", match_type=MatchType.contains,
                               priority=1 + i % 900)
        for i in range(1000)
    )
    s.commit()
    start = time.perf_counter()
    rows = build_rule_rows(s, ana.id, matches={})
    built = time.perf_counter() - start
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for text in ("comercio", "numero 99 transporte", "alimentacion personal", "zzz"):
        filter_rule_rows(rows, RuleFilters(text=text, usage=USAGE_WITHOUT))
    filtered = (time.perf_counter() - start) / 4
    assert len(rows) == 1005
    assert len(_shown(rows, text="número 999")) == 1
    assert built < 2.0 and filtered < 0.1, (built, filtered)

@pytest.fixture
def rules_view(rules, monkeypatch):

    QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

def _select_row(view, row):
    view._table.setCurrentIndex(view._model.index(row, 1))


def _shown_patterns(view):
    return [view._model.item(r, 1).text() for r in range(view._model.rowCount())]


def test_rules_view_search_filters_and_count(rules_view):
    view, _s, ids, cats = rules_view
    assert view._inp_search.placeholderText() == "Buscar reglas…"
    assert view._lbl_count.text() == "5 reglas" and not view._btn_clear.isEnabled()
    assert _shown_patterns(view) == ["NOMINA EMPRESA", "MERCADONA", "^REPSOL", "LIDL", "ZARA"]

    view._inp_search.setText("alimentacion")
    assert view._search_timer.isActive()            # debounced
    view._on_filter_changed()                       # what the timer fires
    assert set(_shown_patterns(view)) == {"MERCADONA", "LIDL"}
    assert view._lbl_count.text() == "Mostrando 2 de 5 reglas" and view._btn_clear.isEnabled()

    view._cmb_scope.setCurrentIndex(view._cmb_scope.findData(SCOPE_GLOBAL))
    assert _shown_patterns(view) == ["LIDL"]
    view._clear_filters()
    assert view._lbl_count.text() == "5 reglas" and view._cmb_scope.currentIndex() == 0
    assert view._inp_search.text() == ""

    view._cmb_cat.setCurrentIndex(view._cmb_cat.findData(cats["transp"]))
    assert _shown_patterns(view) == ["^REPSOL"]
    view._cmb_cat.setCurrentIndex(0)
    view._cmb_match.setCurrentIndex(view._cmb_match.findData(MatchType.exact))
    assert _shown_patterns(view) == ["NOMINA EMPRESA"]

    for theme in ("dark", "light"):
        view.apply_theme(theme)
        view.grab()


def test_rules_view_actions_hit_the_selected_rule_when_filtered_and_sorted(rules_view, monkeypatch):
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QMessageBox
    import app.gui.rules_view as module

    view, s, ids, _ = rules_view
    # Sorting by priority puts NOMINA (5) first; the search leaves only
    # rules whose position differs from the unfiltered list.
    view._inp_search.setText("alimentacion")
    view._on_filter_changed()
    view._table.sortByColumn(1, Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)   # by pattern, Z→A
    assert _shown_patterns(view) == ["MERCADONA", "LIDL"]

    _select_row(view, 1)
    assert view._selected_rule().id == ids["lidl"]

    # Edit: the dialog is accepted unchanged; update_rule must get LIDL's id.
    edited = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(QDialog, "exec", lambda self: QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted)
    monkeypatch.setattr(QMessageBox, "information", lambda *a, **k: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "update_rule", lambda session, rule_id, **kw: edited.append(rule_id))
    view._on_edit_rule()
    assert edited == [ids["lidl"]]

    # Delete the first shown row (MERCADONA, row 1 of the unfiltered list).
    view._inp_search.setText("alimentacion")
    view._on_filter_changed()
    _select_row(view, 0)
    assert view._selected_rule().id == ids["mercadona"]
    monkeypatch.setattr(QMessageBox, "question", lambda *a, **k: QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes)
    view._on_delete()
    assert s.get(AutoCategorizationRule, ids["mercadona"]) is None
    for key in ("repsol", "nomina", "lidl", "zara"):
        assert s.get(AutoCategorizationRule, ids[key]) is not None
    # The filter and the sort survive the refresh after the change.
    assert view._inp_search.text() == "alimentacion"
    assert _shown_patterns(view) == ["LIDL"]
    assert view._lbl_count.text() == "Mostrando 1 de 4 reglas"
```
